## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 1 — THE SILENT CANOPY, THE SCREAMING ROOT`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-7` (`GLDS-7` / `E-MTAB-1264` / DOI: `10.25966/7f77-hw17`)

- **Primary Publication:** Paul AL, Zupanska AK, Schultz ER, Ferl RJ. "Organ-specific remodeling of the Arabidopsis transcriptome in response to spaceflight." *BMC Plant Biology*. 2013;13:112. DOI: `10.1186/1471-2229-13-112` (PMID: `23919896`)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* — Wild-Type **Wassilewskija (`WS`)** (whole-plant assays) and mixed-plate **60% `WS` / 40% `Col-0`** (organ-dissected leaves, hypocotyls, roots); plus GFP reporter lines **`35s::GFP`**, **`Adh::GFP`**, and **`DR5r::GFP`** (imaging Run 3A).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **Advanced Biological Research System (ABRS)** with the **GFP Imaging System (GIS)** (6 vertical `10 cm²` solid `0.5x` MS phytagel plates; VOC-scrubbed air, `22–24°C` [mean `23°C`], white light, `light cycle: Not Available` in OSDR metadata). Flown on Space Shuttle `STS-129` (Run 1B), `STS-130` (Run 3A), and `STS-131` *Discovery* (Runs 2A & 2B; returned on `STS-132` *Atlantis*). Ground control in identical ABRS inside the **Orbital Environmental Simulator (OES)** at KSC on a 24–48 hr telemetry delay. Harvested at 12 days (14.5 days for Run 3A) into **RNAlater**-filled **KSC Fixation Tubes (KFTs)** and frozen in **MELFI** (`<-40°C`).

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Squad `WS` (Wassilewskija) & Squad `Col-0` (Columbia-0):** *Arabidopsis* seedling battalions sharing the `10 cm²` phytagel plates in a `60% WS / 40% Col-0` coalition (while pure `WS` stands watch in the whole-plant control). `Col-0` struggles with reduced lateral root branching in microgravity; both squads exhibit shorter roots, shorter hypocotyls, and pronounced root skewing.

- **Sentinel `DR5r::GFP` (Auxin Reporter):** A glowing bioluminescent scout embedded in the hypocotyls. Goes eerily dim during early orbital growth (Days 3.5–7.5) compared to Ground Control, then flares past terrestrial levels after Day 10.

- **Commander `HY5` (ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 5) & `RHL41` (Responsive to High Light 41, `3-fold` up in roots):** Photoreceptor-linked tactical officers operating *underground* in the root zone, hijacking light-sensing pathways to compensate for missing gravity.

- **Commander `DREB2A` (`At5g05410`), `DDF1` (`At1g12610`), & `WRKY48`:** Stress and touch/wound transcription factor commanders consistently upregulated across Runs 1B, 2A, and 2B (`p ≤ 0.01`) in roots.

- **Engineer `TCH4` (`At5g57560`, Xyloglucan Endotransglycosylase):** Master cell-wall remodeler; heavily upregulated in roots across all three flight runs, cutting and re-ligating xyloglucan tethers to steer skewing root tips.

- **Tactical Operative `JAZ7` (`At2g34600`):** Jasmonate-signaling repressor upregulated across Runs 1B, 2A, and 2B in roots, coordinating defense/wound cross-talk.

- **Gatekeeper `PGP18` (P-Glycoprotein 18):** Dual-allegiance light/cell-wall transporter—**highly upregulated in leaves**, yet **strongly repressed in roots**.

- **Scout `ELIP1` (`At3g22840`, Early Light-Induced Protein 1):** Chloroplast/light-stress sentinel consistently **downregulated** in spaceflight roots across Runs 1B, 2A, and 2B.

- **Metadata Anomaly ("The 60/40 Chimera & Missing Clock"):** The organ-dissected microarray plates combine `60% WS` and `40% Col-0` in single tubes, while the OSDR sample table records `light cycle: Not Available`—an archival blind spot in the orbital log.

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Page 31 — Experimental Architecture & The Whole-Plant Trap

- **Core Takeaway:** Whole-plant transcriptomics masked spaceflight's true impact. Dissecting 12-day-old *Arabidopsis thaliana* seedlings grown in the **ABRS / GIS** (`STS-129`, `STS-130`, `STS-131`) into **Leaves, Hypocotyls, and Roots** uncovered **480 DEGs** (`p < 0.01`, `≥ 1.9-fold`) and **58 high-magnitude DEGs** (`≥ 7-fold`), with only **26 genes** coordinately regulated across all three organs (17 up, 9 down).

- **Organ-by-Organ Doctrine:**

  - **Leaves:** Repressed hormone signaling (`ABC transporters`, `auxin response factors`) and cell wall proteins (`endochitinase`, `polygalacturonase`, `xylan glucuronosyltransferase`); upregulated herbivory/pathogen defense, Ca²⁺/phosphate signaling, and **`PGP18`**.

  - **Hypocotyls:** Shorter morphology; `1.5–4-fold` upregulation of `SAUR-like` (`AuxRE`) genes; `DR5r::GFP` auxin reporter repressed early (Days 3.5–7.5) then surged past Ground Control after Day 10.

  - **Roots:** Dominated the response (**20 of 31** genes induced `≥ 7-fold`), driving shorter roots, fewer `Col-0` lateral roots, negative phototropism, and skewing via **`TCH4`**, **`DDF1`**, **`DREB2A`**, **`JAZ7`**, **`WRKY48`**, **`CAF1`**, **`COW1`**, **`SP1L5`**, and **`HY5`/`RHL41`** light-signaling co-option, while **`ELIP1`** and **`PGP18`** were repressed.

### Page 32 — BLSS Implications & Study Citation

- **Bioregenerative Life Support (BLSS) Impact:**

  - **Organ-Resolved Crop Monitoring:** Whole-plant bulk assays miss tissue-specific stress (especially root-zone remodeling and leaf defense priming); future BLSS biosensors should target organ-specific promoters.

  - **Lighting as a Gravity Substitute:** Roots co-opt `HY5`-mediated light pathways (`RHL41`, `EXO`, `XT1`, `NUDT21`, `WRKY48`) when gravity is absent—meaning directional LED spectra can actively steer root architecture in orbital farms.

  - **Controlled Environment Baseline:** Using VOC-scrubbed ABRS chambers and RNAlater KFTs eliminated hypoxia (`Adh::GFP` remained silent), isolating genuine microgravity/spaceflight adaptation.

- **Primary Citation:** Paul AL, Zupanska AK, Schultz ER, Ferl RJ (2013). *BMC Plant Biology* 13:112. DOI: `10.1186/1471-2229-13-112` | OSDR: `OSD-7`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 2 — THE LEVITATING ABYSS`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-8` (`GEO:GSE29787` / Primary Study: PMC3368779)

- **Primary Publication:** Manzano AI, van Loon JJWA, Christianen PCM, Gonzalez-Rubio JM, Medina FJ, Herranz R. "Gravitational and magnetic field variations synergize to cause subtle variations in the global transcriptional state of Arabidopsis in vitro callus cultures." *BMC Genomics*. 2012;13:105. DOI: `10.1186/1471-2164-13-105` (PMID: `22435851`)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* semi-solid **`MM2d` undifferentiated callus cell cultures** (`1–2 mm` layer on `1%` agar MS medium; lacking statoliths).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** Ground-based multi-simulator campaign (`200 min` exposure, `22°C`, **total darkness**):

  - **HFML Water-Cooled Duplex-Bitter Magnet (Nijmegen, NL):** 5 stacked `40.8 × 25 mm` tubes in a PVC-capped column (`μg*` at `10.1 T`, `0.1 g*` at `14.7 T`, internal `1 g*` control at `16.5 T`, `1.9 g*` at `14.7 T`, `2 g*` at `10.1 T`), plus external `1 g` control (`> 4 m` radius).

  - **Random Positioning Machine (`μg-RPM`, ESA-ESTEC):** Real random mode, max `60 rpm`, `6°` angle, `90 mm` Petri dishes.

  - **Large Diameter Centrifuge (`2 g-LDC`, ESA-ESTEC):** `2 g` gondola vs. `1 g` central gondola (`+1°C` engine heat anomaly).

  - **Preservation & Assay:** Quick-frozen in **liquid nitrogen** (`< 2 min` post-run), stored on dry ice; **Agilent Arabidopsis Oligo Microarrays v4** (`~44k` probesets), analyzed via **Limma** (`p < 0.01`), **RankProd** (`FDR < 0.05`), **BiNGO**, and **GEDI** (`20 × 16` Self-Organizing Maps across `17,419` probesets).

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Squad `MM2d` (The Statolithless Callus):** Undifferentiated *Arabidopsis* suspension-derived cells flattened into a `1–2 mm` biofilm on agar. Unlike Vol. 1's seedlings, they have **no roots, no leaves, and no amyloplast statoliths**—meaning any gravity sensing here is purely cellular.

- **The Bitter Bore (16.5 T Magnet):** A towering vertical superconducting/water-cooled solenoid (`22°C` bath) where diamagnetic water levitates at `BB' = -1360 T²/m`. Divided into five vertical battlegrounds: `μg*`, `0.1 g*`, `1 g*`, `1.9 g*`, and `2 g*`.

- **The Twin Mechanical Arenas (`μg-RPM` & `2 g-LDC`):** A 3D-tumbling gyroscope (`60 rpm`) and a roaring centrifugal arm at ESA-ESTEC (plagued by a `+1°C` thermal leak in the central `1 g` gondola).

- **Thylakoid Alignment Corps (Upregulated in `1 g*`, `16.5 T`):** Plastid membrane units physically torqued into parallel formation by magnetic fields `≥ 1 T`, firing biosynthetic signals even in total darkness.

- **Transferases & Peroxidases (Common Magnet Stressors):** Frontline enzyme engineers reacting across magnet positions to the `> 10 T` magnetic field.

- **Cell Wall & Cytoskeleton Corps (Altered in `μg*`):** Structural remodelers and encapsulating-structure proteins responding to diamagnetic levitation.

- **Abiotic Stress Repressors (Downregulated in `μg-RPM`):** `77` stress-and-stimulus genes powered down under 3D clinorotation.

- **The GEDI Mosaic (`20 × 16` Centroid Grid):** A glowing `320-tile` bioluminescent HUD (`~54` probesets/tile) that bypasses single-gene `FDR` blindness to reveal the inverted hypogravity vs. hypergravity genome-wide wave.

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Page 31 — The Synergy & Statistical Blindness Takeaway

- **Core Biological Takeaway:** Undifferentiated *Arabidopsis* `MM2d` callus cultures—lacking statoliths—still sense and respond to altered effective gravity (`μg*`, `0.1 g*`, `1.9 g*`, `2 g*`), but the response is a **subtle, genome-wide fine-tuning** (`17,419` probesets in GEDI) rather than a massive single-gene spike.

- **Magnetic vs. Gravitational Effects:**

  - **Pure High Magnetic Field (`1 g*`, `16.5 T`):** Altered `96` genes (`limma p < 0.01`; `14` at `RankProd FDR < 0.05`), notably upregulating **thylakoid-related genes** (physical alignment at `≥ 1 T`) alongside **transferases** and **peroxidases**.

  - **Synergistic Stress (`0.1 g*` & `1.9 g*` at `14.7 T`):** Combining high `B` with altered `g*` tripled altered probesets (`283–318`) and triggered the broadest GO enrichment collapse.

  - **GEDI Inversion:** Subtracting `1 g*` from `xg*` revealed opposite global transcriptional states between **hypogravity** (`μg*`/`0.1 g*`) and **hypergravity** (`1.9 g*`/`2 g*`), mirrored between `μg-RPM` (`77` abiotic-stress genes repressed) and `1.9 g* − 1 g*`.

### Page 32 — BLSS Implications & Study Citation

- **Bioregenerative Life Support (BLSS) Impact:**

  - **Whole-Genome Diagnostics Over Single-Gene Thresholds:** Relying solely on strict `FDR` or `2.5-fold` cutoffs misses subtle, coordinated transcriptional shifts in partial-gravity (`0.17 g` Moon / `0.38 g` Mars) environments.

  - **Simulator Caveats:** Ground simulators introduce non-gravitational confounders—high magnetic fields (`10–16.5 T`) align plastid membranes, while centrifuges (`2 g-LDC`) add inertial shear and thermal drift (`+1°C`).

  - **Statolith-Independent Sensing:** Even undifferentiated plant cell cultures (`MM2d`) detect gravity shifts, proving cellular tensegrity/membrane mechanosensing operates independently of root statoliths.

- **Primary Citation:** Manzano AI et al. (2012). *BMC Genomics* 13:105. DOI: `10.1186/1471-2164-13-105` | `GEO:GSE29787` | `OSD-8`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 3 — THE DENATURED PROTEOME`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-16` (`GLDS-16` / `PXD001179` / DOI: `10.25966/scd9-gb35`)

- **Primary Publication:** Ferl RJ, Koh J, Denison F, Paul AL. "Spaceflight induces specific alterations in the proteomes of Arabidopsis." *Astrobiology*. 2015;15(1):32–56. DOI: `10.1089/ast.2014.1210` (PMID: `25517942`)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* — GFP reporter lines (`Adh::GFP`, `DR5r::GFP`, `35s::GFP`) harvested from **Run 1B** (`12-day-old` seedlings; Roots `n = 3` flight vs. `n = 3` ground, Leaves `n = 1` pooled flight vs. `n = 1` pooled ground).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **Advanced Biological Research System (ABRS)** with **GFP Imaging System (GIS)** on the ISS (`STS-129` launch Nov 16, 2009; Run 1B active growth `12/3/2009–12/15/2009`; returned on `STS-130` Feb 8, 2010), `10 cm²` solid media plates, VOC-scrubbed air, `light cycle: Not Available` in OSDR metadata. Ground control in identical ABRS inside the **Orbital Environmental Simulator (OES)** at KSC. Preserved on orbit in **RNAlater-filled KFTs** and stored at `-80°C`. Analyzed via **iTRAQ 8-plex** (`113–115` GC roots, `116–118` FLT roots, `119` GC leaves, `121` FLT leaves) on an **LTQ Orbitrap XL MS/MS** with **Eksigent nano-LC AS2**.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **The Run 1B Veterans (`Adh::GFP`, `DR5r::GFP`, `35s::GFP`):** Returning directly from the **ABRS/GIS** plates of Vol. 1 (`OSD-7`)—except this time, we follow the **proteins** extracted from their `RNAlater`-denatured tissues.

- **The RNAlater Salt Armor (Preservation Hazard):** A strong protein denaturant meant strictly for RNA. Surviving extraction in liquid-nitrogen-chilled buffer (`16 µg` per sample) strips away subcellular compartments, leaving only soluble protein survivors.

- **The iTRAQ 8-Plex Squad (`Tags 113–121`):** Eight mass-tag couriers (`113–115` Ground Roots, `116–118` Flight Roots, `119` Ground Leaves, `121` Flight Leaves) racing through a `14-fraction` SCX-HPLC and nano-LC Orbitrap gauntlet.

- **Root Oxidative & Energy Corps (`358` Differential Proteins: `237` Up, `121` Down):** Root proteome units surging in **cofactor metabolism**, **oxidative stress responses**, **cellular lipid metabolism**, and **ATP / purine nucleoside binding**—while **cell structure** proteins drop into scarcity.

- **Leaf Translation & Photosynthesis Corps (`256` Differential Proteins: `200` Up, `56` Down):** Leaf proteome units ramping up **ribosomal structural constituents**, **translation**, **photosynthesis**, **stress/defense**, **isomerase activity**, and **cell structure**—while **precursor metabolite/energy generation, localization, and transport** power down.

- **The 21 Polarity Flippers:** `21` shared proteins that reverse polarity between organs (up in leaves, down in roots—or vice versa), echoing `PGP18` from Vol. 1.

- **The 34 Concordant Messengers (`r = 0.49`):** The rare `34` genes that show matching differential shifts at *both* the mRNA (`OSD-7`) and protein (`OSD-16`) levels.

- **Metadata Anomaly ("Single-Pool Canopy & Missing Clock"):** While roots have `3` biological replicates (`80 mg` each), leaves are represented by only `1` pooled sample (`7` plants) per condition, and `light cycle` remains `Not Available`.

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Page 31 — Proteomic Divergence & Multi-Omic Concordance

- **Core Biological Takeaway:** Spaceflight drives **organ-specific proteomic remodeling** in 12-day-old *Arabidopsis* (`ABRS/GIS`, Run 1B). Out of `1,570` proteins identified (`5%` FDR; `1,167` leaf and `1,150` root proteins quantified), **`358` root proteins** (`237` up, `121` down) and **`256` leaf proteins** (`200` up, `56` down) changed significantly (`p < 0.05`, FC `> 1.2` or `< 0.8`).

- **Organ Polarity:** Only `47` proteins shifted in the same direction in both organs, while `21` shifted in **opposite directions**.

  - **Leaves:** Upregulated **translation/ribosomes, photosynthesis, stress/defense, isomerase activity, and cell structure**; downregulated **transport, localization, and precursor metabolite/energy generation**.

  - **Roots:** Upregulated **oxidative stress response, cofactor metabolism, cellular lipid metabolism, and ATP/purine nucleoside binding**; downregulated **cell structure** abundance.

- **mRNA vs. Protein (`OSD-7` vs. `OSD-16`):** Only `34` genes were differentially regulated in both datasets, but those `34` showed a strong positive correlation (`r = 0.49`, `p = 0.0003`; `rs = 0.51`, `p = 0.00016`).

### Page 32 — BLSS Implications & Study Citation

- **Bioregenerative Life Support (BLSS) Impact:**

  - **Multi-Omics from Single KFTs:** Proved that **RNAlater-fixed** orbital samples can yield both high-quality RNA (`OSD-7`) and quantitative iTRAQ proteomics (`OSD-16`), maximizing science return per gram of crew-harvested crop tissue.

  - **Root Energetic & Oxidative Load:** Spaceflight roots burn more ATP/cofactors and mount heavier oxidative-stress defenses than leaves—key targets for engineering resilient hydroponic/aeroponic BLSS crops.

  - **Post-Transcriptional Gap:** Because mRNA and protein profiles diverge (`34` shared DEGs/DEPs), crop-health biosensors must validate protein-level outcomes rather than relying on transcriptomes alone.

- **Primary Citation:** Ferl RJ, Koh J, Denison F, Paul AL (2015). *Astrobiology* 15(1):32–56. DOI: `10.1089/ast.2014.1210` | `PXD001179` | `OSD-16`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 4 — THE DARK VAULT & THE HEAT SHOCK FURNACE`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-17` (`GLDS-17` / `STS-131` / `BRIC-16`)

- **Primary Publication:** Paul AL, Zupanska AK, Ostrow DT, Zhang Y, Sun Y, Li JL, Shanker S, Farmerie WG, Amalfitano CE, Ferl RJ. "Spaceflight transcriptomes: unique responses to a novel environment." *Astrobiology*. 2012;12(1):40–56. DOI: `10.1089/ast.2011.0696` (PMID: `22221117`)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* Wild-Type cultivar **Columbia (`Col-0`)** — **etiolated seedlings** (`~75` seeds/plate, `n = 6`) vs. **undifferentiated tissue culture cells** (`~1 g` callus/plate, `n = 6` analyzed).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **BRIC-LED** canisters (`BRIC A`, `BRIC B`, `BRIC G`) with **Petri Dish Fixation Units (PDFUs)** (`60 mm` Petri plates, `6.7 mL` / `≤ 5 mm` MS agar) and **HOBO data loggers** (`21.7–24.8°C`). Launched on Space Shuttle *Discovery* (`STS-131`, April 5, 2010) for `12 days, 21 hours` on orbit. **Hardware Quirk:** Flown as a **nonpowered** middeck payload, so **the LEDs were completely OFF**—total darkness. Ground Control in identical BRIC-PDFUs inside the KSC **OES** on a 24-hour delay. Fixed in-orbit on Day 12 via **RNAlater** injection; assayed by **Affymetrix ATH1 Microarrays**, **SOLiD 4 SAGE**, and **TaqMan RT-qPCR**.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Squad `Col-0` Seedlings (The Etiolated Regiment):** `75` seeds per `60 mm` dish growing pale and tall in total darkness (`BRIC A` & `BRIC G`). Armed with roots, hypocotyls, and statocytes—mounting a moderate, low-amplitude defense/stress response.

- **Squad `Col-0` Cultured Cells (The Undifferentiated Swarm):** `1 g` of organless *Arabidopsis* callus cells spread across MS agar (`BRIC B` & `BRIC G`). Lacking roots, leaves, or stomata—they respond with a **massive, high-amplitude Heat Shock explosion**.

- **Commander `ATHSFA2` (`At2g26150`, `35.26×` up in Cells):** Supreme Heat Shock Transcription Factor leading the cultured-cell brigade—despite *zero* thermal spike (`21.7–24.8°C`).

- **The Chaperone Phalanx (`HSP70` `22.47×`, `ATHSP101` `19.16×`, `ATHSP90.1` `18.77×`, `Hsp70b` `18.51×`, `ATHSP17.4` `16.68×`, `HSP17.6A` `8.57×`):** Unfolded-protein crisis responders dominating `75%` of all `> 7-fold` genes in cultured cells.

- **Commander `LTP6` (`At3g08770`, `16.80×` up in Seedlings) & `WRKY71` (`9.85×` up in Seedlings):** Frontline drought-lipid and pathogen-response officers leading the etiolated seedlings.

- **Returning Veteran `DREB2A` (`At5g05410`, `5.03×` up in Cells):** Stress commander from Vol. 1 (`OSD-7` roots), reappearing here inside the undifferentiated cell swarm.

- **The Lone Double Agent `MT3` (`At3g15353`, Metallothionein 3):** The **only** gene (`≥ 2-fold`, `p < 0.01`) shared between seedlings and cultured cells—and it flips sides (`2.57×` up in seedlings, `0.18×` down in cells).

- **Metadata / Hardware Anomaly ("Unlit BRIC-LED"):** Flown in **BRIC-LED** canisters whose LEDs were unpowered by mission design, turning a light-capable habitat into a sealed, dark vault.

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Page 31 — Differentiated Seedlings vs. Undifferentiated Cells

- **Core Biological Takeaway:** In **BRIC-16** (`STS-131`, `12d 21h` in total darkness inside unpowered **BRIC-LED/PDFU** canisters), *Arabidopsis* `Col-0` etiolated seedlings and undifferentiated cell cultures both altered `~300` genes (`p < 0.01`), **but shared virtually no overlapping DEGs**—only **`MT3` (`At3g15353`)** was common at `≥ 2-fold`, flipping from `+2.57×` in seedlings to `0.18×` in cells.

- **Divergent Molecular Tactics:**

  - **Etiolated Seedlings:** Moderate, low-abundance response led by pathogen/wounding and drought/ABA genes (**`LTP6` `16.80×`**, **`WRKY71` `9.85×`**, **`HEMC` `8.28×`**, **`ALF4` `5.43×`**) and repression of **`XI-J myosin` (`0.09×`)**, **`GA2OX8` (`0.10×`)**, and **`AGD1` (`0.12×`)**.

  - **Cultured Cells:** High-abundance, dramatic response dominated by **Heat Shock** factors and chaperones (**`ATHSFA2` `35.26×`**, **`HSP70` `22.47×`**, **`ATHSP101` `19.16×`**, **`ATHSP90.1` `18.77×`**, **`Hsp70b` `18.51×`**, **`ATHSP17.4` `16.68×`**) despite matched `21.7–24.8°C` temperatures.

### Page 32 — BLSS Implications & Study Citation

- **Bioregenerative Life Support (BLSS) Impact:**

  - **Statolithless Cells Sense Spaceflight:** Undifferentiated plant cells detect orbital conditions without specialized gravity-sensing organs, activating chaperone cross-talk (`HSFA2`/`HSPs`) as a generalized multi-stress buffer.

  - **Tissue Culture vs. Whole Crops:** Biomanufacturing in space using plant cell suspensions cannot assume seedling-like gene regulation—cell cultures mount far sharper chaperone and transcriptional shifts.

  - **Hardware Reality Check:** Unpowered **BRIC-LED** flights operate in total darkness, making `OSD-17` a pure dark-adaptation baseline.

- **Primary Citation:** Paul AL et al. (2012). *Astrobiology* 12(1):40–56. DOI: `10.1089/ast.2011.0696` | `OSD-17`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 5 — The Epsomite Sieve`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-22` (`GLDS-22` / `GEO:GSE20109` / `DOI: 10.25966/yr5e-ye67`)

- **Primary Publication:** Visscher AM, Paul AL, Kirst M, Guy CL, Schuerger AC, Ferl RJ (2010). *Growth Performance and Root Transcriptome Remodeling of Arabidopsis in Response to Mars-Like Levels of Magnesium Sulfate.* *PLoS ONE* 5(8): e12348. (`DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0012348`, `PMID: 20808807`, PMC2925951)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* — `Col-0` (Wild Type) and `cax1-1` (vacuolar `Ca2+/H+` antiporter knockout, `At2g38170`) for transcriptomics; `Col-0`, `Ws`, `mrs2-10` (`At1g80900` knockout), `sel1-10` (`AtSULTR1;2` knockout), `cax1-1`, and `cax1/cax3` for 4-week soil growth assays.

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **Ground Mars-Regolith Simulation** (Kennedy Space Center / University of Florida).

  - **Soil Bioassay:** Sphagnum peat moss/vermiculite/perlite trays irrigated with `2.2 g/L` MS + `0.5 g/L` MES (`pH 5.70–5.75`) + `0, 20, 60, 80, or 100 mM` `MgSO4·7H2O` (epsomite, modeling Martian regolith up to `10 wt%` hydrated sulfates at Meridiani Planum & Gusev Crater).

  - **Hydroponic Transcriptome Rig:** `2.6 L` glass tanks wrapped in opaque black plastic sheeting with `18`-hole opaque lids and `2-cm` Rockwool (`Grodan`) plugs, aerated by `3W` air pumps and glass-bead airstones (`1/32x` MS Weeks 1–2; `1/16x` MS Week 3, `23°C`). At Day 21, roots were flooded with `+2.08 mM` `MgSO4` (`Ca:Mg = 1:15`) for `45 min`, `90 min`, and `180 min` (`Col-0`) or `180 min` (`cax1-1`) vs. `45 min` `Col-0` control (`n = 4` tanks/group, `18` plants/tank).

  - **Preservation & Assay:** Roots excised below Rockwool plugs, flash-frozen in **liquid nitrogen** (`-80°C`), and profiled on **Agilent `4×44k` Arabidopsis Microarrays** (`37,478` transcripts, `q < 0.05` FDR) + diurnally controlled Q-PCR (`At2g32170` reference).

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Col-0 Squad (Root Vanguard):** Veteran hydroponic root divers suspended beneath blacked-out Rockwool decks. At `2.08 mM` `MgSO4` (`Ca:Mg = 1:15`), their transcriptional alarm cascades from `325` DEGs (`45 min`) to `1,516` (`90 min`) and `3,265` (`180 min`).

- **cax1-1 (The Unplugged Valve):** A `Col-0` knockout mutant lacking the tonoplast `Ca2+/H+` antiporter `CAX1`. In soil at `80–100 mM` `MgSO4·7H2O`, `cax1-1` retains `+89%` and `+149%` more shoot fresh-weight biomass than `Col-0` (though still at `20%` of untreated `Col-0`).

- **mrs2-10 & sel1-10 (The Failed Shields):** Plasma-membrane knockout recruits lacking `AtMRS2-10` (`Mg2+` channel) and `AtSULTR1;2` (`80%` reduced sulfate uptake). Both fail to outlast `Col-0`/`Ws` on epsomite soil, proving **`Mg2+` cation toxicity**—not `SO4^2-`—is the primary killer.

- **CAX1 (`At2g38170`, `Log2FC -0.57` at `45m`, `-0.87` at `90m`, `-0.73` at `180m`):** Tonoplast `Ca2+/H+` gatekeeper who normally drains cytosolic `Ca2+` into the vacuole. Under `1:15` `Ca:Mg` attack, `Col-0` orders `CAX1` (and `CAX3`, `-1.17` at `90m`) to stand down within `45 min` to hoard scarce cytosolic `Ca2+`.

- **MHX1 (`At2g47600`, `Log2FC +0.39` at `90m`, `+0.41` at `180m`) & SULTR4;1 (`At5g13550`, `Log2FC -0.55` at `180m`):** Vacuolar containment duo. `MHX1` pumps invading `Mg2+` into the vacuolar vault, while `SULTR4;1` locks its efflux hatch to trap excess `SO4^2-` inside.

- **EXP12 (`At3g15370`, `Log2FC +3.21`) & EXP17 (`At4g01630`, `Log2FC +2.50`):** Hyper-charged alpha-expansin sappers loosening cell walls at `45 min`, clashing against retreating `EXPB1` (`-1.04`), `AGP17` (`-1.15`), and `XTH9` (`-0.41`).

- **NCED (`At1g78390`, `Log2FC +2.55`) & ABRE-CE (`p = 5.11E-17`):** ABA biosynthesis commander and the dominant `ACGCGG/CCGCGT` promoter beacon (`33/156` upregulated genes at `45 min`), flanked by `CIPK9` (`+1.78`), `ACS` (`+1.86`), `HAK5` (`+1.55`), `ZAT7` (`+0.99`), and suppressed `WRKY70` (`-0.95`).

- **The Diurnal Drift Anomaly (Metadata Hazard):** Because `Time 90` and `Time 180` microarrays were benchmarked against the `45 min` control rather than time-matched controls, a circadian shadow creeps into the telemetry—exposed and corrected by diurnally matched Q-PCR (`CAX1 = 0.641`, `p = 0.004`; `SULTR3;4 = 0.861`, `p = 0.049`).

### Page 31 (Mission Debrief — Biological & Molecular Summary)

- **Header:** `OSD-22 MISSION DEBRIEF: MARS-LIKE MgSO4·7H2O STRESS`

- **Panel A — Cation vs. Anion Verdict:** `mrs2-10` (`Mg2+` uptake KO) and `sel1-10` (`80%` lower `SO4^2-` uptake) showed **no growth advantage** on `20–100 mM` `MgSO4·7H2O` soil. **`Mg2+` cation toxicity** (low `Ca:Mg` ratio) is the dominant phytotoxic driver.

- **Panel B — `cax1-1` Partial Tolerance:** `cax1-1` achieved **`+89%` (`80 mM`)** and **`+149%` (`100 mM`)** higher shoot FW biomass and higher chlorophyll than `Col-0`, though still `20%` of untreated `Col-0`.

- **Panel C — Rapid Transcriptome Cascade (`Col-0`, `Ca:Mg = 1:15`):** `325` DEGs (`45m`) →\rightarrow→ `1,516` (`90m`) →\rightarrow→ `3,265` (`180m`), including `217` unique transporters (`13` →\rightarrow→ `74` →\rightarrow→ `189`). `ABRE-CE` (`p = 5.11E-17`) dominates upregulated promoters; `CAX1` (`-0.57` at `45m`, diurnal Q-PCR `0.641`, `p = 0.004`) is downregulated immediately alongside `MHX1` induction (`+0.41`) and `SULTR3;1`/`3;4`/`4;1` repression.

- **Panel D — `cax1-1` vs. `Col-0` at `180 min`:** Only **4 unique transcripts** differed (`q < 0.05`): `CAX1` (`-3.05`/`-3.82`), `At3g01345.1` (`-2.73`), `At4g07526.1` (`-1.20`), and `CHR2:011819877–011819818` (`-1.09`), because `Col-0` rapidly suppresses `CAX1` to phenocopy `cax1-1` early on.

### Page 32 (Mission Debrief — BLSS Implications & Citation)

- **BLSS Engineering Takeaway:** Growing crops in *in situ* Martian regolith (up to `10 wt%` epsomite/kieserite) cannot rely on knocking out outer-membrane `Mg2+` or `SO4^2-` uptake gates. Engineering **vacuolar sequestration** (`MHX1` up, `SULTR4;1` down) and **cytosolic `Ca2+` retention** (`CAX1`/`CAX3` attenuation) offers a viable path to Mars-soil-compatible crops, while narrowing candidate loci from `>10,000` to `~500`.

- **Primary Source:** Visscher AM et al. (2010), *PLoS ONE* 5(8): e12348 (PMC2925951) | `OSD-22`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 6 — Four Flags in the Dark Vault`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-37` (`GLDS-37` / `DOI: 10.26030/zmwr-qf48`)

- **Primary Publication:** Choi WG, Barker RJ, Kim SH, Swanson SJ, Gilroy S (2019). *Variation in the transcriptome of different ecotypes of Arabidopsis thaliana reveals signatures of oxidative stress in plant responses to spaceflight.* *American Journal of Botany* 106(1): 123–136. (`DOI: 10.1002/ajb2.1223`, `PMID: 30644539`, PubMed)

- **Cross-Study Meta-Analysis:** Barker R et al. (2023), *npj Microgravity* 9(1): 21 (PMC10027818).

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* — four natural ecotypes: `Col-0` (Columbia), `Ws-2` (Wassilewskija), `Ler-0` (Landsberg *erecta*), and `Cvi-0` (Cape Verde Islands).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **BRIC-19** (`Biological Research in Canisters`, unpowered, **continuous 24 h darkness**), `60 mm` Petri dishes inside **PDFUs** (`5` PDFUs + `1` HOBO data-logger per BRIC; `4` BRICs). `64` seeds/plate on `15 mL` `1/2`-strength Epstein's medium + `1%` Phytagel + `10 mM` sucrose (`pH 5.7`), pre-irradiated `12 h` (`70 μmol m-2 s-1` white fluorescent, `22°C`), chilled `4°C` in a **Double Cold Bag** (`150 h` total cold hold through launch on **SpaceX CRS-4**, Sep 21 – Oct 25, 2014). Grown `8 days` at ISS ambient (`~24°C`); ground controls run in **ISSES** (`48 h` telemetry delay).

- **Preservation & Assay:** In-orbit actuation of `13 mL` **RNAlater** (`12 h` fixation), **MELFI (`-80°C`)** storage, `-32°C` Dragon return. Ribo-Zero plant leaf rRNA depletion + **Illumina HiSeq 2000** (`2×101 bp` paired-end RNA-Seq, `~30–64M` reads/sample; `2,084` original DEGs / `2,785` GeneLab-pipeline DEGs).

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Col-0 Squad (Columbia Standard):** Veteran central-European line; baseline orbital responder.

- **Ws-2 Squad (Wassilewskija Rangers):** Eastern-European line with high transcriptional plasticity.

- **Ler-0 Squad (Landsberg *erecta* Guard):** Compact-rosette line (flagged with an archival `Ler-2` vs. `Ler-0` label quirk in the repository description).

- **Cvi-0 Squad (Cape Verde Vanguard):** Atlantic-island ecotype evolved under intense sun and drought—testing whether geographic divergence rewires spaceflight survival.

- **HOT1 / HSP101 (`AT1G74310`):** Returning molecular-chaperone titan from Vol. 4 (`OSD-17`). Upregulated across **all four ecotypes** in spaceflight to shield proteins from oxidative denaturation.

- **PRX39 (`AT4G11290`):** Cell-wall peroxidase sentinel. Part of the conserved **downregulated** peroxidase wave in spaceflight across ecotypes, leaving reactive oxygen species (ROS) unbuffered.

- **COR78 (`AT5G52310`) & ABS4 (`AT1G58340`):** Cold-regulated stress marker (`COR78`) and MATE multidrug/toxic-compound extrusion transporter (`ABS4`), both conserved spaceflight loci shared across `Col-0`, `Ws-2`, `Ler-0`, and `Cvi-0`.

- **AAP2 (`AT5G09220`) & MAGL4 (`AT1G73480`):** Amino acid permease and α\alphaα-β\betaβ hydrolase completing the `6`-gene conserved BRIC-19 core (`PMC10027818`).

- **The Stagnant-Air & Metadata Anomalies:** Inside unpowered, convection-free BRIC-PDFUs, lack of buoyancy traps exhaled gases—triggering **microgravity-induced hypoxia** and **oxidative stress**. Meanwhile, archival logs carry three quirks: `Ler-2` vs. `Ler-0` naming, `8` of `56` samples held back in initial release, and ground replicate `GC_Rep3_R1-GC-B1` sequenced at `151 bp` instead of `101 bp`.

### Page 31 (Mission Debrief — Biological & Molecular Summary)

- **Header:** `OSD-37 MISSION DEBRIEF: FOUR ECOTYPES IN BRIC-19`

- **Panel A — Conserved Orbital Signature:** Across `Col-0`, `Ws-2`, `Ler-0`, and `Cvi-0` grown `8 days` in continuous darkness (`BRIC-19`, SpaceX CRS-4), **heat-shock proteins (HSPs)** were consistently **upregulated**, while **peroxidase transcripts** were **downregulated** (Choi et al., 2019).

- **Panel B — Hypoxia-Oxidative Axis:** Stagnant, convection-free air in sealed microgravity PDFUs induces **hypoxia-linked oxidative stress**, driving HSP chaperone induction and ubiquitin-proteasome protein turnover.

- **Panel C — Ecotype Divergence:** Alongside shared stress networks (`2,084` original / `2,785` GeneLab DEGs), each ecotype mounted distinct transcriptional responses—demonstrating that natural genetic variation shapes spaceflight adaptation.

- **Panel D — 6 Conserved BRIC Loci (PMC10027818):** `AT1G74310` (`HOT1/HSP101`), `AT1G58340` (`ABS4`), `AT5G52310` (`COR78`), `AT4G11290` (`PRX39`), `AT5G09220` (`AAP2`), and `AT1G73480` (`MAGL4`) were differentially expressed across **all 4 ecotypes** and shared with `OSD-38` and `OSD-121`.

### Page 32 (Mission Debrief — BLSS Implications & Citation)

- **BLSS Engineering Takeaway:**

  - **Active Ventilation Is Non-Negotiable:** Passive, unpowered chambers trap boundary layers, triggering hypoxia and peroxidase suppression even in non-photosynthetic seedlings.

  - **Cultivar Selection Matters:** Ecotype-level genetic variation alters spaceflight stress routing; BLSS crop breeding should screen diverse cultivars rather than relying on a single reference line.

  - **Chaperone & Plastid Biomarkers:** `HSP101` and `COR78` provide reliable cross-genotype diagnostics for orbital oxidative stress.

- **Primary Source:** Choi WG et al. (2019), *Am J Bot* 106(1): 123–136 (PubMed) | Barker R et al. (2023), *npj Microgravity* 9:21 (PMC10027818) | `OSD-37`.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** `Vol. 7 — The Uncoupled Proteome`

- **Target Accession:** `OSD-38` (`GLDS-38` / `DOI: 10.26030/p03c-xa96`)

- **Primary Publications:**

  - Kruse CPS, Meyers AD, Basu P, Hutchinson S, Luesse DR, Wyatt SE (2020). *Spaceflight induces novel regulatory responses in Arabidopsis seedling as revealed by combined proteomic and transcriptomic analyses.* *BMC Plant Biology* 20: 237 (`DOI: 10.1186/s12870-020-02392-6`, `PMID: 32460700`, PMC7251690)

  - Kruse CPS, Basu P, Luesse DR, Wyatt SE (2017), *PLoS ONE* (`DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0175943`, `PMID: 28423006` — RNAlater vs. LN2\text{LN}_2LN2​ control)

  - Basu P, Kruse CPS, Luesse DR, Wyatt SE (2017), *Life Sci Space Res* (`DOI: 10.1016/j.lssr.2017.09.001`, `PMID: 29198318` — BRIC hardware vs. foil control)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* `Col-0` (Columbia Wild Type, ABRC).

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **BRIC-20** (`4` canisters, `22` `60 mm` Petri plates in **PDFUs**, `800–900` seeds/plate on `0.5x` MS + `1%` sucrose + `1%` agar). Cold-stratified `16 h`, light-synchronized `1–2 h` white light, held `4 days` at `4°C`, launched on **SpaceX CRS-5** (`Jan 10 – Feb 11, 2015`), germinated and grown **`76 hours` (`~3 days`)** in **continuous 24 h darkness** at `22°C`. Ground controls included KSC BRICs, Ohio University foil-wrapped containers, and a dedicated **RNAlater vs. Liquid Nitrogen (LN2\text{LN}_2LN2​)** preservation control (`n = 3` pools of `5` plates for proteomics; `1` plate/replicate for RNA-Seq).

- **Preservation & Assay:** In-orbit **RNAlater** (`6–7 mL`, `12 h` ambient fixation) followed by `-80°C` freeze. **Illumina HiSeq 2500** (`2×101 bp` Ribo-Zero RNA-Seq, `3` concatenated technical runs/sample) + **iTRAQ 8-plex** (`114–119`) soluble & membrane proteomics on **LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro** (`12` high-pH RP fractions).

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Col-0 Etiolated Swarm (3-Day Recruits):** `800–900` densely packed seedlings per dish—younger and denser than `OSD-37`'s `8`-day, `64`-seed plates—racing through `76 hours` of dark germination.

- **TIP3;2 (The Paradox Gatekeeper):** Tonoplast aquaporin whose **protein abundance surges** in spaceflight even while its **mRNA drops `>4-fold`**—personifying post-transcriptional uncoupling (`~30%` of the `17` shared mRNA-protein loci show opposite signs).

- **dPGM (`AT5G04120`) & DNA Pol ε\varepsilonε (`AT1G19530`):** Rare concordant anchors: glycolytic cofactor-dependent phosphoglycerate mutase `dPGM` rises in both RNA and protein to burn `1%` sucrose, while DNA polymerase epsilon subunit A falls in both.

- **GRP7 & GRP8 (The Splicing Phospho-Switches):** Glycine-rich RNA-binding proteins differentially phosphorylated at **Ser118** (`L2FC_phospho = -0.39` and `-0.54` in space vs. Earth), triggering isoform switching across `24` genes.

- **VILLIN 1 (`AT2G29890`):** Actin-binding cytoskeletal twin-blade: isoform `.2` rockets to `L2FC_RNA > +5` in spaceflight while isoform `.3` plunges to `< -7.5` on Earth.

- **TUA4 / TUA6 / TUB1 / TUB5 & ATPIN3 / AtLAZY1:** Cortical microtubule and auxin-polarity squadron upregulated in `BRIC-20` seedlings, even as autophagy units `ATG8b`, `ATG8e`, `ATG8f` power down.

- **The RNAlater & Hardware Ghosts:** Dedicated ground controls (`rl-1..3` vs. `n2-1..3`, plus KSC BRIC vs. Ohio foil) that strip away chemical-fixation and polycarbonate-box artifacts before crowning true microgravity signals.

### Page 31 (Mission Debrief — Biological & Molecular Summary)

- **Header:** `OSD-38 MISSION DEBRIEF: MULTI-OMIC UNCOUPLING IN BRIC-20`

- **Panel A — Multi-Omic Scale (`76 h`, `Col-0`, SpaceX CRS-5):** `968` DEGs (`480` up, `488` down, `L2FC >= ±1`), `107` soluble proteins (`21` up, `86` down), `103` membrane proteins (`45` up, `58` down, `L2FC >= ±0.2`), and `16` differentially phosphorylated peptides (`P <= 0.1`) (PMC7251690).

- **Panel B — Post-Transcriptional Uncoupling:** Only `17` loci overlapped between RNA and protein (`p = 9.7e-4`), and **`~30%` inverted direction** (e.g., `TIP3;2` protein up despite `>4-fold` mRNA drop), while `dPGM` (`AT5G04120`) rose in both and `AT1G19530` fell in both.

- **Panel C — Alternative Splicing & Phospho-Switches:** `GRP7` (`-0.39`) and `GRP8` (`-0.54`) showed reduced `S118` phosphorylation in space, coinciding with isoform switching in `24` genes—notably `VILLIN 1` (`AT2G29890.2` `> +5` vs. `.3` `< -7.5`).

- **Panel D — Plastids, Cytoskeleton & Rigorous Controls:** `>25%` of upregulated transcripts were plastid-localized despite total darkness; `TUA4/6`, `TUB1/5`, `ATPIN3`, and `AtLAZY1` rose while `ATG8b/e/f` fell. Ground `RNAlater` vs. LN2\text{LN}_2LN2​ and BRIC vs. foil controls isolated true spaceflight effects.

### Page 32 (Mission Debrief — BLSS Implications & Citation)

- **BLSS Engineering Takeaway:**

  - **Transcriptomics Alone Is Incomplete:** Because translation, protein stability, and `S118`-gated alternative splicing uncouple in microgravity, crop engineering for BLSS must validate targets at the **proteome and PTM** levels.

  - **Dark-Phase Energy & Plastid Priming:** `dPGM` glycolysis and dark plastid transcription show that germinating spaceflight crops rapidly reallocate carbon and plastid readiness before light exposure.

  - **Preservation & Hardware Controls:** Including `RNAlater` vs. LN2\text{LN}_2LN2​ and hardware-enclosure controls prevents chemical-fixation artifacts from masquerading as microgravity biology.

- **Primary Source:** Kruse CPS et al. (2020), *BMC Plant Biol* 20:237 (PMC7251690) | `OSD-38`.

(`DOI: 10.3732/ajb.1400458`, `PMID: 25587145`, PubMed)

- **Flight Hardware & Conditions:** **BRIC-16** (`Biological Research in Canisters`, unpowered **complete darkness**) aboard **Space Shuttle *Discovery* (`STS-131`, Apr 5 – Apr 20, 2010)**. `150–200` seeds per `60 mm` Petri dish inside light-tight **BRIC-PDFU** canisters (`5` PDFUs/BRIC, foam-padded middeck locker); grown **14 days**. Space radiation exposure (`12.88` living days): **`3.2 mGy`** mean (`2.62–4.42 mGy`, TLDs `DLOC1–3`). Ground controls (`GW`, `GA`) housed in the **Orbital Environmental Simulator (OES)** at KSC SLSL.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Col-0 Squad (`SW` / `GW`):** Wild-type etiolated seedlings (`14 days` in `BRIC-16`). Their primary roots maintain relatively straight trajectories in `0g`—until their root-hair tip-growth genes go dark.

- **act2-3 Squad (The Uncoiled Actin Mutant, `SA` / `GA`):** Vegetative `ACTIN2` knockout mutants. Indistinguishable from `Col-0` on Earth (`1g`), in microgravity their roots violently **coil and skew left-handed** (high FFT entropy) with severely disrupted nascent cell walls.

- **PRX44 & PRX57 (The Tip-Growth Peroxidases):** Uncharacterized root-hair-enriched **class III peroxidases** **repressed** in microgravity across *both* `Col-0` and `act2-3` (actin-independent), mirroring hypoxia repression. When knocked out on Earth, their root-hair tips **rupture** from thin, weakened cell walls.

- **Phosphoinositide Signaling Unit:** Membrane lipid-signaling relays modulating root-hair polarity in an **actin-dependent** branch—the sole cytoskeletal fork where `act2-3` diverges from `Col-0`.

- **Plastid & Mitochondrial Organelle Choir:** Dark-grown organelle transcripts (`GLDS-44` enrichment noted in PMC7830483) humming abnormally in total darkness alongside `BRIC-16` sibling `OSD-17` (Vol. 4).

### Page 31 (Mission Debrief — Biological & Molecular Summary)

- **Header:** `OSD-44 MISSION DEBRIEF: ROOT HAIRS & ACTIN IN BRIC-16 (STS-131)`

- **Panel A — Root Hair Peroxidase Repression:** `14`-day dark-grown *Arabidopsis* seedlings (`Col-0` and `act2-3`) repressed **oxidative stress and cell-wall remodeling** genes enriched in **root hairs**, including class III peroxidases **`PRX44`** and **`PRX57`** (Kwon et al., 2015).

- **Panel B — Earth Mutant Proof:** `prx44` and `prx57` knockouts on Earth exhibit **ruptured root hairs** due to mechanically weak tip cell walls, directly linking microgravity gene repression to spaceflight root-hair defects.

- **Panel C — Actin-Independent vs. Actin-Dependent:** Class III peroxidase repression in `0g` is **actin-independent** (seen in both `Col-0` and `act2-3`), whereas **phosphoinositide-mediated** root-hair modulation is **actin-dependent**.

- **Panel D — Left-Handed Coiling & Cell Wall Disruption:** `act2-3` spaceflight roots coiled/skewed left-handedly with higher FFT entropy and severely disrupted cell walls (`Nakashima et al., 2014`), proving the actin cytoskeleton suppresses endogenous skewing in `0g`.

### Page 32 (Mission Debrief — BLSS Implications & Citation)

- **BLSS Engineering Takeaway:**

  - **Protecting Nutrient Capture:** Because root hairs drive water and mineral uptake, `0g`-induced hypoxia and `PRX44`/`PRX57` repression threaten nutrient-use efficiency in space crops.

  - **Cytoskeletal Architecture:** Preserving `ACTIN2` integrity prevents excessive root coiling and wall delamination when gravity's stabilizing vector is absent.

- **Primary Source:** Kwon T et al. (2015), *Am J Bot* 102(1): 21–35 (PubMed) | `OSD-44`.

Seedlings grown `4`, `8`, and `12` days on solid Murashige and Skoog (`MS10`) medium with **`10%` sucrose**, **`100%` hygrometry**, **`25 ± 2°C`**, **`70 μE m-2 s-1`** light, **`16 h` photoperiod**.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Col-0 Horizontal Squad (`μg` Clinostat):** Columbia root divers strapped to a horizontal rotating wheel—experiencing a continuously averaged gravity vector across `4`, `8`, and `12` days under `10%` sucrose and `100%` humidity.

- **Col-0 Vertical Guard (`1G` Clinostat):** Mirror squad spinning on a *vertical* clinostat—absorbing the same mechanical rotation and motor vibration while keeping Earth's `1g` vector aligned down the plate.

- **Cy5 (Red) & Cy3 (Green) Dye-Swap Twins:** Dual-channel cDNA couriers (`635 nm` at `30%` laser vs. `532 nm` at `35%` laser) who swap uniforms on every paired CATMA slide (`R1`/`R2` dye-swaps) so print-tip and dye biases cancel out under LOESS normalization.

- **The Unclaimed Archive (Metadata Quirk):** Unlike `OSD-7` through `OSD-44`, `OSD-45` has **no linked publication** in OSDR—leaving raw and LOESS-normalized `.gpr` log-ratios (`Ch1/Ch2`) as an open, unmined dossier for future bioinformaticians.

- **Page 30:** Final panel: the two clinostat wheels slowing to a halt in monochrome ink.

### Page 31 (Mission Debrief — Biological & Technical Summary)

- **Header:** `OSD-45 MISSION DEBRIEF: HORIZONTAL VS. VERTICAL CLINOSTAT ROOT TIMECOURSE`

- **Panel A — Experimental Design:** *Arabidopsis* `Col-0` roots grown `4`, `8`, and `12` days on solid `MS10` + `10%` sucrose at `100%` hygrometry (`25 ± 2°C`, `16 h` light at `70 μE m-2 s-1`) on a **horizontal clinostat (`μg`)** vs. **vertical clinostat (`1G` control)** (`OSD-45`).

- **Panel B — Dye-Swap Rigor:** `6` paired `Cy3/Cy5` dye-swaps (`2` biological replicates ×\times× `3` timepoints = `12` **CATMA** arrays, `GSM973422–GSM973433`) processed with `GenePix Pro 3.0`, `-100` spot filtering, **LOESS** normalization, and metablock print-tip median subtraction.

- **Panel C — Archival Status:** Submitted via `GEO:GSE39631` (2012) with **no linked primary publication** in OSDR—preserving raw `.gpr` and normalized `log2(Cy5/Cy3)` tables as an open resource for time-resolved clinostat vs. spaceflight meta-analyses.

### Page 32 (Mission Debrief — BLSS Implications & Citation)

- **BLSS Engineering Takeaway:**

  - **Ground Analog Calibration:** Pairing horizontal and vertical clinostats controls for mechanical rotation/shear, isolating gravity-vector randomization—essential for pre-flight screening before expensive ISS runs.

  - **Multi-Timepoint Root Tracking:** Capturing `4d`, `8d`, and `12d` separates early germination/establishment shifts from mature root-architecture remodeling.

- **Primary Source:** `OSD-45` (`GLDS-45` / `GEO:GSE39631` / `DOI: 10.26030/rdt0-yx94`).

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume Title:** *Vol. 10 — The Iron Track and the False Dawn*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-46` (`GLDS-46` | Version 6 | Submitted `17-Sep-2014` | Released `18-Sep-2014` | `DOI: 10.26030/gvz9-3b88` | GEO/ArrayExpress: `GSE61484` / `E-GEOD-61484`)

- **Primary Publication(s):**

  - Missirian V, Conklin PA, Culligan KM, Huefner ND, Britt AB (2014). *High atomic weight, high-energy radiation (HZE) induces transcriptional responses shared with conventional stresses in addition to a core "DSB" response specific to clastogenic treatments.* *Frontiers in Plant Science* `5:364` (`PMC4117989` | `PubMed 25136344` | `DOI: 10.3389/fpls.2014.00364`).

  - Corrigendum (2016). *Frontiers in Plant Science* `7:1753` (`Frontiers Corrigendum` | `DOI: 10.3389/fpls.2016.01753` | `PMID: 27877191` — replaced the placeholder `[GSEXXXX]` in the original 2014 manuscript with `[GSE61484]`).

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* ecotype Wassilewskija (`Ws`) Wild Type (`WT`) and **`atm-1`** (T-DNA insertion mutant defective in the DSB-sensing protein kinase `ATM`), 5-day-old seedlings (6 days old by the `24 h` harvest).

- **Hardware & Conditions (Ground Space-Radiation Simulation at Brookhaven National Laboratory):**

  - Seeds (`20%` bleach-sterilized) plated on `1 × MS` Phytoagar, shipped on ice to BNL (`4°C`), then grown vertically 5 days at `21°C` under `16 h` cool white light in the BNL Controlled Environment Facility.

  - **Gamma Treatment:** `100 Gy` gamma photons over `15 min` (`7 Gy/min`, average LET `0.2 keV/μ`) at BNL's **Controlled Environment Radiation Facility** (completed `8:40 am`).

  - **HZE Treatment:** `30 Gy` of relativistic `1 GeV/n` `56Fe` (`Fe26+`) nuclei over `~12 min` (`7 Gy/min`, high LET `170 keV/μ`, `~65` iron tracks per nucleus) at the **National Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL)**, executed in two staggered runs (`1:09 pm` and `1:28 pm` due to chamber space limits), followed by `~30 min` in a lighted hood for deactivation.

  - **Sampling Grid:** `WT` harvested at `1.5, 3, 6, 12, 24 h`; `atm-1` harvested at `1.5, 6, 12, 24 h` (`3 h` omitted); unirradiated `WT`/`atm-1` controls harvested only at `10:45 am` (Day 1) and `9:15 am` (Day 2). `22` conditions ×\times× `2` replicates = **`44` samples overall**.

- **Preservation & Assay:** `30–40` pooled seedlings per sample flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen (`-80°C`), extracted via `RNeasy Mini-Prep`, hybridized (`10 μg` fragmented biotin-cRNA, `16 h` at `45°C`) to **Affymetrix `ATH1` Genome Arrays**, stained with `SAPE` on `Fluidics Station 450`, scanned on `GeneChip Scanner 3000`, and normalized via `RMA`/`limma`.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **`Ws` Wild Type (`WT`):** The compact `135 Mb` vanguard—resilient enough that `100 Gy` gamma leaves roughly the same DSB count as `4 Gy` in a `3.2 Gb` human nucleus. Holds both `ATM` and `ATR` checkpoints intact.

- **`atm-1` (The Blind Sentinel):** `Ws` mutant lacking the `ATM` double-strand-break kinase. Deaf to the initial alarm at `1.5 h`, unable to mount the core `Cluster B` repair surge under `56Fe` bombardment, and strangely stripped of the `24 h` pathogen-defense wave.

- **Gamma (`100 Gy` Photon Barrage, `0.2 keV/μ`):** Diffuse Compton-scattering sniper fire. Generates scattered `2–5` radical clusters across `4–5 nm` spans and heavy replication-fork stalling (`WEE1` up, `S`-phase hyperexpression at `24 h`), allowing `ATR` to partially compensate in `atm-1`.

- **HZE (`30 Gy` `1 GeV/n` `56Fe`, `170 keV/μ`):** A relativistic iron lance punching `~65` continuous radical cylinders (`9 nm` core + `15 Gy` secondary-electron penumbra) straight through nuclei, membranes, and chloroplasts—triggering `1,169` induced transcripts at `1.5 h` (`1,009` unique to HZE).

- **The DSB Core (`Cluster B`, `424` transcripts):** `ATM`-dependent homology-repair strike team peaking at `1.5 h` in both treatments: **`BRCA1`** (`log2` `7.4` Gamma / `7.9` HZE in `WT`, collapsing to `0.6` in `atm-1` HZE), **`XRI1`** (`7.0` / `7.1`), **`RAD51`** (`5.3` / `5.4`), **`SYN2`** (`4.8` / `5.3`), **`RAD17`** (`3.6` / `5.0`), **`MND1`** (`3.9` / `4.4`), **`PARP1`** (`3.6` / `3.9`), and uncharacterized **`AT5G49110`** (human `FANCI` homolog).

- **HZE Collateral-Repair Unit (`Table 2`, `15` transcripts):** `XRCC1` (`4.0` HZE vs. `0.57` Gamma), `P-loop helicase At1g02670` (`4.9` vs. `1.2`), `RAD23-3` (`3.5` vs. `1.1`), `XPC` (`2.5` vs. `1.1`), and `LIG4` (`2.3` vs. `1.9`), summoned at `1.5 h` even in `atm-1`.

- **The Extended-Night Phantom (`Cluster A`: `1,357` up / `Cluster D`: `1,336` down):** `ATM`-independent starvation mirage triggered *only* by `56Fe` at `1.5 h` (`174` transcripts shared with extended-night starvation): `411` chloroplast genes plummet while **`PEX11a/c–e`**, **`FIS1b`**, **`DRP3a`**, fatty-acid β\betaβ-oxidation, and leucine catabolism cannibalize damaged organelles.

- **The Late Chitin Choir (`Cluster C`, `349` transcripts):** `ATM`-dependent conventional-stress / pathogen-defense wave (`31` chitin-response, `50` defense, `14` programmed-cell-death genes) that erupts at `6 h` under HZE and `24 h` under Gamma.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1**

- **Panel 1 (Splash):** Vertical agar plates of 5-day-old *Arabidopsis* `Ws` seedlings standing like emerald soldiers inside the **Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL)** growth chamber (`21°C`, cool white lamps).

  - *Caption:* `BNL CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENT FACILITY — 08:25 AM. GENOME SIZE: 135 Mb.`

- **Panel 2:** Close-up on two sister plates side by side: `WT` (`Ws`) and `atm-1`. Their roots trace straight vertical lines down `1 × MS` Phytoagar.

- **Panel 3:** Inside a meristematic nucleus, `ATM` kinase—a towering, armored radar-warden—scans the chromatin fibers of `WT`. Next to him, in `atm-1`, an empty, shattered pedestal bears a T-DNA scar.

**Page 2**

- **Panel 1:** `08:25 AM.` The **Controlled Environment Radiation Facility** door seals. Gamma emitter shutters slide open.

  - *SFX:* **ゴゴゴ (GOGOGO — low chamber hum)**

- **Panel 2:** `100 Gy` over `15 minutes` (`7 Gy/min`). Invisible gamma photons rain through the agar, scattering Compton electrons in erratic, sparkling zigzags.

  - *Dialogue (`ATM`):* *"Low-LET scatter. Two to five radicals per cluster. They're peppering the replication forks."*

- **Panel 3:** `08:40 AM.` The gamma run ends. Across the BNL campus, the **National Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL)** accelerator tunnel charges for the afternoon beamline.

**Page 3**

- **Panel 1:** `1:09 PM` and `1:28 PM`—two cramped beamline runs at **NSRL**, forced by chamber space limits. A beam of relativistic `1 GeV/n` `56Fe` (`Fe26+`) nuclei tears through the plates (`30 Gy` over `~12 min`).

  - *SFX:* **ズガアアアン (ZUGAAAAN — relativistic heavy-ion impact)**

- **Panel 2:** Unlike gamma's scattered sparks, each `Fe26+` ion carves a blinding, razor-straight `9 nm` cylinder of ionization—`170 keV/μ`—with `~65` iron lances skewering every nucleus, flanked by a dimmer `15 Gy` penumbra of secondary electrons.

- **Panel 3:** `~30 minutes` under a lighted deactivation hood while induced radioactivity decays. Inside the `WT` cell, chloroplasts flicker and thylakoid membranes smoke along the iron tracks.

**Page 4**

- **Panel 1:** `10:10 AM` (Gamma `1.5 h`) and `2:39 PM` (HZE `1.5 h`). Because unirradiated controls were only drawn at `10:45 AM` (Day 1) and `9:15 AM` (Day 2), a circadian filter sweeps across the transcriptome, erasing `586` clock-driven and `685` diurnal-drift transcripts (`85` overlapping) from the battle map.

- **Panel 2:** In `WT`, the alarm explodes. **`WEE1`** kinase leaps higher in Gamma-hit cells than in HZE-hit cells, bracing stalled `S`-phase forks against premature differentiation.

- **Panel 3:** Meanwhile, `Cluster B` (`424` transcripts) detonates simultaneously in both Gamma and HZE `WT` nuclei—the **Core DSB Strike Team**.

**Page 5**

- **Panel 1:** **`BRCA1`** (`log2` `7.4` Gamma / `7.9` HZE) and **`XRI1`** (`7.0` / `7.1`) drop from the nuclear ceiling in heavy ubiquitin-rigged harnesses.

  - *Dialogue (`BRCA1`):* *"Both fronts are breached! Homologous recombination—deploy!"*

- **Panel 2:** **`RAD51`** (`5.3` / `5.4`), **`MND1`** (`3.9` / `4.4`), and **`AHP2`** (`3.2` / `4.0`) braid around resected single-stranded tails, while **`SYN2`** (`4.8` / `5.3`) clamps sister chromatids together.

- **Panel 3:** Behind them, **`PARP1`** (`3.6` / `3.9`), **`RAD17`** (`3.6` / `5.0`), **`RPA1E`** (`4.2` / `4.8`), and **`RECQL3`** (`3.1` / `4.1`) lock down the chromatin perimeter; **`AT5G49110`**—a silent recruit wearing a human `FANCI` badge—steps into the breach.

**Page 6**

- **Panel 1:** Cut to the `atm-1` mutant at `1.5 h`. Under `100 Gy` Gamma, `BRCA1` (`3.3`), `XRI1` (`2.5`), and `RAD51` (`1.6`) still limp onto the field—summoned by `ATR` sensing Gamma's replication-fork stress.

- **Panel 2:** Under `30 Gy` HZE in `atm-1`, the comms are dead. `BRCA1` (`0.6`), `RAD51` (`0.3`), `MND1` (`-0.1`), and `TK1A` (`-0.2`) never answer the call.

  - *Caption:* `HZE'S 15 Gy PENUMBRA TRIGGERS TOO LITTLE REPLICATION STRESS TO WAKE ATR. WITHOUT ATM, THE CORE DSB TEAM IS PARALYZED.`

**Page 7**

- **Panel 1:** Yet `WT` HZE cells are not fighting the same war as Gamma. Out of `1,169` transcripts induced by HZE at `1.5 h` and `280` by Gamma, only `160` overlap.

- **Panel 2:** `1,009` HZE-exclusive transcripts surge through the cytoplasm! In `Table 2`'s DNA-repair wing, **`XRCC1`** (`4.0` vs. `0.57` Gamma), **`P-loop helicase At1g02670`** (`4.9` vs. `1.2`), **`RAD23-3`** (`3.5` vs. `1.1`), **`XPC`** (`2.5` vs. `1.1`), and **`LIG4`** (`2.3` vs. `1.9`) scramble to patch clustered lesions and oxidized bases—even inside `atm-1`.

**Page 8**

- **Panel 1:** Suddenly, the lights inside the `WT` and `atm-1` HZE cells seem to go out—even though the BNL growth chamber lamps are blazing at `2:39 PM`.

  - *SFX:* **バチィン (BACHIIN — metabolic circuit breaker tripping)**

- **Panel 2:** `Cluster D` (`1,336` transcripts) crashes downward—`411` **Chloroplast** genes (`FDR 7e-37`) go dark at once, alongside `42` amine-biosynthesis and `59` carboxylic-acid-biosynthesis genes.

- **Panel 3:** Across the cytosol, `Cluster A` (`1,357` transcripts) ignites in an `ATM`-independent wave.

  - *Dialogue (`PEX11c`):* *"Sugar's gone—or the power plants are slag. Either way, it's Extended Night!"*

**Page 9**

- **Panel 1:** `174` of `230` classic **Extended Night** starvation transcripts flare to life (`1.5–3 h` post-HZE), completely absent in `100 Gy` Gamma and `BLM+MMC`.

- **Panel 2:** **`PEX11a`**, **`PEX11c–e`**, **`FIS1b`**, and **`DRP3a`** slice elongated peroxisomes into multiplying fleets of demolition drones.

- **Panel 3:** Fatty-acid β\betaβ-oxidation enzymes and leucine-catabolism squads begin dismantling lipids and damaged proteins (`68` protein-catabolism genes) to keep the starved or battered cell alive.

**Page 10**

- **Panel 1:** In `Cluster E` (`1,248` transcripts), `S`-phase and `M`-phase cyclins are slammed into lockdown across both radiations—except **`CYCB1;1`**, standing alone like a glowing flare over arrested meristems.

- **Panel 2:** Root tips halt their downward march in `1 × MS` Phytoagar. Two completely different architectures of damage now confront the same `135 Mb` genome.

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Pages 11–12 (Double-Page Spread — *The Two Geometries of Ruin*)**

- **Left Page (Gamma `100 Gy`):** A wide-angle battlefield of `WT` chromatin under a hail of Compton electrons. Scattered `4–5 nm` radical bursts stall replication forks everywhere; **`WEE1`** and **`ATR`** reinforce `ATM`, keeping `BRCA1` and `RAD51` active while chloroplasts hum untouched in full daylight.

- **Right Page (HZE `30 Gy` `1 GeV/n` `56Fe`):** A catastrophic, diagonal iron-ion scar (`170 keV/μ`) bisects the entire page—cleaving DNA helices into co-located multiply damaged sites, shattering membranes, and blacking out chloroplasts. **`ATM`** desperately coordinates `BRCA1`/`RAD51` along the core track while **`PEX11`/`FIS1b`/`DRP3a`** peroxisomes swarm the wreckage in a false-dawn starvation frenzy.

  - *SFX:* **バリバリバリ (BARIBARIBARI — continuous track ionization & organelle fission)**

**Page 13**

- **Panel 1:** `3 h` post-irradiation (`11:40 AM` Gamma / `4:09 PM` HZE). `WT` plates are harvested into liquid nitrogen; in the `atm-1` wing, the `3 h` rack sits empty—an intentional sampling omission that leaves `atm-1`'s intermediate kinetics invisible.

- **Panel 2:** By `6 h` (`7:24 PM` HZE), the `Extended Night` mirage begins to recede in HZE-treated seedlings, replaced by a strange new drumbeat from `Cluster C` (`349` transcripts).

**Page 14**

- **Panel 1:** `Cluster C`—**The Late Chitin Choir**—marshals `31` chitin-response genes, `50` defense-response genes, and `14` programmed-cell-death executors.

- **Panel 2:** In HZE, `Cluster C` already crests at `6 h` and `12 h`, echoing cold, salt, wounding, UV-B, and *Pseudomonas syringae* infection. In Gamma, `Cluster C` stays silent at `6 h` and waits until `24 h` to erupt.

- **Panel 3:** Stranger still: in `atm-1`, `Cluster C` is silenced—completely in Gamma, and by half in HZE.

  - *Caption:* `A KINASE KNOWN ONLY FOR DNA BREAKS IS GOVERNING THE PLANT'S CONVENTIONAL STRESS AND CELL-DEATH PROGRAM.`

**Page 15**

- **Panel 1:** `12 h` (`8:40 PM` Gamma / `1:09 AM` Day 2 HZE). Night has truly fallen in the BNL chamber.

- **Panel 2:** Inside `WT` Gamma nuclei, `BRCA1` and `RAD51` transcripts have largely wound down; `S`-phase transcripts are quietly gathering at an intra-`S` checkpoint.

- **Panel 3:** Inside `WT` HZE nuclei, complex clustered lesions along the `65` iron tracks still smolder, keeping `Cluster C`'s defense signals humming through the dark.

**Page 16**

- **Panel 1:** `24 h` (`8:40 AM` Day 2 Gamma / `1:09 PM` Day 2 HZE). Unirradiated Day-2 controls are harvested at `9:15 AM`.

- **Panel 2:** In Gamma-irradiated `WT`, `S`-phase transcripts suddenly **hyperexpress** in a partially `ATM`-dependent surge—cells released from their `S`-phase bottleneck flooding forward together.

- **Panel 3:** In HZE-irradiated `WT`, `S`- and `M`-phase transcripts return nearly to baseline, while `Cluster C`'s pathogen-defense wave peaks in Gamma at `24 h`—a full `18 hours` behind HZE.

**Page 17–22 (Montage of the `DSB` Signature vs. Conventional Stress)**

- **Pages 17–18:** Side-by-side comparison panels against the `AtGenExpress` stress atlas: `Paraquat` floods the cell with superoxide ROS, yet `Cluster B` (`BRCA1`, `RAD51`, `XRI1`) refuses to budge—proving ROS alone does not trigger the `DSB` core.

- **Pages 19–20:** Only `Bleomycin + Mitomycin C` (and faintly `UV-B` and `Hydroxyurea` via replication blocks) awaken the same `ATM`-dependent `DSB` squad.

- **Pages 21–22:** Meanwhile, `72` of the `160` shared `1.5 h` transcripts flash human homolog badges (`e-value < 1e-6`), linking *Arabidopsis* `AT5G49110` (`FANCI`) and `BRCA1`-centric repair directly to human `1 GeV` `56Fe` fibroblast responses.

**Page 23**

- **Panel 1:** `30–40` whole seedlings per condition are plucked from `1 × MS` Phytoagar and plunged into liquid nitrogen (`-80°C`).

  - *SFX:* **シュウウウ (SHUUU — LN2 flash-freeze)**

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume Title:** *Vol. 11 — The Single-Cell Compass*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-57` (`GLDS-57` | Version 2 | Submitted `28-Jan-2016` | Initial Release `21-Mar-2016` | Metadata Update `31-Aug-2024` | `DOI: 10.25966/b9jj-pp51` | Source Accession: `PRJNA168519`)

- **Primary Publication(s):**

  - Bushart TJ, Cannon AE, Ul Haque A, San Miguel P, Mostajeran K, Clark GB, Porterfield DM, Roux SJ (2013). *RNA-seq analysis identifies potential modulators of gravity response in spores of Ceratopteris (Parkeriaceae): evidence for modulation by calcium pumps and apyrase activity.* *American Journal of Botany* `100(1):161–174` (`PubMed 23048014` | `DOI: 10.3732/ajb.1200292`, Epub `9-Oct-2012`).

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Ceratopteris richardii* (aquatic homosporous fern, Parkeriaceae), cultivar **`Hn-n`**, germinating single-celled **spores**.

- **Hardware & Conditions (Ground Study — NASA Kennedy Space Center / SLPS; PI: Stanley J. Roux, Co-I: Greg Clark):**

  - Surface-sterilized spores soaked in sterile water in the dark at `29°C` for `5–7 days` to synchronize germination, then exposed to **continuous light for `10 hours`** on `1/2-strength MS` basal salts (`0.5%` agar) in `100 × 15 mm` plastic Petri dishes.

  - **`10 h` Developmental Anchor:** The exact window when gravity fixes the downward polarity alignment of the emerging rhizoid via a trans-cell `Ca2+` current (previously shown to be blocked by nifedipine).

  - **Archival Sample Quirk (`n = 1`):** `Group-1.Subject-1.spores` is a single pooled `10 h` reference sample (`~29 μg` total RNA), paired with pharmacological perturbation assays (`BHQ`, `PPADS`, `ATPγS`) rather than a multi-condition RNA-Seq contrast.

- **Preservation & Assay:** Frozen at `-80°C` at `10 h` post-light exposure; spores ruptured on a **Retsch MM300 bead mill** (max speed, two `2-min` intervals, checked by bright-field microscopy); `Poly(A)Purist` + `SMARTer PCR` cDNA synthesis; sequenced at Purdue University Genomics Core Facility on a **Roche 454 GS FLX Titanium Series** (`1` full + `1` half + `1` quarter plate = **`958,527` reads**, **`266,316,412` total bases**), *de novo* assembled with **Newbler**.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **The `Hn-n` Spore:** A lone, armored single cell—our first non-flowering plant protagonist in the series—carrying neither root cap nor statolith-packed columella, yet capable of reading Earth's gravity vector within `10 hours` of dawn.

- **Trans-Cell `Ca2+` Current:** An inward-at-the-bottom, outward-at-the-top calcium flux across the spore, previously known to steer rhizoid emergence downward unless silenced by nifedipine.

- **Endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase Pumps:** Quiet intracellular custodians sequestering cytosolic `Ca2+` into internal stores. When sabotaged by **`2,5-di-(t-butyl)-1,4-hydroquinone` (`BHQ`)**, they paradoxically weaken the trans-cell current while *sharpening* the spore's gravity alignment.

- **Extracellular ATP (`eATP`) & Purinoceptor:** A glowing nucleotide tide pooling outside the spore during polarization; blocked by **`350 μM` `PPADS`** or drowned by **`150 μM` `ATPγS`**, leaving the spore blind to "down."

- **Apyrase:** The ecto-enzyme gatekeeper trimming `eATP` levels at the cell surface so the nucleotide gradient stays crisp rather than saturated.

- **Ethylene-Biosynthesis & Photoreceptor Transcripts:** Supporting signalers transcribed inside the `10 h` *de novo* Newbler assembly alongside calcium-signaling modules.

- **The 454 Titanium Chronicler (`958,527` Reads):** An older, long-read pyrosequencing engine (`GS FLX Titanium`) stitching `266.3 Mb` of fern mRNA without a sequenced *Ceratopteris* reference genome.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1**

- **Panel 1 (Splash):** Pitch darkness. Hundreds of ridged, tetrahedral *Ceratopteris richardii* `Hn-n` spores drift suspended in sterile water at `29°C`.

  - *SFX:* **カッ (KA — continuous light ignition)**

**Page 2**

- **Panel 1:** `Hour 0.5 to Hour 3.` Gravity pulls across the spherical cell. Along the bottom hemisphere, `Ca2+` ions begin streaming inward while exiting at the crown—a living electrical compass.

  - *Dialogue (`Trans-Cell Ca2+ Current`):* *"Hold the vector. Ten hours until polarity locks."*

- **Panel 2:** Flashback panel: a drop of **nifedipine** clogs the plasma-membrane `Ca2+` channels; the current flatlines, and the spore forgets which way to send its rhizoid.

- **Panel 3:** `Hour 10.` The critical fixation threshold. Downward polarity is about to be engraved into the cytoskeleton—and at this exact instant, the `-80°C` freezer door slams shut.

- **Panel 3:** On the **454 GS FLX Titanium**, one full plate, one half plate, and one quarter plate ignite in pyrosequencing flashes—`958,527` reads totaling `266,316,412` bases, assembled *de novo* by **Newbler** with zero reference genome to lean on.

**Pages 4–10 (Inside the `10 h` Transcriptome)**

- **Pages 4–5:** The *de novo* map unfolds across the spore cytoplasm: light-receptive photoreceptors at the roof, **ethylene-biosynthesis** transcripts humming near the cortex, and a dense web of **calcium-signaling** transcripts around the ER.

- **Pages 6–7:** Deep in the endomembrane labyrinth, **Endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase Pumps** hum steadily, pumping cytosolic `Ca2+` back into internal reservoirs.

  - *Dialogue (`Ca2+`-ATPase Pump):* *"Every spike has a ceiling. We keep the cytosolic tide from drowning the signal."*

- **Pages 8–10:** Outside the plasma membrane, an unexpected glow rises from the cell wall into the `1/2 MS` agar: **`eATP`**—extracellular ATP—accumulating in the medium as the spore polarizes, guarded by membrane-bound **Apyrase** enzymes.

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Pages 11–12 (Double-Page Spread — *The Paradox of the Pump & the Tide*)**

- **Left Page (`BHQ` Challenge):** **`2,5-di-(t-butyl)-1,4-hydroquinone` (`BHQ`)** locks the endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase pumps in chains. Cytosolic `Ca2+` swells internally while the trans-cell `Ca2+` current *drops*—yet paradoxically, the spore's downward polar axis snaps **sharper** toward gravity than before!

- **Right Page (`PPADS` & `ATPγS` Ambush):** Outside the cell wall, **`350 μM` `PPADS`** slams a shield over the purinoceptor, while **`150 μM` `ATPγS`**—an unhydrolyzable counterfeit ATP—floods the medium, overwhelming **Apyrase**. Stripped of its extracellular nucleotide gradient, the spore's rhizoid spins aimlessly, losing its gravity compass.

  - *SFX:* **ザザザザ (ZAZAZA — nucleotide gradient washed out)**

**Pages 13–18 (The Two Arms of Spore Polarity)**

- **Pages 13–15:** Inside the `BHQ`-treated spore, the **Endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase** protests from its chains: *"Wait—if the trans-cell current is weaker, why did orientation *increase*?*" Cytosolic `Ca2+` retention amplifies the internal asymmetry, proving the trans-cell current isn't the whole story.

- **Pages 16–18:** Outside, **Apyrase** fights to hydrolyze excess ATP into ADP and AMP, trying to preserve a directional contrast between the bottom and top of the spore against `ATPγS`'s stubborn sulfur bond.

**Pages 19–22 (Evolutionary Echoes)**

- **Pages 19–20:** Side-by-side silhouette panels comparing *Arabidopsis* `Col-0` roots (with columella statocytes) against a single *Ceratopteris* `Hn-n` spore: `400 million` years apart, both rely on `Ca2+` and `eATP`/apyrase signaling to read gravity.

- **Pages 21–22:** The `10 h` fixation wave freezes the pharmacological battleground in place, locking the single-cell transcriptome into the Newbler contig ledger.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Pages 23–26**

- **Pages 23–24:** In `October 2012` (print `January 2013`), Bushart, Cannon, Clark, Porterfield, and Roux publish the *Ceratopteris* `10 h` spore atlas in *American Journal of Botany* (`100(1):161–174`).

- **Pages 25–26:** In `2016`, NASA GeneLab ingests the `PRJNA168519` pyrosequencing archive as **`OSD-57`** (`GLDS-57`), later updating its ISA metadata in `August 2024` (`Version 2`)—a rare **`n = 1`** single-sample foundational transcriptome in a repository built for multi-replicate contrasts.

**Pages 27–30 (Series Bridge)**

- **Pages 27–28:** A decade later (`2023`), Cannon et al. return with an amperometric biosensor to prove what `OSD-57` first glimpsed: `eATP` really does pool `7`-fold higher at the bottom of the polarizing spore.

- **Pages 29–30:** From a single fern spore on a KSC-funded ground plate, the signal jumps upward—to `27 days` of long-term spaceflight aboard the International Space Station...

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Page 31 — Spore Hardware & Sequencing Ledger

- **Header Banner:** `OSD-57 // CERATOPTERIS RICHARDII 10-HOUR SPORE TRANSCRIPTOME (n = 1)`

- **Left Column (Culture & Fixation):**

  - **Strain:** *Ceratopteris richardii* cultivar `Hn-n` (single-celled spores).

  - **Plating & Trigger:** Continuous light on `1/2 MS` + `0.5%` agar (`100 × 15 mm` Petri dishes); harvested & frozen at `-80°C` at **`10 h`** (gravity polarity-fixation window).

### Page 32 — Pharmacological & Molecular Compass

- **Top Panel (Key Transcripts Identified at `10 h`):**

  - Calcium signaling & endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase pumps; apyrases; ethylene-biosynthesis genes; light-receptive photoreceptors.

- **Bottom-Left Panel (Calcium Pump Paradox):**

  - **`BHQ`** (`2,5-di-(t-butyl)-1,4-hydroquinone`, endomembrane `Ca2+`-ATPase inhibitor) →\rightarrow→ **diminishes** trans-cell `Ca2+` current, yet **increases** gravity-directed polar axis orientation.

- **Bottom-Right Panel (Extracellular Nucleotide Compass):**

  - `eATP` accumulates in medium during spore polarization.

  - **`PPADS`** (`350 μM`, purinoceptor antagonist) or **`ATPγS`** (`150 μM`, poorly hydrolyzable ATP) →\rightarrow→ **decreases** gravity-directed polarization, implicating **apyrase** and `eATP` gradients as gravity-response modulators.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume Title:** *Vol. 12 — The Over-Watered Greenhouse*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-59` (`GLDS-59` | Version 5 | Submitted `12-May-2014` | Initial Release `12-May-2014` | Updated `07-Oct-2021` | `DOI: 10.26030/4w3q-hk88` | Source Accession: `PRJDB2020`)

- **Primary Publication(s):**

  - Sugimoto M, Oono Y, Gusev O, Matsumoto T, Yazawa T, Levinskikh MA, Sychev VN, Bingham G, Wheeler R, Hummerick M (2014). *Genome-wide expression analysis of reactive oxygen species gene network in Mizuna plants grown in long-term spaceflight.* *BMC Plant Biology* `14:4` (`PubMed 24393219` | `DOI: 10.1186/1471-2229-14-4`).

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Brassica rapa* var. *nipposinica* (**Mizuna**), leaf tissue (`27 days` cultivation).

- **Hardware & Conditions (ISS Expedition 22, `11/30/2009–03/18/2010`; Payload `Lada-VPU-P3R`):**

  - Cultivated in the **Lada** greenhouse aboard the **Zvezda** module of the International Space Station (ISS) under `24 h` cool-white fluorescent light (`125–250 μmol m^-2 s^-1` PAR).

  - **Zvezda Flight Environment:** `24.3 ± 0.8°C`, `3.27 ± 0.46 mmHg ppCO2` (`4,303 ± 605 ppm CO2`), `40.7 ± 6.9% RH`; total absorbed radiation dose **`8.37 mGy`**. Ground Control matched at `24.5 ± 0.5°C`, `4,254 ± 566 ppm CO2`, `41.2 ± 2.6% RH`.

  - **The Over-Watering Incident:** Two arcillite substrates were flown (`15 g` `14-14-14 Osmocote` vs. `14 g` custom `Nutricote`, `85%` moisture setpoint). One root module's pump failed to shut off at `85%`, dumping **nearly `2 liters` of water in `35 hours`**. Automatic watering was disabled and switched to **manual operation** in both flight and ground controls; **only the `Osmocote` manually watered modules** were sequenced here.

- **Preservation & Assay:** Harvested at `27 days`, frozen at **`-80°C` in `MELFI`** (Destiny module), returned at **`< -20°C` in `GLACIER`** aboard the Space Shuttle. `RNeasy Plant Mini kit` →\rightarrow→ `TruSeq RNA` (`mRNA enrichment`, `100-bp` paired-end, unstranded) on **Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx** (`FLT`: `37,248,177` reads, `DRR013834`; `GC`: `37,792,960` reads, `DRR013833`).

  - **Archival Quirk (`n = 2` Pooled Libraries):** `1` pooled Flight sample vs. `1` pooled Ground Control sample; GeneLab (`STAR 2.7.3a` / `RSEM 1.3.1` on *B. rapa* `1.0` Ensembl `43`) provides raw counts only and omits differential-expression calls due to lack of biological replicates.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Mizuna (`Brassica rapa` var. `nipposinica`):** A leafy *Brassicaceae* cousin of *Arabidopsis* (`37.2 M` flight reads vs. `37.8 M` ground reads) that looks phenotypically unbothered after `27 days` in orbit—even as `22,428` of its transcripts (`8,258` up, `14,170` down) rewrite their orders.

- **The `Lada` Pump & `85%` Sensor:** A rogue hardware subsystem in Zvezda that locks open for `35 hours`, flooding one root module with `~2 L` of water and forcing human cosmonauts and astronauts into manual-watering mode.

- **`RbohD` & `RbohF` (The NADPH Oxidase Twins):** Plasma-membrane ROS generators that deliberately fire superoxide bursts in orbit, turning microgravity and `8.37 mGy` cosmic radiation into an internal chemical alarm.

- **`MEKK1–MKK4–MPK3` & `OXI1` (The MAPK Relay):** Phosphorylation couriers carrying the oxidative distress signal into the nucleus, where `MEKK1–MKK4–MPK3` ignites **`WRKY22`**.

- **`Zat12` (The Dual-Blade Regulator):** A zinc-finger tactician that simultaneously **induces `WRKY25`** and **represses `ZAT7`** to keep the stress response calibrated rather than suicidal.

- **Thioredoxin, Glutaredoxin & Alternative Oxidase (`AOX`):** The ROS-scavenging vanguard and mitochondrial bypass valve soaking up excess radicals so Mizuna leaves stay lush and edible across `27` continuous days of `24 h` light.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1**

- **Panel 1 (Splash):** Inside the **Zvezda** module of the International Space Station during **Expedition 22** (`November 2009 – March 2010`), the twin chambers of the **Lada** greenhouse glow under `24-hour` cool-white fluorescent lamps.

  - *Caption:* `ISS ZVEZDA MODULE // LADA-VPU-P3R. 24.3°C. 4,303 PPM CO2. CONTINUOUS LIGHT.`

- **Panel 2:** `10–15` *Brassica rapa* var. *nipposinica* (Mizuna) seeds rest in Turface arcillite granules—one root module packed with `15 g` `14-14-14 Osmocote`, its twin packed with `14 g` custom `Nutricote`.

- **Panel 3:** The moisture controller targets `85%`. Water beads weightlessly through the porous arcillite.

**Page 2**

- **Panel 1:** Emergency red light on the Lada control module! A moisture sensor sticks; the pump refuses to stop at `85%`.

  - *SFX:* **ブオオオオ (BUOOOO — runaway water pump)**

- **Panel 2:** Over `35 hours`, nearly **`2 liters`** of water flood into the failing root module—an orbital flash flood in zero-G!

- **Panel 3:** A crew hand throws the override switch, killing automatic watering. From this hour on, both ISS flight and KSC ground controls run on **manual watering**—and only the `Osmocote` chambers survive as clean, matched comparators.

**Page 3**

- **Panel 1:** `Day 1 to Day 27.` Mizuna's serrated emerald leaves unfurl under `125–250 μmol m^-2 s^-1` PAR, soaking up `8.37 mGy` of cosmic radiation while `4,303 ppm` cabin `CO2` bathes every stoma.

- **Panel 2:** On the outside, the ISS leaves look identical to the ground controls in Florida.

- **Panel 3:** Inside the leaf mesophyll, however, the air is thick with invisible sparks—reactive oxygen species (`ROS`) drifting off photosystems and membranes.

**Pages 4–10 (The `20/32` Oxidative Awakening)**

- **Pages 4–5:** Along the plasma membrane, **`RbohD`** and **`RbohF`** flare to life—NADPH oxidases purposefully pumping ROS into the apoplast as a long-range distress beacon.

- **Pages 6–7:** **`20` of `32` ROS oxidative marker genes** light up across the leaf transcriptome, led by `4` blazing hallmark sentinels.

- **Pages 8–10:** **`OXI1`** and **`MEKK1`** intercept the oxidative surge, passing the baton down **`MKK4`** to **`MPK3`** as Mizuna's leaf cells brace for `27` days without night or gravity.

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Pages 11–12 (Double-Page Spread — *The Reprogrammed Canopy*)**

- **Left Page (The Signal Cascade):** **`MEKK1–MKK4–MPK3`** and **`OXI1–MKK4–MPK3`** tear through the nucleus, unlocking **`WRKY22`**. Beside them, **`Zat12`** raises twin blades—raising **`WRKY25`** high while pinning **`ZAT7`** to the floor in transcriptional repression.

- **Right Page (The Scavenger Shield):** Across chloroplasts and mitochondria, **Thioredoxin**, **Glutaredoxin**, and **Alternative Oxidase (`AOX`)** unfurl like shimmering cooling fins, neutralizing runaway peroxides and diverting excess electrons before they can scorch the leaves.

  - *Caption:* `8,258 TRANSCRIPTS UP. 14,170 DOWN. ZERO VISIBLE WILTING.`

**Pages 13–18 (Acclimation vs. Alarm)**

- **Pages 13–15:** **`AOX`** stands at the mitochondrial inner membrane, bleeding off electron pressure under `24-hour` continuous light and `4,303 ppm CO2` so the respiratory chain doesn't choke on its own ROS.

- **Pages 16–18:** **Thioredoxin** and **Glutaredoxin** patrol the stroma, resetting disulfide bonds on Calvin-cycle enzymes—explaining why Mizuna grows just as vigorously in Zvezda as on Earth.

**Pages 19–22 (The Space-Exclusive Cohort)**

- **Pages 19–21:** Some transcripts on the battlefield wear familiar abiotic/biotic stress armor; others carry no terrestrial badge at all—genes preferentially awakened *only* by the spaceflight combination of microgravity, `8.37 mGy` radiation, and stagnant boundary layers.

- **Page 22:** `Day 27.` The Zvezda harvest shears close around the crisp Mizuna leaves.
