## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **`Col-0` (The Over-Reactive Strategist):** Mounts a massive **`297`-DEG** response in dim ISS light—`217` of which turn out to be completely unnecessary for surviving spaceflight.

- **`WS` (The Minimalist Veteran):** Naturally carries a `PHYD` deletion; adapts to Destiny's dim light with only **`71` DEGs** (and equal root length to `Col-0`), yet erupts into **`218` DEGs** when plunged into orbital darkness.

- **`phyD` (`SALK_027956C`):** `Col-0` stripped of a single red/far-red shade-avoidance sensor (`Phytochrome D`). Instantly sheds nearly two-thirds of `Col-0`'s light-grown transcriptional baggage (`297` →\rightarrow→ `130` DEGs) without losing a millimeter of root growth.

- **`ATARD3` (`AT2G26400`, Acireductone Dioxygenase 3):** The lone survivor—the **single gene** coordinately expressed across all `3` genotypes in *both* Light (`18`-gene core) and Dark (`11`-gene core).

- **The Cell-Wall Guild (`14–17%` of every genotype's unique DEGs):** Different individual genes per genotype, yet always occupying the same `14–17%` architectural share of the response.

- **Steve Swanson's `iPad3` (`iOS 5.1.1`):** Improvised photon-scout bridging the Destiny module wall and KSC's `ISSES` chamber in the absence of a standard ISS light meter.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1**

**Page 2**

- **Panel 2:** Inside the Phytagel, `Col-0`, `WS`, and `Col-0 phyD` (`SALK_027956C`) germinate.

- **Panel 3:** On the ISS wall, roots abandon straight vertical tracks and curl into loose, unorganized coils across the gel, while hypocotyls lean away from the shaded bulkhead toward the dim cabin lights.

**Pages 3–10 (Three Genotypes, One Root-Length Verdict)**

- **Pages 3–5:** Days `3, 6, 9, 11`. Nikon shutters click on orbit; Panasonic shutters click at KSC—often shooting through the *back* of the Petri dishes to dodge lid condensation.

- **Pages 6–8:** Inside the `2 mm` light-grown root tips, `Col-0` sounds a frantic **297-gene** general alarm—flooding oxidative-stress, hormone, and defense channels.

- **Pages 9–10:** Right beside it, **`phyD`** (`130` DEGs) and **`WS`** (`71` DEGs) glide along the exact same Phytagel at the exact same root length (`F2,310 = 12.112`, no orbital difference among genotypes!).

  - *Dialogue (`WS` to `Col-0`):* *"You're burning two hundred extra transcripts just to grow the same two millimeters."*

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Pages 11–12 (Double-Page Spread — *The Cost of Listening to the Wrong Signal*)**

- **Left Page (`Col-0` Light-Grown Root Tip — `297` DEGs):** A chaotic war room packed with `217` dispensable transcripts—defense sirens blaring, ROS alarms flashing, auxin/ABA/GA couriers colliding in `4–6 μmol m^-2 s^-1` twilight.

- **Right Page (`phyD` `130` DEGs & `WS` `71` DEGs):** A stripped-down, quiet command deck. Without `Phytochrome D` misinterpreting microgravity's dim light cues, `phyD` and `WS` bypass two-thirds of the panic while keeping their **`14–17%` Cell-Wall Remodeling** engineers steadily at work.

  - *SFX:* **シーン (SHIIN — quiet, streamlined transcriptional silence)**

**Pages 13–18 (The Dark Flip)**

- **Pages 13–15:** Cut to the Duvetyne-wrapped **Dark** plates (`1 mm` root tips, `461` total DEGs across genotypes). Now the tables turn: stripped of ambient light cues, **`WS`** suddenly spikes to **`218` DEGs** (nearly matching `Col-0`'s **`224`**), while **`phyD`** stays leanest at **`131` DEGs**.

- **Pages 16–18:** In the dark, hormone-metabolism (`auxin`, `ABA`, `GA`) and gravitropism genes crowd the floor, while `11` light-grown and `17` dark-grown genes even flip in *opposite* directions between genotypes.

**Pages 19–22 (The `18`, the `11`, and the One)**

- **Pages 19–20:** Venn circles converge: `18` shared genes in Light (`7` light-signaling genes down; `11` defense/cell-wall genes up) vs. `11` shared genes in Dark (`1` methionine-biosynthesis gene down; `10` up).

- **Pages 21–22:** Between the two circles stands a single, solitary figure wearing both Light and Dark badges: **`ATARD3` (`AT2G26400`, Acireductone Dioxygenase 3)**—the *only* gene coordinately regulated across every genotype and both light regimes.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Pages 23–25**

- **Page 23:** Day `11` harvest: seedlings are sealed into **KFTs** with `RNAlater` (`12–18 h` ambient perfusion), frozen in **`MELFI`** (`-80°C`), and returned aboard Dragon (`May 18, 2014`) via Long Beach charter plane, JSC dry ice, and FedEx to KSC and UF.

**Pages 26–30 (Archival Epilogue & Series Bridge)**

- **Pages 26–27:** In `June 2017`, Paul & Ferl publish `CARA` in *PLOS ONE*: much of the plant spaceflight transcriptome is **dispensable**—and knocking out a single light sensor (`phyD`) lowers the transcriptional tax of orbit.

- **Pages 28–29:** Years later (`2025`), machine-learning pipeline **`GLARE`** re-mines `OSD-120`, uncovering latent hypoxic signatures alongside cell-wall remodeling.

- **Page 30:** Leaving `CARA`'s Destiny bulkhead behind, the OSDR sequence advances to the next botanical frontier...

- **Header Banner:** `OSD-120 // CARA ("PETRI PLANTS") — SPACEX CRS-3 (n = 36 RNA-SEQ / 90 TOTAL ROWS)`

- **Top Panel (Light-Grown Spaceflight DEGs, `394` total, `FDR < 0.05`, `|log2FC| >= 1`):**

- **Bottom-Left Panel (Dark-Grown Spaceflight DEGs, `461` total):**

- **Bottom-Right Panel (Key Takeaway):**

  - **Root Growth:** Equal across all `3` genotypes on orbit (`F2,310 = 12.112`).

  - **Universal Gene:** Only **`ATARD3` (`AT2G26400`)** is coordinately expressed across all `3` genotypes in both Light and Dark; **cell-wall remodeling** (`14–17%` of unique DEGs) is the unifying functional category.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Ler-0 Shoot ("Lans"):** Etiolated *Arabidopsis* `Ler-0` hypocotyl and cotyledon team from Canister `F` (`PDFU 2–4`). Unlike its `Col-0` neighbors in `BRIC-16-Reg` and `BRIC-16-DNA`, Lans is dissected away from its roots before RNA extraction—speaking purely for the shoot.

- **AGP31 (`AT1G28290`):** An arabinogalactan scaffolding protein surging `+22.97`-fold (`RMA`) to `+23.44`-fold (`MAS5`) in flight shoots, frantically reinforcing a rounding, loosening cell wall.

- **The Xyloglucan Cutters (`XTH32`, `XTH9`, `GH9C2`):** Wall-remodeling enzymes (`+3.19` to `+12.92`-fold across normalizations) cleaving hemicellulose cross-links while **Xylan-3–7** and **HG/RG-I Pectic Backbones** thin out in the 155-antibody ELISA screen.

- **XERO1 (`AT3G50980`):** The water-stress dehydrin—downregulated a staggering **`-268.27`-fold** in `BRIC-16-Cyt` flight shoots (and `-6.07`-fold in `BRIC-16-DNA`), proving that in dark `BRIC` canisters, microgravity shoots feel *less* drought stress than Earth-bound controls.

- **HSFA2 (`AT2G26150`) & The Adventitious Roots:** The hypoxia/heat-shock factor downregulated in flight shoots while hypocotyl-sprouting adventitious roots act like emergency snorkels.

- **The Shredder-Column Ghost (CCRC 155-mAb Panel):** The microscopic cell-wall residue left behind after RNA extraction—rescued from the trash by Michael Hahn and Sivakumar Pattathil's zero-waste `4 M KOH` ELISA.

- *Caption:* "Zero shared transcripts across all three. Only `XERO1` bridges `Cyt` and `DNA`."

**Page 18 — The Mirror-Image Six**

- *Panel 1:* Six genes bridge `BRIC-16-Cyt` and `BRIC-16-Reg` (`GDSL`, `AT1G75280`, `AT2G22510`, `AT2G38390`, `ATEXPA4`, `AT4G24780`)—but their arrows point in **opposite** directions!

- *Panel 2:* Up `+5.41` to `+12.98`-fold in `Cyt` shoots; down `-5.22` to `-8.04`-fold in `Reg` whole seedlings.

- *Lans:* "You pooled the roots with the shoots! We're two different organs!"

**Page 19 — Rescue from the Shredder Column**

- *Panel 1:* Back in the lab, a gloved hand pulls the spent `RNeasy` shredder column from the biohazard bin.

- *Panel 2:* "Zero waste." At the University of Georgia's CCRC, `4 M KOH` with `1%` sodium borohydride strips noncellulosic glycans from the trace shoot-wall residue.

**Page 20 — The 155-Antibody Gauntlet**

- *Panel 1:* A `96`-well ELISA grid lights up in a yellow-to-black heatmap as **155** monoclonal antibodies (`CCRC`, `JIM`, `MAC`, `BG1`, `LAMP`) probe `0.3 µg` glucose-equivalent wall extracts.

- *Panel 2:* Nonfucosylated and fucosylated xyloglucans blaze bright yellow in both flight and ground—confirming the core scaffold survived.

**Page 21 — The Missing Xylans & Pectins**

- *Panel 1:* Closer inspection of the heatmap: `xylan-3` through `xylan-7` bands dim in spaceflight shoots.

- *Panel 2:* Beside them, `HG backbone-1`, `HG backbone-2`, `RG-I backbone`, and `RG-Ic` pectic epitopes fade marginally too. The `4 M KOH` screen proves the transcriptome's prophecy: microgravity thinned the pectin–xylan network.

**Page 22 — The qRT-PCR Cross-Exam**

- *Panel 1:* At Miami University, `UBC10` (`AT5G53300`) holds the baseline steady.

- *Panel 2:* `MYB2` confirms down; `EXPA10` confirms up; `CCX2` and `XYL1` stay flat under small-`n` noise—closing the molecular case.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23 — The Two-Organ Lesson**

- *Panel 1:* Side-by-side silhouettes of `Ler-0` (dissected shoot) and `Col-0` (whole seedling). Even in identical `BRIC-PDFU` hardware on the same shuttle flight, ecotype, sowing pattern, agar vs. Phytagel, and organ pooling rewrite the gene list.

**Page 24 — Functional Convergence**

- *Panel 1:* Though individual gene IDs diverge, the Venn rings glow with shared *pathways*: cell wall remodeling, auxin signaling, defense, and downregulated water-stress responses.

**Page 25 — The Endodermal Echo**

- *Panel 1:* Petiole endodermal cells from Johnson et al. (2015) overlay the 2017 glycome heatmap—showing how reduced xylan/pectin cross-linking and upregulated `XTH`/`AGP31` translate directly into rounder, smaller shoot cells.

**Page 26 — GeneLab Reprocessing (`GLDS-121`)**

- *Panel 1:* Seven years after *STS-131* (`May 2017`), the six `.CEL` files enter NASA GeneLab as `GLDS-121` / `OSD-121` (`DOI: 10.26030/23fe-sa48`).

- *Panel 2:* In `2024` (Version 10), `NF_MAAffymetrix 1.0.5` (`oligo` RMA, `Ensembl Plants` rel. 54, `limma`) standardizes every probeset for cross-mission meta-analyses.

**Page 27 — The Zero-Waste Blueprint**

- *Panel 1:* A diagram of the dual-omics pipeline: one tiny `RNAlater`-fixed shoot enters a shredder column and exits as both an `ATH1` transcriptome and a 155-mAb cell-wall glycome.

**Page 28 — Hardware Legacy: Dark `BRIC` to `BRIC-LED`**

- *Panel 1:* The dark `BRIC-16` canister fades into blueprints for future `BRIC-LED` missions—addressing the two biggest limits of *STS-131*: total darkness and ambient `RNAlater` return.

**Page 29 — The Bioregenerative Horizon**

- *Panel 1:* Etiolated `Ler-0` shoots give way to future space-farm crops. If microgravity softens xylan–pectin networks and alters water-stress signaling, crop engineers must breed walls built for weightlessness.

**Page 30 — Closing Splash: What Remains in the Filter**

- *Panel 1 (Full-page splash):* A single `Ler-0` shoot floats inside a glowing `PDFU` cylinder, its cell wall rendered as a golden lattice of xyloglucan, xylan, and pectin threads—some freshly snipped by `XTH32`, others reinforced by `AGP31`.

- *Caption:* "Nothing wasted. Not a seed, not a shredder-column scrap, not a single `3.22 mGy` orbit."

**Pages 31–32 — Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** *(Detailed in Section 4 below.)*

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

**Page 31 (Left Spread): `BRIC-16` Three-Team Matrix & Microarray Convergence**

- **Header Banner:** `STS-131` (`BRIC-PDFU`, `309 h` Dark, `24°C`, `RNAlater` in-orbit + `53 h` post-landing, `3.22 mGy` mean TLD dose)

- **3-Column Comparison Table (`Johnson et al., 2017`, Table 4):**

  - `BRIC-16-Cyt` (Kiss): Canisters `E, F, H` | `Ler-0` | **Shoots only** | `40` seeds/1 row | `1.2%` agar + MS + `1%` sucrose | `RMA`

  - `BRIC-16-Reg` (Blancaflor): Canisters `C, D, H` | `Col-0` | Whole seedling | `150–200` seeds/rows | `1.2%` agar + MS + `1%` sucrose | `RMA`

  - `BRIC-16-DNA` (Paul/Ferl): Canisters `A, B, G` | `Col-0` | Whole seedling | `75` seeds/grid | `0.5%` Phytagel + MS | `MAS5`

- **DEG Normalization Funnel (`±5`-fold, `P < 0.01`):**

  - `PLIER`: `384` Up / `66` Down (`450` total)

  - `MAS5`: `187` Up / `121` Down (`308` total)

  - `RMA`: `71` Up / `55` Down (`126` total)

  - **Consensus Core:** `43` transcripts (`37` Up, `6` Down) across all 3 methods

- **3-Team Venn Callout:** `0` transcripts shared by all three; `1` (`XERO1`, `-268.27` `Cyt` / `-6.07` `DNA`) shared by `Cyt` & `DNA`; `6` (`GDSL`, `AT1G75280`, `AT2G22510`, `AT2G38390`, `ATEXPA4`, `AT4G24780`) shared—and **oppositely regulated**—between `Cyt` shoots (`+5.41` to `+12.98`) and `Reg` whole seedlings (`-5.22` to `-8.04`).

**Page 32 (Right Spread): Zero-Waste Glycomics & Cell-Wall Architecture**

- **Zero-Waste Pipeline Box:** `RNeasy` shredder-column shoot residue → `4 M KOH` + `1%` NaBH₄ extraction → `0.3 µg` glucose-eq/well ELISA → **155** mAbs (`CCRC`, `JIM`, `MAC`, `BG1`, `LAMP`).

- **Glycome Shift Callout:**

  - *Dominant:* Nonfucosylated & fucosylated xyloglucans (high in both `FLT` & `GC`).

  - *Reduced in Spaceflight:* **Xylan** (`xylan-3` to `-7` mAbs) and **Pectic Backbones** (`HG backbone-1/2`, `RG-I backbone`, `RG-Ic`).

- **Key Molecular Movers (`BRIC-16-Cyt`):**

  - *Wall Remodeling (Up):* `AGP31` (`+22.97` `RMA`), `GH9C2` (`+5.33`), `XTH32` (`+3.19` `RMA` / `+7.98` `MAS5`), `XTH9` (`+12.92` `PLIER`), `EXPA10` (`qRT-PCR` confirmed).

  - *Cytoskeleton (Up):* `FH2` family (`AT3G07540` `+18.66`, `AT3G05470` `+10.32`, `AT2G43800` `+8.74`, `AT3G32400` `+5.45`), `NET1A` (`+14.38`), `SPC97` (`+6.59`), `WLIM2A` (`+4.39`).

  - *Water/Hypoxia/Heat Stress (Down):* `XERO1` (`-268.27`), `LTI78`, `DREB2A`, `MYB2` (`qRT-PCR` confirmed), `HSFA2`, `HSP101`, `HSP90.1` (`HSP40` Up).

- **Phenotypic Anchor (`Johnson et al., 2015`; `Millar et al., 2011`):** Unidirectional root/shoot skewing, abundant adventitious roots, and smaller, rounder petiole endodermal cells.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** Vol. 15 — *The Thin-Air Dissection*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-134` (`GLDS-134`)

- **Version & Dates:** Version 3 | Submitted: `12-Oct-2016` | Initial Release: `11-May-2017` | Updated: `28-Aug-2024`

- **Study DOI:** `10.26030/wknj-pf59`

- **Source Accession / Related Study:** `PRJNA347979` (`GSE87869` [Experiment 1]) | Related: `OSD-136` (`GSE87868`, Experiment 2)

- **Payload & Mission:** `Simulated_Environmental_Factors` (Ground Study — Low Pressure Growth Chambers [`LPGC`] at CESRF, University of Guelph, Ontario, Canada)

- **Primary Publication:** Zhou et al. (2017), *Front Plant Sci* 8:528 (PMID: `28443120` | DOI: `10.3389/fpls.2017.00528`) — *Dissecting Low Atmospheric Pressure Stress: Transcriptome Responses to the Components of Hypobaria in Arabidopsis*

- **Organism & Genotype:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* Wassilewskija (`WS`), `10`-day-old seedlings (`12` plants/plate, `10` plates/chamber, `3` chambers/treatment) grown vertically on `0.5×` MS media, `0.45%` Phytagel, `2.5 ppm` benomyl (`pH 5.75`), `24 h` continuous light (`70–80 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹`), `22–25°C` at `97 kPa` ambient before `24 h` atmospheric shift

- **Hardware & Conditions (`6` Atmospheres, `CO₂ = 0.05 kPa`, `RH ≥ 95%`, `22–24°C`):**

  - `97 kPa` (`pO₂ = 21 kPa`, Guelph ambient control)

  - `50 kPa` (`pO₂ = 10 kPa`, moderate hypobaria + mild hypoxia)

  - `25 kPa` (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`, severe hypobaria + strong hypoxia)

  - `50 kPa/NormOx` (`pTOT = 50 kPa`, `pO₂ = 21 kPa`, pure moderate hypobaria)

  - `25 kPa/NormOx` (`pTOT = 25 kPa`, `pO₂ = 21 kPa`, pure severe hypobaria)

  - `97 kPa/HypOx` (`pTOT = 97 kPa`, `pO₂ = 5.1 kPa` [`5 kPa`], pure hypoxia at ambient pressure)

- **Preservation & Assays (`n = 33` in `OSD-134`):** Direct harvest into `RNAlater`, dissected into **roots** and **shoots**; `RNeasy Mini Kit`, `3' IVT plus` biotin labeling, `Affymetrix ATH1 121501` (`MAS5`/`RMA`, `limma` unadjusted `P < 0.01`, `|FC| ≥ 2`); Taqman `qRT-PCR` validation (`UBQ11` [`AT4G05050`] internal control)

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **WS-10 Root & Shoot ("Guelph Twins"):** Ten-day-old *Arabidopsis* `WS` seedlings raised vertically on `0.45%` Phytagel at `97 kPa` (`1,100 ft` elevation in Guelph, Ontario) before being sealed inside `245 L` steel-and-glass `LPGC` cylinders (`0.45 × 1.6 m`) for a `24 h` atmospheric trial.

- **The Oxygen Trio (`PDC1`, `AHB1`, `PCO1`):** Core root hypoxia responders (`AT4G33070`, `AT2G16060`, `AT5G15120`) that roar to life at `50 kPa`, `25 kPa`, and `97 kPa/HypOx`—yet fall silent the moment `pO₂` is restored to `21 kPa` (`NormOx`).

- **TAD3 (`AT5G24670`):** An essential tRNA-editing enzyme repressed in `50 kPa` roots (but not `50 kPa/NormOx`), embodying how combined hypobaria quietly brakes growth.

- **LBD41 (`AT3G02550`):** The sole root gene crossing all three severe treatments (`25 kPa`, `25 kPa/NormOx`, `97 kPa/HypOx`)—surging in low oxygen, yet flipping *downward* when pressure drops while `pO₂` stays `21 kPa`.

- **MYB44 (`AT5G67300`):** The lone ranger of `25 kPa/NormOx` shoots—the *only* gene (`|FC| ≥ 2`, `P < 0.01`) significantly altered in `10 d` shoots when severe `25 kPa` hypobaria is stripped of hypoxia.

- **CWLP (`AT3G22120`) & FSD1 (`AT4G25100`):** The pressure-sensitive specialists—`CWLP` (cell wall–plasma membrane linker) "enhanced" specifically in `25 kPa` roots beyond either `NormOx` or `HypOx`, while oxidative-stress `FSD1` is "repressed."

- **AT4G33560:** A wounding-responsive unknown protein—the sole bridge between `50 kPa` roots and shoots showing a `> 1.8`-fold divergence from `50 kPa/NormOx`.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 — Splash: Six Skies in Steel Cylinders**

- *Panel 1 (Full-page splash):* Inside the University of Guelph's Controlled Environment Systems Research Facility (`CESRF`), six towering `245 L` Low Pressure Growth Chambers (`0.45 × 1.6 m`) stand wired to second-by-second gas manifolds. Inside each, vertical Petri plates of `10 d` *Arabidopsis* `WS` seedlings glow under `70–80 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹` continuous light.

- *Caption:* "On Earth, thinning air always steals oxygen. Only inside a steel chamber can you pull the sky apart."

**Page 2 — Baseline at `1,100 Feet`**

- *Panel 1:* Close-up on a `97 kPa` pressure gauge—Guelph's natural ambient pressure (`pO₂ = 21 kPa`, `CO₂ = 0.05 kPa`).

- *Panel 2:* `WS-10` Root and Shoot cling vertically to `0.45%` Phytagel (`pH 5.75`, `2.5 ppm` benomyl, `95%+` humidity).

- *WS-10 Shoot:* "Ten days of `24`-hour light. No spaceflight yet—just a clean `97 kPa` baseline."

**Page 3 — The Six-Way Split**

- *Panel 1:* A manifold diagram splits the `18` chambers (`3` replicates × `6` atmospheres) into their `24 h` assignments: `97 kPa` (control), `50 kPa` (`pO₂ = 10 kPa`), `25 kPa` (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`), `50 kPa/NormOx` (`pO₂ = 21 kPa`), `25 kPa/NormOx` (`pO₂ = 21 kPa`), and `97 kPa/HypOx` (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`).

- *Caption:* "Two pressures. Two oxygen levels. One question: how much of hypobaria is really just suffocation?"

**Page 4 — Valve Open: The Drop to `50 kPa`**

- *Panel 1:* Vacuum pumps hum (`WHIRRR`). Pressure needles swing down to `50 kPa`—roughly `5,500 m` altitude, the natural limit of higher plants on Earth.

- *Panel 2:* In `50 kPa/NormOx`, a separate line bleeds pure `O₂` back in, holding `pO₂` at `21 kPa` even as total pressure halves.

**Page 5 — Plunge to `25 kPa`: Beyond the Mountain Line**

- *Panel 1:* In the `25 kPa` chamber, the needle drops past `40 kPa`—into an atmosphere no land plant has ever evolved to breathe (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`).

- *Panel 2:* Across the aisle, `97 kPa/HypOx` keeps full `97 kPa` weight on the leaves while starving them down to the exact same `5 kPa` oxygen.

**Page 6 — The Stomatal Rush**

- *Panel 1:* Microscopic view of a `WS-10` leaf stoma at `25 kPa`. Water vapor molecules rocket outward faster through the thin air—accelerated evapotranspiration!

- *Panel 2:* Yet inside the sealed Petri plate (`RH ≥ 95%`), hydrated Phytagel feeds the roots continuously.

- *WS-10 Shoot:* "The air feels dry... but my feet are standing in a full reservoir."

**Page 7 — Hour 24: No Wilted Leaves**

- *Panel 1:* Post-treatment photographs (`Figure 2`) line up all six chambers: `97 kPa`, `50 kPa`, `50 kPa/NormOx`, `25 kPa`, `25 kPa/NormOx`, `97 kPa/HypOx`.

- *Panel 2:* Every rosette is green, turgid, and un-wilted. To the naked eye, nothing happened.

- *Caption:* "Morphology stays poker-faced. The truth is hiding in the mRNA."

**Page 8 — Straight to `RNAlater`**

- *Panel 1:* Chambers vent back to `97 kPa`; plates are cracked open and `12` seedlings per plate are plunged straight into `RNAlater` tubes (`3` chamber replicates per group).

- *Panel 2:* Forceps bisect every seedling at the hypocotyl-root junction: aerial shoots in one vial, vertical roots in another.

**Page 9 — One Missing Array**

- *Panel 1:* At UF's ICBR core, `24` root arrays and `18` shoot arrays hit the `Affymetrix ATH1` scanner (`3' IVT plus`, `12.5 µg` cRNA).

- *Panel 2:* A red warning blinks over `25 kPa/NormOx` roots: two hybridizations fail QC, leaving `n = 1` array (`GSM2342078`) to carry the `25 kPa/NormOx` root flag alone.

**Page 10 — Lifting the FDR Veil**

- *Panel 1:* On the `limma` workstation, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction wipes the `50 kPa` and `NormOx` comparisons completely blank (`0` genes!).

- *Panel 2:* The analyst toggles to unadjusted `P < 0.01` (`|FC| ≥ 2`)—and `151` genes (`50 kPa` suite) and `372` genes (`25 kPa` suite) light up the screen, waiting for `Taqman qRT-PCR` to prove they're real.

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 — Roots vs. Shoots at `50 kPa`**

- *Panel 1:* Inside `50 kPa` (`pO₂ = 10 kPa`), **112** genes stir in `WS-10` roots—led by drought/cold-linked `SUS1` (`AT5G20830`)—while shoots shift just **23** genes (mostly biotic defense, including downregulated thionin `AT1G72260`).

- *WS-10 Root:* "Down here on the agar, I feel every kilopascal drop."

**Page 12 — The Oxygen Rescue (`50 kPa/NormOx`)**

- *Panel 1:* When `pO₂` is topped back up to `21 kPa` at `50 kPa`, the root storm shrinks from `112` genes to **25**, and shoots drop from `23` to just **2** (`AT5G18600`, `AT1G23130`)—with *zero* overlap between roots and shoots!

- *Panel 2:* `PDC1`, `AHB1`, and `PCO1` stand down completely; `TAD3` (`AT5G24670`) stops being repressed.

**Page 13 — The `14 + 7` Bridge**

- *Panel 1:* Comparing `50 kPa` directly against `50 kPa/NormOx` (`> 1.8`-fold gap) isolates `14` root genes and `7` shoot genes (`5` in signal transduction).

- *Panel 2:* Only **one** gene—wounding-responsive `AT4G33560`—crosses between root and shoot in that hypoxia-driven gap.

**Page 14 — Severe Hypobaria: The `25 kPa` Storm**

- *Panel 1:* At `25 kPa` (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`), **256** genes ignite in roots and **55** in shoots (`AOC1` / `AT3G25760` among them), with **34 of 51** known plant core hypoxia genes lighting up across the `25 kPa` suite.

- *Panel 2:* `97 kPa/HypOx` (`pO₂ = 5 kPa`) triggers **167** genes in roots (`ADH1`, `PDC2`, `ALAAT1` driving ethanol/alanine fermentation) and **31** in shoots.

**Page 15 — The Lonely `MYB44`**

- *Panel 1:* In `25 kPa/NormOx` (`25 kPa` total pressure, `21 kPa` `O₂`), roots drop to **17** DEGs—and in the entire `WS-10` shoot transcriptome, only **one** gene (`MYB44`, `AT5G67300`) crosses the `2`-fold, `P < 0.01` threshold!

- *MYB44:* "Strip away the hypoxia, and the shoot barely flinches at a quarter-atmosphere."

**Page 16 — `LBD41`'s Flip**

- *Panel 1:* `LBD41` (`AT3G02550`) stands at the three-way intersection of `25 kPa`, `97 kPa/HypOx`, and `25 kPa/NormOx` in roots.

- *Panel 2:* In `25 kPa` and `97 kPa/HypOx`, `LBD41` surges upward; in `25 kPa/NormOx`, it plunges *downward*—proving pressure and oxygen tug on opposite levers.

**Page 17 — The Thirteen Pressure-Specific Rebels**

- *Panel 1:* A `> 1.8`-fold filter comparing `25 kPa` simultaneously against *both* `25 kPa/NormOx` and `97 kPa/HypOx` catches **13** genes (`4` root, `9` shoot) that refuse to obey either hypoxia or pure low pressure alone:

  - *Enhanced in `25 kPa`:* `CWLP` (`AT3G22120`) in roots + `5` shoot genes (`2` lipid-transfer proteins).

  - *Repressed in `25 kPa`:* `FSD1` (`AT4G25100`) in roots.

  - *Intermediate:* `2` root + `4` shoot genes suppressed by low total pressure.

**Page 18 — KEGG Pathways: Known vs. Unknown**

- *Panel 1:* `DAVID` (`Benjamini P < 0.05`) scans the gene lists. `97 kPa/HypOx` maps cleanly to textbook pathways: *Glycolysis/Gluconeogenesis* (`5.4%` in roots), *Cysteine & methionine metabolism* (`12.9%` in shoots), *Biosynthesis of secondary metabolites*.

- *Panel 2:* `50 kPa`, `50 kPa/NormOx`, and `25 kPa/NormOx` return **`N/A`**—no canonical KEGG pathway enriched! Even `25 kPa` roots only hit broad *Metabolic pathways* (`15.4%`), while shoots hit *alpha-Linolenic acid metabolism* (`7.3%`).

- *Caption:* "Hypobaria isn't in the evolutionary textbook. Most of its responders don't even have a KEGG map."

**Page 19 — Why Core Drought Genes Stayed Quiet**

- *Panel 1:* Classic dehydration markers `COR15A` and `RD29A` remain silent at `50` and `25 kPa` (unlike earlier `10 kPa` studies), because `95%+` plate humidity and hydrated Phytagel buffer the shoot against lethal water loss.

**Page 20 — `Taqman` Vindication**

- *Panel 1:* `UBQ11` (`AT4G05050`) anchors the `Taqman qRT-PCR` bench (`n = 3`).

- *Panel 2:* `AHB1` and `PDC1` amplify strongly in `50 kPa`, `25 kPa`, and `97 kPa/HypOx` roots—proving that the unadjusted `P < 0.01` microarray call captured real biology that FDR would have erased.

**Page 21 — The Continuous-Light Twist**

- *Panel 1:* Overhead `24 h` lamps (`70–80 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹`, matching ISS growth hardware) keep stomata open and alter organ-specific hypoxia gating—explaining why only `9` of `51` core hypoxia genes overlap between roots and shoots in `97 kPa/HypOx`.

**Page 22 — Hypobaria as a Shield?**

- *Panel 1:* Comparing `25 kPa` against `97 kPa/HypOx`, the negative regulation of oxidative/stress genes by lower total gas pressure hints at a paradox: mild hypobaria can actually *buffer* plants against low-oxygen injury when water is plentiful.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23 — The Two-Component Verdict**

- *Panel 1:* A Venn diagram splits hypobaria into three forces: (1) **Hypoxia** (the dominant driver at `25 kPa`, rescued by `NormOx`), (2) **Evapotranspiration / Water-flux sensing** (buffered by `RH ≥ 95%`), and (3) **Pure Low Pressure** (novel, unmapped genes like `MYB44`, `CWLP`, `FSD1`).

**Page 24 — Martian & Lunar Greenhouse Economics**

- *Panel 1:* An engineering schematic of a `50 kPa` or `25 kPa` Mars greenhouse: lower internal pressure slashes structural mass and gas-leak rates—and `OSD-134` shows that simply maintaining `pO₂ = 21 kPa` (`NormOx`) and steady root water eliminates most of the transcriptomic stress!

**Page 25 — Passing the Baton to `OSD-136`**

- *Panel 1:* Beside the `10 d` plates sit `5`-day-old `WS` seedlings (`Figure 4` of Zhou et al., 2017)—where `103` genes in `5 d` roots share only `10` responders with `10 d` roots at `50 kPa` (`EPF2`, `SWEET11`). Their `GSE87868` arrays await **Vol. 16 (`OSD-136`)**.

**Page 26 — Archive & Curation (`GLDS-134`)**

- *Panel 1:* Thirty-three `.CEL.gz` files (`GSM2342067`–`GSM2342091+`) enter `PRJNA347979` / `GSE87869` and NASA GeneLab as `OSD-134` (`DOI: 10.26030/wknj-pf59`, updated `28-Aug-2024`).

**Page 27–30 — Epilogue Montage: Breathing Thin Air**

- *Page 27:* `WS-10` roots and shoots stand side by side—proof that two organs of the same plant read the same sky differently.

- *Page 28:* The `LPGC` chamber door swings open, letting `97 kPa` Guelph air rush back in.

- *Page 29:* A Mars dome silhouette glows at dusk, its crops thriving at reduced barometric pressure with `21 kPa` `O₂`.

- *Page 30 (Closing Splash):* Inside a `245 L` chamber, a single *Arabidopsis* `WS` seedling floats above a barometer reading `25 kPa / pO₂ = 21 kPa`, with only `MYB44` glowing softly in its leaves. *Caption:* "Take away the hypoxia, feed the roots, and even a quarter-atmosphere becomes home."

- **Header:** `OSD-134` (`GLDS-134` | `LPGC` at CESRF, Guelph | `24 h` exposure | `22–24°C` | `CO₂ = 0.05 kPa` | `RH ≥ 95%` | `n = 33` arrays)

- **Treatment & DEG Summary Table (`|FC| ≥ 2`, unadjusted `P < 0.01`):**

- **25 kPa Dissection (`372` total DEGs, `34/51` core hypoxia genes):**

  - `LBD41` (`AT3G02550`) up in `25 kPa` & `97 kPa/HypOx`, down in `25 kPa/NormOx` roots.

  - `13` pressure-divergent genes (`> 1.8`-fold vs. *both* `NormOx` & `HypOx`): `CWLP` (`AT3G22120`, Enhanced in root), `FSD1` (`AT4G25100`, Repressed in root).

- **KEGG Enrichment (`Benjamini P < 0.05`):**

  - `97 kPa/HypOx`: Glycolysis/Gluconeogenesis (`5.4%` root), Cysteine/methionine (`12.9%` shoot), Secondary metabolites.

  - `50 kPa`, `50 kPa/NormOx`, `25 kPa/NormOx`: **`N/A`** (novel unmapped pressure response).

- **Organism & Genotype:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* Wassilewskija (`WS` / `Ws-0`), **5-day-old** seedlings (`12` plants/plate, `10` plates/chamber, `3` chambers/treatment) grown vertically on `0.5×` MS media, `0.45%` Phytagel, `2.5 ppm` benomyl (`pH 5.75`), `24 h` continuous light, `22–25°C` at `97 kPa` before `24 h` transfer

- **Hardware & Conditions (`3` Atmospheres, `CO₂ = 0.05 kPa`, `RH ≥ 95%`, `22–24°C`):**

  - `97 kPa` (`97,000 Pa` Guelph ambient control, `pO₂ = 21 kPa`)

  - `50 kPa` (`50,000 Pa` moderate hypobaria, `notsuppO2`)

  - `50 kPa/NormOx` (`50,000 Pa + O₂` supplemented to `pO₂ = 21 kPa`, `suppO2`)

- **Preservation & Assays (`n = 9` `5 d` root arrays):** Harvested directly to `RNAlater`, **Plant Roots** dissected; `RNeasy Mini Kit`, `3' IVT plus` biotin labeling, `Affymetrix ATH1 121501` (`MAS5`/`RMA`, `limma` unadjusted `P < 0.01`, `|FC| ≥ 2`); reprocessed in `2024` via GeneLab `NF_MAAffymetrix 1.0.5` (`oligo` RMA, `Ensembl Plants` rel. 54, `limma`)

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **WS-5 Root ("Young Sprout"):** Five-day-old *Arabidopsis* `WS` primary root—half the age of Vol. 15's `WS-10` veteran, still building its lipid membranes and sugar pipelines when the `LPGC` pressure drops to `50 kPa`.

- **SWEET11 (`AT3G48740`):** A bidirectional sugar transporter—and the **sole** gene repressed in *both* `5 d` and `10 d` roots under oxygen-supplemented `50 kPa/NormOx`, proving that pure `50 kPa` pressure alters carbon transport regardless of age.

- **EPF2 (`AT1G34245`):** Epidermal Patterning Factor 2—a water-use-efficiency and stomatal-density regulator unexpectedly upregulated in `5 d` roots at `50 kPa` (but not `50 kPa/NormOx` or `10 d` roots).

- **CWLP (`AT3G22120`):** Cell wall–plasma membrane linker protein—protecting water content in `5 d` roots at `50 kPa`, echoing its `25 kPa` role in `10 d` roots (Vol. 15).

- **The Age-Independent Nine (`PDC1`, `AHB1`, `PCO1` + 6 allies):** The nine hypoxia and wound-responsive genes that show a `> 1.8`-fold `50 kPa` vs. `50 kPa/NormOx` gap in *both* `5 d` and `10 d` roots.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 — Splash: The Younger Sibling**

- *Panel 1 (Full-page splash):* Inside the same `CESRF` Low Pressure Growth Chambers (`LPGC`) from Vol. 15, a new rack of vertical `0.5×` MS plates holds tiny **5-day-old** `Ws-0` seedlings—shorter roots, fresh cotyledons, barely five days out of the seed coat.

- *Caption:* "Experiment 1 tested ten-day-old veterans at `50` and `25 kPa`. Experiment 2 (`OSD-136`) asks a sharper question: does a five-day-old root hear the same sky?"

**Page 2 — Five Days at `97 kPa`**

- *Panel 1:* Close-up of `WS-5` Root's delicate root hairs clinging to `0.45%` Phytagel (`2.5 ppm` benomyl, `pH 5.75`) under `24 h` light.

- *WS-5 Root:* "Ten-day-old roots have already settled into their abiotic stress routines. I'm still wiring my sugar and lipid highways."

**Page 3 — Three Chambers, Nine Replicates**

- *Panel 1:* Three `LPGC` manifolds lock in for `24 h`: `97 kPa` (`CTRL`, `GSM2342100–2342102`), `50 kPa` (`notsuppO2`, `GSM2342103–2342105`), and `50 kPa/NormOx` (`+ O₂` to `21 kPa`, `GSM2342106–2342108`).

- *Panel 2:* Temperature holds at `22–24°C`, `CO₂` at `0.05 kPa`, humidity inside plates at `95%+`.

**Page 4 — The `50 kPa` Drop**

- *Panel 1:* Pressure falls from `97,000 Pa` to `50,000 Pa`—right on the terrestrial mountain boundary where higher plants naturally thin out.

- *Panel 2:* In the `suppO2` chamber, supplemental oxygen holds `pO₂` steady at `21,000 Pa` while nitrogen balances the rest.

**Page 5 — Poker-Faced at Day 5**

- *Panel 1:* At Hour `24`, cameras snap the `5 d` plates (`Figure 2` of Zhou et al., 2017): zero wilting, zero browning, zero visible desiccation across `97 kPa`, `50 kPa`, and `50 kPa/NormOx`.

- *WS-5 Root:* "We look identical on the outside. Now open the tubes."

**Page 6–8 — Harvest, Bisection & Array Hybridization**

- *Page 6:* Twelve seedlings per plate plunge into `RNAlater`; forceps isolate the `5 d` **Plant Roots** (`9` clean biological replicates, `n = 3` per atmosphere).

- *Page 7:* At UF ICBR, `100 ng` total RNA feeds the `3' IVT plus` kit, yielding biotin-labeled cRNA (`12.5 µg`) for `Affymetrix ATH1 121501` arrays (`FS450_0004`, `GeneChip Scanner 3000 7G`).

- *Page 8:* Unlike Vol. 15's missing `25 kPa/NormOx` replicates, all **9** `5 d` root arrays pass clean.

**Page 9–10 — The `5 d` vs. `10 d` Heatmap Unfolds**

- *Page 9:* The `221`-gene comparative heatmap (`Figure 4A`) renders on screen: `103` DEGs from `5 d` roots on the left, `129` DEGs from `10 d` roots on the right.

- *Page 10:* The two columns look like strangers. *Caption:* "Same ecotype. Same chamber. Same `50 kPa`. Five days of age changes almost everything."

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 — The Great Age Divide (`103` vs. `129`)**

- *Panel 1:* In the `50 kPa` Venn diagram (`Figure 4B`), `5 d` roots and `10 d` roots share just **10** coordinately regulated genes!

- *WS-5 Root:* "Only ten! My older self fights abiotic stress—I'm rewriting lipid, sugar, and water metabolism."

**Page 12 — The Oxygen Trio Holds the Line**

- *Panel 1:* Inside those `10` shared `50 kPa` responders, `PDC1`, `AHB1`, and `PCO1` stand tall in both `5 d` and `10 d` roots—confirming that mild `10 kPa` hypoxia is the universal trigger across ages.

**Page 13 — `SWEET11`: The Sole `NormOx` Survivor**

- *Panel 1:* The `50 kPa/NormOx` Venn diagram shrinks to a single glowing dot at the intersection of `5 d` and `10 d` roots: **`SWEET11`** (`AT3G48740`).

- *SWEET11:* "Both of you—five days old and ten days old—shut down my bidirectional sugar gate when total pressure drops to `50 kPa`, even with `21 kPa` oxygen!"

**Page 14 — Lipid & Sugar Rerouting in `5 d` Roots**

- *Panel 1:* `AgriGO` (`Table S2`) highlights `5 d` root clades packed with **lipid metabolism** and **sugar transport** transcripts—fueling rapid early root expansion while `50 kPa` alters gas diffusion.

**Page 15 — `EPF2` & `CWLP` Step Forward**

- *Panel 1:* Two unexpected defenders surge in `5 d` roots at `50 kPa` (but *not* `50 kPa/NormOx`, and *not* in `10 d` roots): **`EPF2`** (`AT1G34245`, stomatal/water-use-efficiency factor) and **`CWLP`** (`AT3G22120`, cell wall–plasma membrane linker).

- *CWLP:* "At `10` days old, I wait for `25 kPa` to wake up. At `5` days old, `50 kPa` is enough!"

**Page 16–18 — The `37`-Gene `50 kPa` vs. `NormOx` Gap**

- *Page 16:* Filtering `5 d` and `10 d` roots for genes with a `> 1.8`-fold shift between `50 kPa` and `50 kPa/NormOx` (`Figure 4C`) yields **37** genes.

- *Page 17:* **23** of those `37` belong exclusively to `5 d` roots; only **5** belong exclusively to `10 d` roots—showing young seedlings are far more transcriptionally reactive to mild hypobaria's oxygen-dependent component!

- *Page 18:* **9** hypoxia and wound-responsive genes bridge both ages, forming the age-independent core of moderate hypobaria.

**Page 19–22 — Why Young Roots React Differently**

- *Page 19:* `5 d` roots lack the lignified buffers and mature root architecture of `10 d` seedlings, making their plasma-membrane linkers (`CWLP`) and sugar gates (`SWEET11`) immediate pressure sensors.

- *Page 20:* `NormOx` (`+ O₂` to `21 kPa`) silences `23` of those `5 d`-specific spikes, leaving only `SWEET11` and a handful of unshared metabolic genes.

- *Page 21–22:* For space-farm designers, germination and early seedling establishment (`Day 5`) represent a distinct metabolic window from vegetative growth (`Day 10`)—requiring age-aware atmospheric tuning.

**Page 26–30 — Epilogue Montage: Growing Up Under Half a Sky**

- *Page 26:* `WS-5` Root lengthens along the vertical Phytagel, `SWEET11` quietly throttling sugar flux in `50 kPa/NormOx`.

- *Page 27–29:* The `LPGC` telemetry log ticks every `5` minutes—second-by-second proof that plants can adapt to half an atmosphere if water and oxygen are managed.

- *Page 30 (Closing Splash):* Two *Arabidopsis* `WS` roots—one `5` days old, one `10` days old—stand side by side inside a `50 kPa` chamber, linked by a single glowing `SWEET11` thread. *Caption:* "Same sky. Five days apart. Only one sugar gate remembers both."

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** Vol. 17 — *The Accelerated Clock*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-144` (`GLDS-144`)

- **Version & Dates:** Version 4 | Submitted: `18-Aug-2014` | Initial Release: `23-Aug-2014` | Updated: `24-Mar-2025`

- **Study DOI:** `10.26030/x0c3-9p86`

- **Source Accession:** `E-GEOD-60473` (`GSE60473` | `CATdb: Au13-11_Gravity`)

- **Payload & Mission:** `Simulated_Microgravity` (Ground Study — Random Positioning Machine [`RPM`], Airbus Defense and Space, Leiden, the Netherlands; CSIC Madrid / ESA-ELIPS)

- **Primary Publications:**

  - Kamal et al. (2019), *Genomics* 111(6):1956–1965 (PMID: `30641127` | DOI: `10.1016/j.ygeno.2019.01.007`) — *Differential transcriptional profile through cell cycle progression in Arabidopsis cultures under simulated microgravity*

  - Kamal et al. (2019), *Plant, Cell & Environment* 42(2):480–494 (PMID: `30105864` | DOI: `10.1111/pce.13422`) — *Cell cycle acceleration and changes in essential nuclear functions induced by simulated microgravity in a synchronized Arabidopsis cell culture*

- **Organism & Cell Line:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* Landsberg *erecta* (`Ler`) **`MM2D`** cell suspension culture (`MSS` medium: MS + `3%` w/v sucrose, `0.5 mg/L` NAA, `0.05 mg/L` kinetin, `pH 5.8`, `27°C` darkness; synchronized at `G1/S` via **aphidicolin** block/release `T0`; immobilized in **`1%` w/v low-melting agarose**)

- **Hardware & Conditions (`3` Cell-Cycle Regimes, `RPM` vs. `1 g` Earth Control):**

  - **`G2/M` synchronized:** `7 h` `RPM` vs. `10 h` `1 g` control (`T7`/`T10`, `> 2/3` `G2/M` enrichment)

  - **`G1` synchronized:** `14 h` `RPM` vs. `16 h` `1 g` control (`T14`/`T16`, `> 2/3` `G1` enrichment)

  - **`Asynchronous` reference:** `14 h` `RPM` vs. `14 h` `1 g` control

- **Preservation & Assays (`n = 24` paired dye-swap samples across `12` arrays):** Liquid nitrogen flash-freeze (`0.5 g` pooled cell pellets); `REAL Total RNA Spin Plants and Fungi` kit + `Turbo DNA-free`; `Cy3`/`Cy5` direct dye-swap labeling (`5 µg` aRNA); `NimbleGen` microarray (`A-GEOD-17404`, `4` hybridizations/comparison, `Mapix` scan, `loess` normalization); flow cytometry, immunofluorescence microscopy, & `qPCR`

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **MM2D ("The Synchronized Squad"):** *Arabidopsis* Landsberg *erecta* suspension cells—stripped of roots, shoots, and statoliths, yet still feeling gravity's pull while locked inside `1%` low-melting agarose.

- **Aphidicolin ("The Starting Pistol"):** The `G1/S` DNA-replication blocker that halts every `MM2D` cell at the exact `T0` starting line before releasing them in lockstep.

- **The Staggered Clocks (`T7/T10` & `T14/T16`):** Twin timekeepers. Under `RPM` simulated microgravity, `MM2D` sprints into mitosis—forcing researchers to harvest `RPM` `G2/M` at `7 h` (`1 g` at `10 h`) and `RPM` `G1` at `14 h` (`1 g` at `16 h`) just to catch the cells in the same phase.

- **The Nucleolus ("The Ribosome Forge"):** The nuclear factory where ribosome biogenesis slows down under simulated microgravity—especially at `G2/M`—even as the cell cycle accelerates.

- **Chromatin Sentinel:** The epigenetic gatekeeper packing DNA tighter in `RPM`—raising DNA methylation, dropping histone acetylation, and driving overall transcriptional inhibition.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 — Splash: Locked in Agarose**

- *Panel 1 (Full-page splash):* Inside a darkened `27°C` incubator, `250 mL` Pyrex flasks swirl at `120 rpm` with golden *Arabidopsis* `MM2D` cell clusters. Cut to a `1%` low-melting agarose slab mounted onto the twin-frame gimbal of an Airbus `Random Positioning Machine` (`RPM`).

- *Caption:* "Whole seedlings mix dividing meristems with mature leaves. To catch microgravity red-handed inside the cell cycle, you have to freeze the whole army at `T0`."

**Page 2 — The `G1/S` Starting Line (`T0`)**

- *Panel 1:* Seven-day-old `MM2D` cells (`1:20` subculture in `MSS` medium: `3%` sucrose, `0.5 mg/L` NAA, `0.05 mg/L` kinetin, `pH 5.8`) hit **aphidicolin**.

- *Panel 2:* Every nucleus jams at the `G1/S` gate. Washout! `T0` begins.

- *MM2D Cell:* "Everyone on the line! Next stop: `S` phase, `G2/M`, and mitosis!"

**Page 3 — Spaceflight-Ready Gel**

- *Panel 1:* Warm `1%` low-melting agarose pours over the synchronized `T0` cells—immobilizing them in a semisolid matrix designed for real orbital hardware.

- *Panel 2:* Half the plates stay flat at `1 g` on Earth; half mount onto the `RPM` inner frame, tumbling continuously in three dimensions.

**Page 4 — The Race Begins: Gravity vs. `RPM`**

- *Panel 1:* Split-panel timer at `Hour 5`. On the `1 g` bench, `MM2D` nuclei march steadily through `S` phase.

- *Panel 2:* On the spinning `RPM`, the cell cycle **accelerates**—rushing prematurely toward `M` phase while ribosome biogenesis lags behind!

- *The Nucleolus:* "Slow down! We haven't finished building ribosomes for daughter cells!"

- *MM2D Cell:* "Can't! The `G2/M` checkpoint just slipped!"

**Page 5 — Staggering the Harvest (`T7/T10`)**

- *Panel 1:* Flow cytometry histograms flash on a monitor. To catch `> 2/3` of cells in `G2/M`, `RPM` must be harvested at **`7 h`**, while `1 g` control waits until **`10 h`**.

- *Caption:* "If you harvest both at `10 h`, you aren't comparing `G2/M` to `G2/M`—you're comparing two different phases."

**Page 6 — Second Wave (`T14/T16` & Asynchronous `14 h`)**

- *Panel 1:* The clock ticks on. After mitosis, `RPM` hits `G1` enrichment at **`14 h`**, while `1 g` reaches `G1` at **`16 h`**.

- *Panel 2:* Beside them, an **asynchronous** `MM2D` batch runs `14 h` `RPM` vs. `14 h` `1 g` as an un-synchronized reference.

**Page 7 — Liquid Nitrogen Snap**

- *Panel 1:* At `7 h`, `10 h`, `14 h`, and `16 h`, `0.5 g` cell pellets drop into liquid nitrogen (`-196°C`), locking every `Cy3`/`Cy5` target in place.

**Page 8–10 — The `NimbleGen` Dye-Swap Matrix**

- *Page 8:* Four `µg` of `DNase`-treated RNA feeds `SuperScript II RT` with `Cy3-dCTP` and `Cy5-dCTP`, purified through `QIAquick`.

- *Page 9:* Twelve `NimbleGen` `A-GEOD-17404` arrays (`557245A01`–`A12`) run as **four dye-swapped hybridizations** per comparison (`Asyn`, `G1`, `G2/M`) to cancel dye bias.

- *Page 10:* `Mapix` lasers (`532 nm` & `635 nm`) scan the slides; `loess` normalization flattens the log₂ ratios. *Caption:* "Twenty-four samples. Three cell-cycle windows. Now let's see which phase takes the hardest hit."

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 — Global Silence**

- *Panel 1:* Across `Asyn`, `G1`, and `G2/M`, the dominant color on the `NimbleGen` heatmap is **repression**.

- *Chromatin Sentinel:* "Simulated microgravity doesn't just shout—it mutes the nucleus."

**Page 12 — The `G2/M` Peak**

- *Panel 1:* Comparing the three windows side-by-side (`30641127`), differential expression **peaks sharply at `G2/M`** (`T7`/`T10`), eclipsing `G1` (`T14`/`T16`) and the blurred `Asynchronous` average.

- *Caption:* "In an asynchronous culture, `G2/M`'s alarm gets diluted by `G1` and `S`. Synchronization pulls off the mask."

**Page 13 — Checkpoints Under Fire (`G2/M` & `G1/S`)**

- *Panel 1:* `qPCR` and flow cytometry (`30105864`) zoom in on core cell-cycle regulators: both the `G2/M` and `G1/S` checkpoints are misregulated, letting `RPM` cells race through division without normal growth coordination.

**Page 14 — Chromatin Locks Down**

- *Panel 1:* Inside the `MM2D` nucleus, **DNA methylation climbs** while **histone acetylation drops**.

- *Panel 2:* Euchromatin coils into dense heterochromatin blocks—physically choking global nuclear transcription.

**Page 15 — The Nucleolar Slowdown**

- *Panel 1:* Immunofluorescence microscopy shows shrunken, less active nucleoli under `RPM`—especially in **`G2/M`**—as nucleolar proteins and ribosome-biogenesis transcripts fall.

- *The Nucleolus:* "Cell division is speeding up, but protein-factory assembly is slowing down. That's how proliferation and cell growth decouple!"

**Page 16–18 — Shifting Stress Armies (`G2/M` vs. `G1`)**

- *Page 16:* Three GO pillars light up across the arrays: **cell proliferation**, **energy/redox**, and **stress responses**—alongside a crowd of **unknown biological process** genes.

- *Page 17:* Watch the stress-response squad between `G2/M` (`7 h`) and `G1` (`14 h`): the roster flips dramatically! What protects a cell preparing for mitosis is completely rewired once daughter cells enter `G1`.

- *Page 18:* Meanwhile, the `Asynchronous` (`14 h`) culture shows a blunted, averaged signature—missing the phase-specific handoff.

**Page 19–22 — Undifferentiated Cells Still Feel `g`**

- *Page 19:* A recurring question in space biology: *how can an undifferentiated `MM2D` cell with no statoliths sense microgravity?*

- *Page 20:* Through plasma-membrane tension, cytoskeletal/nuclear mechanics, and chromatin-remodeling cascades that alter `G1/S` and `G2/M` timing directly.

- *Page 21–22:* Comparing `OSD-144` (`RPM`) with future spaceflight callus studies (`BRIC-16-DNA`, `BRIC-17`), the Madrid/ESA team concludes that counteracting nucleolar and chromatin stress is essential before space crops can grow reliably from meristems.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23–25 — From `CATdb` & `GEO` to `OSD-144`**

- *Page 23:* `Au13-11_Gravity` lands in `GEO` (`GSE60473`), `ArrayExpress` (`E-GEOD-60473`), and NASA OSDR (`OSD-144` / `GLDS-144`, `DOI: 10.26030/x0c3-9p86`).

- *Page 24:* Updated `24-Mar-2025` (Version 4), `OSD-144` stands as OSDR's benchmark dataset for **cell-cycle-resolved** plant microgravity transcriptomics.

- *Page 25:* Bridging Vol. 17 (`OSD-144`, `Ler` `MM2D` on `RPM`) to Vol. 18 (`OSD-147`, `Col-0` `ARG1 KO` callus in `BRIC-17` on SpaceX `CRS-2`)!

**Page 26–30 — Epilogue Montage: The Uncoupled Rhythm**

- *Page 26:* Two daughter `MM2D` cells separate at `M` phase—smaller, chromatin-condensed, rushing ahead of their nucleoli.

- *Page 27–29:* The `RPM` frame slows to a halt; the `1%` agarose gel rests flat on the bench again.

- *Page 30 (Closing Splash):* A giant *Arabidopsis* `MM2D` nucleus floats in dark `MSS` agarose, its cell-cycle dial split into `G1` (`14 h` vs. `16 h`) and `G2/M` (`7 h` vs. `10 h`) arcs. *Caption:* "Microgravity doesn't just stress a plant cell. It rewrites its clock."

**Pages 31–32 — Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** *(Detailed in Section 4 below.)*

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

**Page 31 (Left Spread): Synchronization & `RPM` Design (`n = 24` Samples)**

- **Cell Line & Matrix:** *Arabidopsis* (`Ler`) `MM2D` suspension cells (`MSS` medium, `27°C`, dark) → **aphidicolin** `G1/S` block/release (`T0`) → immobilized in `1%` low-melting agarose → `RPM` vs. `1 g` Earth control.

- **Phase-Matched Harvest Schedule (`> 2/3` phase enrichment):**

  - `G2/M` synchronized: **`7 h` `RPM`** vs. **`10 h` `1 g`** (`4` dye-swap arrays, `GSM1480720–723`)

  - `G1` synchronized: **`14 h` `RPM`** vs. **`16 h` `1 g`** (`4` dye-swap arrays, `GSM1480716–719`)

  - `Asynchronous` reference: **`14 h` `RPM`** vs. **`14 h` `1 g`** (`4` dye-swap arrays, `GSM1480712–715`)

- **Platform:** `NimbleGen` `A-GEOD-17404` (`Cy3`/`Cy5` dye-swap, `loess` normalization).

**Page 32 (Right Spread): Nuclear & Transcriptomic Impact (`Kamal et al., 2019`)**

- **Cell-Cycle Acceleration:** `RPM` induces **quick entry into M phase**, shortening the cell cycle and decoupling proliferation from growth (`G2/M` & `G1/S` checkpoint misregulation).

- **Phase Peak:** Overall transcriptional inhibition across all samples, with differential expression **peaking at `G2/M`** and stress-response profiles shifting sharply from `G2/M` to `G1`.

- **Epigenetics & Nucleolus (`PMID: 30105864`):** Higher DNA methylation, lower histone acetylation, increased chromatin condensation, depleted nuclear transcription, and **reduced ribosome biogenesis / nucleolar activity** (strongest at `G2/M`).

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Volume:** Vol. 18 — *The Hidden Logic of `ARG1`*

- **OSDR Accession:** `OSD-147` (`GLDS-147`)

- **Version & Dates:** Version 7 | Submitted: `16-May-2016` | Initial Release: `01-Sep-2017` | Updated: `03-Oct-2023`

- **Study DOI:** `10.26030/npp5-bt42`

- **Source Accession:** `GSE81442`

- **Payload & Mission:** `BRIC-17-1` (`CEL` — Cellular Expression Logic) aboard SpaceX `CRS-2` Dragon (`03/01/2013`–`03/26/2013`, `10 d` on ISS)

- **Primary Publication:** Zupanska et al. (2017), *Astrobiology* 17(11):1077–1111 (PMID: `29088549` | DOI: `10.1089/ast.2016.1538`) — *ARG1 Functions in the Physiological Adaptation of Undifferentiated Plant Cells to Spaceflight* *(Companion `HSFA2 KO` study: `OSD-205`, PMID: `30658467`)*

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* Columbia-0 (`Col-0`) hypocotyl-derived undifferentiated callus cell cultures (`~1 g` cells/plate on `6.5 mL` nutrient agar with `2,4-D`, `3%` sucrose, `0.8%` agar): **Wild Type (`WT`)** vs. **`ARG1 KO`** (`SALK_024542C` / `arg1-3` T-DNA insertion null allele)

- **Hardware & Conditions:** `BRIC-LED` (LEDs disabled, continuous dark) Canisters `A` & `B` (`PDFU` 60 mm plates + `HOBO` temperature logger) vs. KSC `ISSES` (International Space Station Environmental Simulator) ground control on a `48 h` delay

- **Preservation & Assays (`n = 18`):** In-orbit `RNAlater` fixation at Day `10` → `24 h` later frozen in `MELFI` (`-80°C`) → cold Dragon return; `RNeasy Mini Kit`, `Ovation Pico WTA` + `Encore Biotin`, `Affymetrix ATH1-121501` (`MAS5` & GeneLab `NF_MAAffymetrix 1.0.3`, `limma` `P < 0.01`, `|log₂ FC| > 1`); `TaqMan` duplex `qRT-PCR` (`UBQ11` control; `AGP12`, `SKB1`, `HSFA2`)

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **WT Callus ("Wild-Type Squad"):** Undifferentiated `Col-0` hypocotyl cells—no roots, no statoliths, no amyloplasts—yet adapting cleanly to orbit by tuning `78` genes.

- **ARG1 (`Altered Response to Gravity 1`):** A J-domain, coiled-coil peripheral membrane protein cycling between the plasma membrane, endomembrane system, and actin cytoskeleton. Its own transcript level stays flat (`307` vs. `313` raw units in `WT`), yet removing it forces **`75` of `78`** `WT` spaceflight genes off their normal script.

- **ARG1 KO (`arg1-3` / `SALK_024542C`):** The knockout twin—thriving in orbit despite missing `ARG1`, but forced to rewrite **`130`** genes (and compensate across **`107`** more) to get there.

- **WRKY2 (`AT5G56270`):** Leader of the tiny **Independent Trio** (`3` genes total)—the only genes that shift identically in both `WT` and `ARG1 KO` spaceflight cells.

- **PEN2 (`AT2G44490`) & Subtilase (`AT1G30600`):** Two of the **12 Required** genes—already pre-elevated on Earth in `ARG1 KO` to match `WT`'s spaceflight level!

- **TIP1;1 (`AT2G36830`) & MATE (`AT2G38330`):** Champions of the **102 Corrected** genes—silent in `WT` spaceflight comparisons, yet exposed when `ARG1 KO` scrambles to pull their expression back to `WT` orbital levels.

- **XTH9 (`AT4G03210`), XTH4 (`AT2G06850`), & XYL1 (`AT1G68560`):** Xyloglucan-remodeling enzymes suppressed in `ARG1 KO` spaceflight cells (`-1.2` to `-2.0` log₂ FC), defining the **Compensated** cell-wall divergence.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 — Splash: Undifferentiated, Not Unfeeling**

- *Panel 1 (Full-page splash):* Inside two dark `BRIC-LED` canisters (with every LED switched off) bolted inside SpaceX `CRS-2` Dragon (`March 1, 2013`), `1 g` smears of golden `Col-0` `WT` and `ARG1 KO` callus cells coat `60 mm` agar plates.

- *Caption:* "No root cap. No statoliths. Just undifferentiated `Col-0` callus—and a single missing J-domain protein called `ARG1`."

**Page 2 — Six Months from Hypocotyl to `3:00 AM` Turnover**

- *Panel 1:* At UF Gainesville, `WT` and `arg1-3` (`SALK_024542C`) hypocotyls dedifferentiate into callus on `2,4-D`/kinetin agar, then swirl in liquid suspension before `1 g` scoops are spread onto `6.5 mL` `BRIC` plates.

- *Panel 2:* Wrapped in black cloth inside Nalgene `BioTransport` carriers, the plates drive through the night to KSC for `3:00 AM` turnover—`48 h` before Falcon 9 ignition.

**Page 3 — `BRIC A` & `BRIC B`: Sharing the Canister**

- *Panel 1:* Schematic of `BRIC-17-1` (`CEL`): `BRIC A` holds `WT` (`PDFU 1–2`) alongside `ARG1 KO` (`PDFU 3–5`); `BRIC B` holds `WT` (`PDFU 1–2`) alongside `HSFA2 KO` (`PDFU 3–5`, Vol. 21/later) plus `HOBO` temperature loggers.

- *Panel 2:* Forty-eight hours behind launch, KSC's `ISSES` chamber replays orbital temperature, humidity, and `CO₂` telemetry for the ground twins.

**Page 4 — Twelve Minutes to Orbit**

- *Panel 1:* March 1, `10:10 EST`—Dragon clears the pad; by March 3, it berths to the ISS.

- *Panel 2:* Inside `PDFU-3`, `ARG1 KO` cells float in dark microgravity. *ARG1 KO:* "No `ARG1`? No problem. We don't even have roots to bend!"

**Page 5 — Inside the Endomembrane**

- *Panel 1:* Cross-section of a `WT` cell: `ARG1` shuttles along Golgi, endosomes, and actin cables with its N-terminal J-domain (`HSC70` partner) and C-terminal coiled-coil.

- *Panel 2:* Inside `ARG1 KO`, that trafficking bridge is snapped (`arg1-3` truncated transcript, `6.4`-fold lower raw signal: `48` vs. `307`). Already on Earth, **`90` genes** (`GArg : GWt`) have shifted just to keep `ARG1 KO` alive.

**Page 6–7 — Day 10: `RNAlater` & `MELFI`**

- *Page 6:* Day `10` on orbit: an astronaut triggers the `PDFU` actuator, flooding `WT` and `ARG1 KO` plates with `RNAlater`.

- *Page 7:* Twenty-four hours later, both `BRICs` slide into `-80°C` `MELFI`—solving the ambient-return RNA degradation that plagued `BRIC-16` (`STS-131`, Vol. 14)!

**Page 8–10 — The Four-Way Matrix**

- *Page 8:* Dragon splashes down in the Pacific (`March 26`), returning cold to KSC (`April 2`) and UF ICBR (`Ovation Pico WTA` + `ATH1-121501`, `n = 18`).

- *Page 9:* Zupanska et al. draw a 4-arrow square (`Figure 1`):

  - Vertical: `FWt : GWt` (`WT` adaptation) & `FArg : GArg` (`ARG1 KO` adaptation).

  - Horizontal: `GArg : GWt` (ground gap) & `FArg : FWt` (spaceflight gap).

- *Page 10:* *Caption:* "Don't just ask what changes in `WT`. Ask what `ARG1 KO` had to *fix* just to survive."

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 — The `WT` Adaptation (`78` Genes)**

- *Panel 1:* In `WT` cells (`FWt : GWt`), **78** genes shift (`46` up, `32` down; `P < 0.01`, `|log₂ FC| > 1`).

- *Panel 2:* Golgi and endomembrane proteins surge (`Reticulon` `+3.1`, `CSLC12` `+1.9`, `PDIL1-2` `+1.2`, `ST1` `+1.1`), while `FLA13` (`-2.1`) and `GMA12/MNN10` (`-2.4`) drop.

**Page 12 — The `ARG1 KO` Detour (`130` Genes)**

- *Panel 1:* In `ARG1 KO` (`FArg : GArg`), **130** genes shift (`68` up, `62` down)—almost none of them `WT`'s genes!

- *Panel 2:* Transporters (`TIP1;1`, `HMA5`, `SWEET2`, `NHX2`, `MATE`) surge while xyloglucan wall cutters (`XYL1`, `XTH9`, `XTH4`) plunge.

**Page 13 — The Independent Trio (`3` Genes)**

- *Panel 1:* Overlapping `FWt : GWt` (`78`) and `FArg : GArg` (`130`) leaves only **three** shared genes (`WRKY2` `+1.9`, `At3g08590`, `At3g30843`)!

- *WRKY2:* "Cell polarity is non-negotiable. With or without `ARG1`, we hold the apical/basal switch."

- *Caption:* "That means **`75` of `78`** `WT` spaceflight genes depend—directly or partially—on `ARG1`."

**Page 14 — The `24` Stringent Dependents & `12` Required**

- *Panel 1:* `12` `WT` genes (`PSK4`, `Nucleotide-sugar transporter`) simply go dead in `ARG1 KO` (`Category II`).

- *Panel 2:* Another `12` (**Required**, `Category III`—including `Subtilase` `At1g30600`, `CYP71B2`, `PEN2`) were *already* cranked up on Earth in `ARG1 KO` to match `WT`'s spaceflight level!

**Page 15–17 — The `102` Corrected Genes (The Hidden Majority)**

- *Page 15:* A spotlight hits **102** genes (`25` from `GArg : GWt` + `77` from `FArg : GArg`) that *never* changed in `WT` (`FWt : GWt`), yet `ARG1 KO` had to actively pull back to `WT` spaceflight levels (`FArg : FWt` = no difference!).

- *Page 16:* `TIP1;1` (`-1.6` on ground → `+1.6` in flight), `MATE` (`-1.9` → `+1.7`), `Subtilase` (`-2.3` → `+3.3`), `NHX2`, `SPSA1`, and `SPI` snap back into alignment.

- *Page 17:* *Caption:* "If you only study `WT`, these `102` genes are invisible—because `WT` already holds them at the exact level spaceflight demands."

**Page 18–19 — The `107` Compensated Genes (`XTH` & Gravitropism)**

- *Page 18:* In `FArg : FWt`, **107** genes (`25` active in `FArg : GArg`, `82` static) diverge between `ARG1 KO` and `WT` in orbit.

- *Page 19:* `XYL1` (`-1.4`), `XTH9` (`-1.4`), `XTH8` (`-2.0`), `XTH4` (`-2.0`), `POL` (`-2.4`), `SGR7`/`SHR` (`-1.5`), and vesicle-trafficking `SRP54`/`Clathrin`/`SOS1` (`-1.8` to `-2.1`) mark `ARG1 KO`'s alternative cell-wall and polarity route.

**Page 20 — `PAGE` Convergence & `TaqMan` Check**

- *Panel 1:* `agriGO PAGE` (`Figure 7`) reveals the twist: even with different gene rosters, `WT` and `ARG1 KO` converge on the same overarching biological processes.

- *Panel 2:* `TaqMan` duplex `qRT-PCR` (`UBQ11` control) confirms `AGP12` under-expression in `FArg : GArg` and validates the `P < 0.01` microarray stringency.

**Page 21–22 — `BRIC-16` vs. `BRIC-17`: Only One Gene**

- *Page 21:* Comparing `BRIC-17` `WT` callus (`SpaceX CRS-2`, `MELFI` `-80°C`, freshly established `6`-month line) against `BRIC-16` `WT` callus (`STS-131`, ambient `RNAlater`, years-old line, `+1` week on solid media): **only 1 DEG** (`At5g62710` protein kinase) overlaps!

- *Page 22:* *Caption:* "Pre-flight physiological state—how stressed a cell already is on Earth—rewires the specific gene list, while cell-wall remodeling remains universal."

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23–25 — The `180`-Gene Landscape & `GLDS-147`**

- *Page 23:* `Figure 6` maps the full `180`-gene `Important` landscape (`78` `WT` + `102` `Corrected`) alongside the `107` `Compensated` genes.

- *Page 24:* Eighteen `.CEL.gz` files (`GSM2152569`–`GSM2152586`) enter `GSE81442` and NASA OSDR as `OSD-147` (`DOI: 10.26030/npp5-bt42`), later reprocessed via `NF_MAAffymetrix 1.0.3`.

- *Page 25:* Meanwhile, inside `BRIC B`, the `HSFA2 KO` plates await their own sequel (`OSD-205`).

**Page 26–30 — Epilogue Montage: Many Roads to Orbit**

- *Page 26–29:* `WT` and `ARG1 KO` callus cells divide peacefully in dark `BRIC` agar—two genotypes, two distinct transcriptomic paths, one shared destination.

- *Page 30 (Closing Splash):* A glowing endomembrane network links `ARG1` to `WRKY2`, `PEN2`, `TIP1;1`, and `XTH9` inside a single undifferentiated `Col-0` cell. *Caption:* "A cell doesn't need a root cap to feel spaceflight. It only needs its internal traffic—and a backup plan when `ARG1` is gone."

**Pages 31–32 — Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** *(Detailed in Section 4 below.)*

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

**Page 31 (Left Spread): `BRIC-17` `CEL` Flight Profile & 4-Way Matrix (`n = 18`)**

- **Flight:** SpaceX `CRS-2` (`03/01/2013`–`03/26/2013`) | `10 d` dark growth in `BRIC-LED` (`A`/`B`, LEDs off) → in-orbit `RNAlater` → `MELFI` (`-80°C`) | `ISSES` ground control (`48 h` delay).

- **Replicates:** `WT` (`5` `FLT`, `5` `GC`) vs. `ARG1 KO` `SALK_024542C` (`4` `FLT`, `4` `GC`) on `ATH1-121501` (`P < 0.01`, `|log₂ FC| > 1`).

- **4-Way DEG Counts:**

  - `FWt : GWt` (`WT` adaptation): **78** (`46` up, `32` down)

  - `FArg : GArg` (`ARG1 KO` adaptation): **130** (`68` up, `62` down)

  - `GArg : GWt` (ground genotype gap): **90** (`39` up, `51` down)

  - `FArg : FWt` (spaceflight genotype gap): **107**

**Page 32 (Right Spread): The `180`-Important & `107`-Compensated Gene Landscape**

- **ARG1-Independent (`3`):** `WRKY2` (`At5g56270`), `At3g08590`, `At3g30843` (`75/78` `WT` genes depend on `ARG1`).

- **ARG1-Dependent (`24` stringent + `51` partial):** `12` voided (`PSK4`) + `12` **Required** pre-set on ground in `ARG1 KO` (`Subtilase` `At1g30600`, `CYP71B2`, `PEN2`).

- **Corrected (`102`):** Silent in `WT` (`FWt : GWt`), actively adjusted by `ARG1 KO` in orbit to match `WT` levels (`TIP1;1`, `MATE`, `NHX2`, `SPSA1`, `SPI`, `CPK9`, `RALF23`).

- **Compensated (`107`):** Genotype-specific bypasses (`XYL1`, `XTH9`, `XTH4`, `XTH8` down; `POL`, `SGR7`/`SHR` down; `PRA1.G2`, `STP14` up).

- **Cross-Mission (`BRIC-16` vs. `BRIC-17` `WT`):** Only **1** shared DEG (`At5g62710`).

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Series & Volume:** *Roots in Orbit: The NASA OSDR Plant Chronicles* — **Volume 19**

- **Title:** *The Unfolded Citadel: HSFA2 & the Non-Thermal Stress Logic of Undifferentiated Cells*

- **Study DOI:** `10.26030/bjyc-pj66`

- **Source Accession:** `GSE95388`

- **Payload & Mission:** `BRIC-17-1` (*Biological Research In Canisters-17-1: Undifferentiated Cell development in Arabidopsis plants in Microgravity* — *Cellular Expression Logic [CEL]* experiment) aboard SpaceX `CRS-2` (`SpaceX-2`; launched `03/01/2013`, berthed `03/03/2013`, unberthed/splashed down `03/26/2013`, returned to PIs at `SLSL` `04/02/2013`)

- **Primary Publication:** Zupanska, A.K., LeFrois, C., Ferl, R.J., & Paul, A.-L. (2019). *HSFA2 Functions in the Physiological Adaptation of Undifferentiated Plant Cells to Spaceflight*. *Int. J. Mol. Sci.* 20(2):390. `PMC6359015` | PMID: `30658467` | DOI: `10.3390/ijms20020390`

- **Organism & Genotype:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* (`Col-0`) hypocotyl-derived undifferentiated callus/cell cultures (`14 d` old at fixation): Wild Type (`WT`, `n = 5` FLT, `n = 5` GC) vs. `HSFA2 KO` T-DNA insertion mutant (`SALK_008978C`, `n = 3` FLT, `n = 3` GC; `n = 16` total)

- **Hardware & Conditions:** `BRIC-PDFU` (`BRIC-LED` with LEDs disabled, `24 h` continuous dark) in `60 mm` Petri plates on `6.5 mL` MS + `3%` sucrose + `2,4-D` + `0.8%` agar; `ISS-US Laboratory` (`10 d` orbital growth) vs. `OES` / `ISSES` ground control chamber at `KSC` `SLSL` (`24–48 h` telemetry-delayed replication)

- **Preservation & Assays:** In-orbit `RNAlater` fixation at Day 10 → `MELFI` (`-80 °C`) after `24 h`; `Affymetrix GeneChip Arabidopsis ATH1 Genome Array` (`ATH1-121501`); `R 3.0.0` / `Limma` / `MAS 5.0` (`P < 0.01`, `|log2 FC| > 1`)

- *(Chronology Note: `OSD-148`–`OSD-204` were verified as non-plant studies—rodent, human, microbial, *C. elegans*, and *Helix lucorum*—including `OSD-177` [*Fusarium oxysporum* isolated from ISS *Zinnia*]; `OSD-205` is the next sequential plant study after `OSD-147`.)*

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **The `Col-0` Wild-Type Callus Collective (`WT`, `GWt` / `FWt`):** Five flight and five ground replicates of undifferentiated hypocotyl cells—the same `WT` baseline from `OSD-147`—carrying an intact `HSFA2` (`AT2G26150`) master switch (`4171` raw ground signal) and adapting to orbit with a lean `78`-DEG script.

- **The `HSFA2 KO` Vanguard (`SALK_008978C`, `GHsf` / `FHsf`):** Three flight and three ground replicates crippled by a `-7.27 log2 FC` (`39` vs. `4171`, `P = 2.9 × 10^-9`) loss of `HSFA2`. They launch into space already carrying `349` baseline transcriptional scars and chronic endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress.

- **The ER Folding & UPR/ERAD Corps (`PDIL1-2`, `PDIL2-3`, `AERO1`, `HRD3A`, `CUL2`):** Disulfide isomerases, oxidoreductins, and ubiquitin-ligase/ER-associated degradation sentinels. `HSFA2 KO` keeps `PDIL1-2` and `AERO1` blazing on Earth and recruits `PDIL2-3` and `HRD3A` in orbit to clear misfolded protein aggregates.

- **The Cell Wall & Membrane Architects (`ATCSLC12`, `SRF5`, `XTH4`, `EXPL1`, `QUA1`, `TBL45`):** In orbit, `WT` upregulates `ATCSLC12` (`+1.9 log2 FC`) and `PEN2` (`+1.4`) to reinforce its wall, while `HSFA2 KO` drops `XTH4` (`-2.4`), `EXPL1` (`-1.4`), `QUA1` (`-2.0`), and `TBL45` (`-2.4`), risking cell-wall thinning.

- **The Soloist & The Reversed Trio (`SOT12`/`ST1`, `AT3G10400`, `AT4G03570`, `PMS1`):** The only four genes shared by both genotypes' flight-vs-ground responses—led by `SOT12` (`AT2G03760`), the sole gene upregulated in both (`+1.1` in `WT`, `+1.0` in `HSFA2 KO`).

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Launch & Environmental Shift (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1:** Splash page. Inside the Kennedy Space Center `SLSL`, two identical `60 mm` Petri dishes sit side by side under black cloth. Caption: *Same `SpaceX-2` canister. Same `BRIC-17-1` darkness. Two radically different starting states.* On the left, `WT` `Col-0` callus cells glow with steady chaperone homeostasis (`HSFA2` signal: `4171`). On the right, `HSFA2 KO` (`SALK_008978C`) cells flicker with amber ER-stress alarms (`HSFA2` signal: `39`).

**Page 2:** Cutaway of the `HSFA2 KO` endoplasmic reticulum before launch. Chaperone bays sit half-empty: `DNAJ` (`At3g08910`, `-3.2`), `MGE2` (`-2.5`), and `HSP21` (`-1.3`) are powered down. Unfolded polypeptides pile up at the ER lumen.

**Page 3:** Emergency bells ring in the `GHsf` ER. Oxidoreductin `AERO1` (`+2.9`) and disulfide isomerases `PDIL1-2` (`+2.0`) and `PDIL2-1/UNE5` (`+1.1`) scramble to weld disulfide bonds, while drought/salt responders `RCI2A` (`+1.5`), `dehydrin` (`+1.3`), and `DREB2B` (`+1.1`) fire off false environmental-stress flares.

**Page 4:** Wide shot of `GHsf : GWt`—`349` genes (`115` up, `234` down) already separated before liftoff. Narration: *When you knock out `HSFA2`, you don't disable one gene. You launch `349` altered baselines into orbit.*

**Page 5:** `03/01/2013`, `10:10 EST`. SpaceX `CRS-2` (`SpaceX-2`) Falcon 9 roars off Pad 40. Inside the sealed, unlit `BRIC-LED` canisters (LEDs disabled), `WT` and `HSFA2 KO` plates ride twelve minutes to orbit, berthing with the ISS on `03/03/2013`.

**Page 6:** Forty-eight hours behind, the `OES` / `ISSES` ground control chamber at `KSC` mirrors the downlinked cabin temperature, humidity, and `CO2` telemetry. Two parallel timelines lock into step.

**Page 7:** Microgravity settles over the `ISS-US Laboratory`. Inside the `PDFU` cassettes, `WT` cells lose their downward gravity vector. No heat shock strikes—temperature stays nominal—yet the cell wall and endomembrane begin to shift.

**Page 8:** `WT` reads the subtle mechanical distortion at its periphery. It doesn't panic; it pulls a compact `78`-gene playbook (`46` up, `32` down). `At3g18260` (Reticulon, `+3.1`) and `PDIL1-2` (`+1.2`) step up to steady the ER.

**Page 9:** Meanwhile, inside `HSFA2 KO`, the pre-existing ER backlog collides with microgravity. Without `HSFA2` to coordinate chaperone capacity, the mutant's transcriptional switchboard lights up with `221` DEGs (`112` up, `109` down)—nearly three times `WT`'s count.

**Page 10:** Split-panel contrast: `WT` (`78` DEGs) glides through a surgical adjustment; `HSFA2 KO` (`221` DEGs) thrashes across defense, starvation, and morphogenesis networks just to hold the line.

### Act II: The Molecular Battle (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11:** Deep inside `HSFA2 KO`'s ER-to-Golgi corridor (`FHsf : FWt`, `220` DEGs). Misfolded glycoproteins jam the exit gates. `HRD3A` (`+1.2`) flags the aberrant cargo for `ERAD` ubiquitin-proteasome demolition.

**Page 12:** Vesicle-trafficking reinforcements rush the bottlenecks: `ATARFA1D` (`+1.7`), `Coatomer beta'` (`+1.1`), `Target SNARE` (`+1.5`), and `Ypt/Rab-GAP` (`At3g49350`, `+2.4`) try to force secretory traffic through, while `RMR1` (`-1.7`) and calcium pumps `ACA9` (`-2.6`) and `ACA2` (`-1.7`) power down.

**Page 13:** At the plasma membrane, `HSFA2 KO` bristles with hyper-induced LRR receptor kinases—`SRF5` (`+2.2`), `At5g65240` (`+1.9`), and `BIR1` (`+1.2`)—cranking up extracellular sensitivity to compensate for lost intracellular coordination.

**Page 14:** Outside, at the cell wall, the two genotypes diverge sharply. `WT` boosts `Subtilase` (`At1g30600`, `+2.5`), `ATCSLC12` cellulose-synthase-like (`+1.9`), and `PEN2` (`+1.4`) to remodel and fortify its wall.

**Page 15:** Across the divide, `HSFA2 KO` starves its own wall construction: `XTH4` (`-2.4`), `EXPL1` (`-1.4`), `GASA1` (`-1.4`), `EXO` (`-1.1`), `QUA1` (`-2.0`), and `TBL45` (`-2.4`) all plummet, thinning the wall and triggering herbivore/wounding alarms (`AOP1.1` `+3.7`, `NSP5` `+1.4`, `SRG1` `+1.1`).

**Page 16:** Inside `HSFA2 KO` plastids, energy reserves falter. Starch-biosynthesis enzymes `PGM` (`-2.2`), `ISA1` (`-1.7`), and `NdhN` (`-2.4`) drop, while `DIN3` (`+1.2`), `DIN4` (`+1.3`), `ALDH6B2` (`+1.2`), and `MCCB` (`+1.1`) burn branched-chain amino acids under perceived sugar starvation.

**Page 17:** The Two-Dimensional Map (`Figure 2` & `Figure 5` brought to life). Four glowing categories crystallize from the cross-comparison: **Required** (`10` genes), **Corrected** (`66` genes), **`HsfA2`-Dependent** (`7` genes), and **Compensated** (`53` genes).

**Page 18:** Spotlight on the **10 Required** genes: `CUL2`, `PDIL1-2`, `At3g18260`, `At1g30600`, and `PEN2` rise in `WT` during flight to reach the exact ceiling `HSFA2 KO` had already hit on Earth. Narration: *`HSFA2 KO` arrived in orbit pre-stressed at the required setpoint.*

**Page 19:** Spotlight on the **66 Corrected** genes (`61` up, `5` down): `GAMMA-TIP` (`+3.1`), `ATNRT2.7` (`+2.4`), `ATPME1` (`+1.1`), `MLO7` (`+1.9`), `ILL6` (`+1.9`), and `DIN3` (`+1.2`) climb in `HSFA2 KO` flight cells to match `WT`'s spaceflight level—genes a `WT`-only study would never have seen.

**Page 20:** Spotlight on the **7 `HsfA2`-Dependent** genes (`ATCSLC12` up in `WT`; `SRF5`, `At5g19070`, `At2g43240` down in `WT`) and the **53 Compensated** genes (`ATPDIL2-3`, `ATGSTU25`, `Coatomer beta'` up; `ACA9`, `ACA2`, `RMR1` down in `HSFA2 KO`).

**Page 21:** Amid `295` combined physiological-adaptation DEGs, only **4 genes** overlap between `WT` and `HSFA2 KO`. Three flip in opposite directions (`AT3G10400`, `AT4G03570`, `PMS1`—up in `WT`, down in `HSFA2 KO`).

**Page 22:** One lone gene stands together in the same direction: `AT2G03760` (`SOT12`/`ST1`, steroid sulfotransferase), glowing `+1.1` in `WT` and `+1.0` in `HSFA2 KO`—the sole shared vertical anchor across both genotypes.

### Act III: Fixation & Data Epilogue (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23:** Day 10 on orbit. Crew members actuate the `PDFU` plungers. `RNAlater` floods all `60 mm` Petri dishes simultaneously, freezing every transcript in place without opening the canisters.

**Page 24:** Twenty-four hours post-fixation, the `BRIC` canisters slide into the `-80 °C` `MELFI` freezer aboard the ISS. Forty-eight hours later, the `OES` ground controls follow into `-80 °C` storage at `KSC`.

**Page 25:** `03/26/2013`: `SpaceX-2` Dragon unberths and splashes down in the Pacific. By `04/02/2013`, the frozen canisters return to the PIs at `SLSL`.

**Page 26:** Lab montage in Gainesville: `Qiashredder`/`RNeasy` RNA extraction, `Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer` QC, `Ovation Pico WTA` cDNA synthesis, `Encore Biotin` labeling, and `16 h` hybridization onto `Affymetrix ATH1` arrays (`n = 16`).

**Page 27:** `R 3.0.0` / `Limma` / `MAS 5.0` pipelines crunch the fluorescence intensities (`P < 0.01`, `|log2 FC| > 1`). Heatmaps of `78`, `221`, `349`, and `220` genes resolve on screen.

**Page 28:** Side-by-side comparison with `Vol. 18` (`OSD-147`, `ARG1 KO`): Both knockouts rode the same `SpaceX-2` flight and shared the same `WT` baseline, yet disabling `ARG1` (gravity-sensing) vs. `HSFA2` (protein-folding/stress network) carved distinct compensatory routes.

**Page 29:** Synthesis panel: `HSFA2` is far more than a thermal switch. In microgravity, it governs ER protein homeostasis, cell-wall remodeling, plasma-membrane receptor tuning, and starch/BCAA metabolism.

**Page 30:** Closing vista of the ISS cupola over Earth's limb. Narration: *Both `WT` and `HSFA2 KO` survived ten days in orbit—proving plant cells can adapt without their master heat-shock factor, but only at triple the transcriptional cost.*

**Pages 31–32:** Full-bleed **Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** (detailed in Section 4).

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Left Spread (Page 31): Mission Architecture & 2D Comparison Matrix

- **Flight & Hardware:** `BRIC-17-1` (`CEL` payload) | `SpaceX-2` (`CRS-2`, `03/01/2013`–`03/26/2013`) | `10 d` dark growth in `BRIC-PDFU` (`BRIC-LED` LEDs off) | `RNAlater` at Day 10 → `MELFI` (`-80 °C`) | `OES`/`ISSES` ground control (`24–48 h` delay).

- **Sample Design (`n = 16` `ATH1` arrays):** `WT` `Col-0` (`5` FLT, `5` GC) vs. `HSFA2 KO` `SALK_008978C` (`3` FLT, `3` GC) hypocotyl-derived undifferentiated callus (`14 d` old).

- **Knockout Validation:** `HSFA2` (`AT2G26150`) ground raw signal `4171` (`WT`) vs. `39` (`HSFA2 KO`), `log2 FC = -7.27` (`P = 2.9 × 10^-9`).

- **DEG Counts (`P < 0.01`, `|log2 FC| > 1`):**

  - `FWt : GWt` (WT physiological adaptation): **`78`** (`46` up, `32` down)

  - `FHsf : GHsf` (`HSFA2 KO` physiological adaptation): **`221`** (`112` up, `109` down)

  - `GHsf : GWt` (Ground-adapted genotypic difference): **`349`** (`115` up [`33%`], `234` down [`67%`])

  - `FHsf : FWt` (Spaceflight-adapted genotypic difference): **`220`** (`95` up, `125` down)

### Right Spread (Page 32): Cross-Dimensional Gene Classes & Key Findings

- **Physiological Adaptation Overlap (`FWt:GWt` ∩ `FHsf:GHsf`):** **`4` genes** total — **`1`** concordant (`AT2G03760` / `SOT12` `+1.1` WT, `+1.0` KO); **`3`** discordant (`AT3G10400`, `AT4G03570`, `AT4G02460` `PMS1`).

- **Persistent Genotypic Difference (`GHsf:GWt` ∩ `FHsf:FWt`):** **`28` genes** (e.g., `GSTU1`, `GSTU3`, `GSTU24`, `CEF`, `SecY`, `ROL1`, `NAP5`).

- **Four Functional Adaptation Classes:**

  - **Required (`10`):** WT adjusts in flight to `HSFA2 KO`'s pre-stressed ground level (`CUL2`, `ATPDIL1-2`, `At3g18260`, `At1g30600`, `PEN2`).

  - **Corrected (`66`; `61` up, `5` down):** `HSFA2 KO` adjusts in flight to match `WT` spaceflight levels (`GAMMA-TIP`, `ATNRT2.7`, `ATPME1`, `MLO7`, `ILL6`, `DIN3`, `ALDH6B2`, `MCCB`).

  - **`HsfA2`-Dependent (`7`):** WT-only flight adaptation (`ATCSLC12` up; `SRF5`, `At5g19070`, `At2g43240` down).

  - **Compensated (`53`):** `HSFA2 KO`-only flight adaptation (`ATPDIL2-3`, `ATGSTU25`, `Coatomer beta'`, `Target SNARE` up; `ACA9`, `ACA2`, `RMR1` down).

- **Core Takeaway:** `HSFA2` has non-thermal roles in spaceflight adaptation—governing ER protein-folding homeostasis, cell-wall remodeling, plasma-membrane kinase signaling, and starch/BCAA metabolism.
