- **Payload & Mission:** **APEX03-2** (*Advanced Plant Experiment 03-2* / **TAGES-ISA**), flown aboard **SpaceX-5 (`CRS-5`)** (launched `January 10, 2015`; docked `Jan 12–13`; plates unwrapped `Jan 26`; harvested at **Day 4** and **Day 8**; returned `Feb 15, 2015`) inside the **Vegetable Production System (`VPS/Veggie`)** on the `ISS` Columbus Module, paired with a `48-h` delayed ground control in `Veggie` inside the **ISS Environmental Simulator (`ISSES`)** at Kennedy Space Center (`KSC`).

- **Primary Publications:**

  - Califar, B., Sng, N.J., Zupanska, A., Paul, A.-L., & Ferl, R.J. (2020). *Root Skewing-Associated Genes Impact the Spaceflight Response of Arabidopsis thaliana*. *Frontiers in Plant Science* `11`:`239` (DOI: `10.3389/fpls.2020.00239`, `PMC7064724`, PMID: `32194611`).

  - Beisel, N.S., Noble, J., Barbazuk, W.B., Paul, A.-L., & Ferl, R.J. (2019). *Spaceflight-induced alternative splicing during seedling development in Arabidopsis thaliana*. *npj Microgravity* `5`:`9` (DOI: `10.1038/s41526-019-0070-7`).

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* wild-type `Col-0` (`CS70000`) and `WS` (`CS915`), alongside T-DNA root-skewing mutants `spr1` (`CS6547`, `Col-0` background) and `sku5` (`CS16268`, `WS` background) — whole **roots** dissected at **4 days (`4d`)** (`5–8` roots/rep) and **8 days (`8d`)** (`2–3` roots/rep), `n = 4` biological replicates.

- **Hardware & Conditions:** `100 mm × 15 mm` Petri plates (`50 mL` `0.5% Phytagel`, `0.5× MS`, `0.5%` sucrose, `1×` Gamborg's Vitamin Mixture), `Micropore` tape, wrapped in `Duvetyne` Black-Out Fabric within `< 10 min` of seed wetting, stowed at `4–10 °C`, then grown vertically in `Veggie` under constant LEDs (`100–135 µmol m^-2 s^-1`).

- **Preservation & Assays:** Harvested on orbit by **CDR Butch Wilmore** into `RNAlater`-filled **KSC Fixation Tubes (`KFTs`)** (`12 h` ambient perfusion → `-80 °C` `MELFI`). Total RNA (`Qiashredder` + `RNeasy`, `10 ng`) converted via `SMART-Seq v4` (`8` cycles) → `150 pg` cDNA → `Nextera` tagmentation → **Illumina `NextSeq 500`** (`5` flow cells, `2 × 75 bp`, `~40M` paired-end reads/sample; `502M` total reads aligned with `STAR v2.5.1b` to `TAIR10` [`Col-0`/`spr1`] and `WS` [Gan et al., 2011], `Picard`, `Cufflinks`/`Cuffdiff v2.2.1`, `FDR < 0.05`).

- **Chronology Note:** `OSD-218` follows `OSD-217` (Vol. 23) as the next sequential plant study in OSDR, shifting from `11-day` `WS` organ methylomes (`OSD-217`) to `4d` vs. `8d` root development and skewing genetics across `Col-0`, `WS`, `spr1`, and `sku5` on the exact same `SpaceX-5` mission.

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Brandon Califar, Natasha J. Sng & Dr. Agata Zupanska (University of Florida):** Returning from `OSD-210` (`Vol. 21`), `OSD-217` (`Vol. 23`), and `OSD-205` (`Vol. 19`), they dissect how two opposite root-skewing mutations—`spr1` and `sku5`—reshape *Arabidopsis* root navigation and transcriptomic cost in microgravity.

- **Dr. Anna-Lisa Paul & Dr. Robert J. Ferl (Principal Investigators, University of Florida):** Architects of `APEX03-2` / `TAGES-ISA`, testing whether root skewing—once assumed to require gravity—acts as an active cell-wall remodeling strategy in space.

- **CDR Butch Wilmore (ISS Astronaut) & KSC `ISSES` Crew:** Performing synchronized `4-day` and `8-day` harvests (`KFT` actuation verified via over-the-shoulder ISS video logs so no extra drought stress creeps in).

- **The Two Wild-Type Compass Bearers (`Col-0` vs. `WS`):**

  - **`Col-0` (`CS70000`):** Shows a `4d` deficit in wax and suberin production in orbit relative to `8d` (absent on ground) and `533` "high light early" `ROS` wheel genes at `4d` (`TOAST` analysis, `PMC7076552`).

  - **`WS` (`CS915`):** Uniquely overexpresses photosynthesis-related genes in `4d` orbital roots vs. `8d`, and shortens primary roots by `8d` in flight (`p = 0.000209`).

- **The Two Skewing Mutants (`spr1` vs. `sku5`):**

  - **`SPIRAL1` (`spr1`, `CS6547`, `Col-0`):** Microtubule plus-end tracking linker (`EB1b` partner). Loses `SPR1` → skews **sharply leftward** in spaceflight (`p = 0.00385`), yet acclimates with **fewer DEGs** than `Col-0`!

  - **`SKU5` (`sku5`, `CS16268`, `WS`):** `GPI`-anchored cell-wall/plasma-membrane lipid-raft protein (`ABP1`–`TOR` link). Loses `SKU5` → germination plunges to **`48%`** (`p = 0.00181`), skewing collapses, and `4d` roots erupt with **`5×` more DEGs** than `WS`, flooding `LEA`s (`30–1000×`) and `ABA` dormancy genes!

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: Gravity's Missing Compass (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 (Splash Page)**

- **Visual:** A close-up of two Petri plates floating side by side inside `Veggie` on the `ISS` Columbus Module (`January 2015`): on the left, `Col-0` and `spr1` roots sweep in dramatic leftward arcs across `0.5% Phytagel`; on the right, `WS` and `sku5` roots wander at tangled angles under uniform magenta-white LEDs (`100–135 µmol m^-2 s^-1`).

- **Caption (Narration):** *"For decades, textbooks taught that root skewing—that helical, sideways drift across an agar plate—needed gravity to exist."*

- **Caption:** *"Then Arabidopsis went to orbit. Even with zero gravity and zero directional light, the roots still skewed. Something inside the cell wall was steering."*

**Page 2 (4-Panel Grid)**

- **Panel 1:** University of Florida prep bench: seeds of four lines—`Col-0` (`CS70000`), `spr1` (`CS6547`), `WS` (`CS915`), and `sku5` (`CS16268`)—are dried over Drierite for `1` week, sterilized `10 min` in `70%` ethanol, and suspended in sterile water.

- **Panel 2:** A stopwatch ticks! From wetting the seeds to sealing the `100 mm × 15 mm` plates (`Micropore` tape) and wrapping them in light-tight `Duvetyne` Black-Out Fabric takes **under `10` minutes**—locking dormancy before `4–10 °C` transport to KSC.

- **Panel 3:** Plate layout: `35–40` seeds in two rows on `4-day` (`4d`) plates; `12–15` seeds in one row on `8-day` (`8d`) plates.

- **Panel 4:** `January 10, 2015` — `SpaceX-5` launches, docks (`Jan 12–13`), and on `Jan 26`, CDR Butch Wilmore unwraps the plates and slides them vertically into `Veggie`.

**Page 3 (3-Panel Vertical)**

- **Panel 1:** Day 4 (`Jan 30, 2015`) on `ISS`: Wilmore photographs every plate against its `13 mm` grid squares, then harvests seedlings into `RNAlater`-loaded `KFTs` (`12 h` ambient perfusion → `-80 °C` `MELFI`).

- **Panel 2:** Day 8 (`Feb 3, 2015`): second wave photographed and fixed.

- **Panel 3:** KSC `ISSES` ground control (`48-h` delay): telemetry-matched `CO2`, temperature, and lighting, while UF analysts check over-the-shoulder `ISS` video to verify harvest timing matches to the minute.

**Pages 4–6 (3-Page Sequence: Measuring the Unmoored Root)**

- **Page 4:** At UF, thawed `RNAlater` seedlings are examined under an `Olympus SZX12` stereoscope; whole **roots** are cleanly severed from shoots/hypocotyls (`5–8` roots/rep at `4d`, `2–3` at `8d`, `n = 4` biological replicates).

- **Page 5:** `FIJI` / `JFilament` traces primary root lengths (`Figure 2A–B`):

  - `Col-0` vs. `spr1`: **no significant root-length difference** between flight (`FLT`) and ground (`GC`) at `4d` or `8d` (`8d Col-0` `p = 0.0152`, just shy of `p < 0.0125` Bonferroni cutoff).

  - `WS` vs. `sku5`: `FLT WS` roots shorten significantly vs. `GC WS` at `8d` (`p = 0.000209`), whereas `FLT sku5` matches `GC sku5` in length.

- **Page 6:** Polar rose-plots (`Figure 2C`) map `4d` root-tip angles (viewed from behind the media):

  - **`spr1`:** Already skews left on Earth; in spaceflight, it curves **far harder to the left** (`p = 0.00385`), tangling into neighboring roots by Day 8 (`Figure 3F, H`).

  - **`sku5`:** Fails to enhance skewing in orbit—its directional compass goes noisy, and **`FLT sku5` germination plunges to `48%`** (vs. `85%` `WS FLT`, `77%` `sku5 GC`, `93%` `WS GC`; `χ^2 = 15.01, p = 0.00181`)!

**Pages 7–10 (4-Page Sequence: `502` Million Reads of Root Logic)**

- **Page 7:** `Qiashredder` + `RNeasy` extracts ultra-low-input root RNA (`10 ng`), amplified `8` cycles with `SMART-Seq v4` and tagmented (`150 pg` cDNA) via `Nextera`.

- **Page 8:** Five `NextSeq 500` flow cells (`2 × 75 bp`) churn out `~40M` paired-end reads per sample—**`502` million reads** aligned via `STAR v2.5.1b` (`Col-0`/`spr1` → `TAIR10`; `WS`/`sku5` → `WS` reference) and quantified via `Cuffdiff v2.2.1` (`FDR < 0.05`).

- **Page 9:** First surprise (`OSD-218` `Col-0` vs. `WS` `4d → 8d` trajectory):

  - On Earth, both genotypes show a huge developmental gap between `4d` and `8d` root-system genes; **in orbit, that developmental gap shrinks**.

  - `4d` orbital `Col-0` shows a **wax and suberin production deficit** relative to `8d` (unregistered on ground).

  - `4d` orbital `WS` uniquely overexpresses **photosynthesis-related genes** in roots relative to `8d`!

- **Page 10:** `TOAST` (`PMC7076552`) cross-examines `GLDS-218` `Col-0`: **`533` `4d` root DEGs** (and `295` at `8d`) belong to the **"high light early" `ROS` clade**—even though roots sit on agar in `Veggie`, proving `ROS` signaling is triggered by spaceflight itself, not just excess light.

### Act II: Two Mutants, Opposite Costs (Pages 11–22)

**Pages 11–12 (Double-Page Spread: The Metabolic Price Tag)**

- **Visual:** Mirror-image bar charts (`Figures 4 & 9`) comparing `FLT vs. GC` DEG counts at `4d` and `8d`:

  - **Left Side (`Col-0` & `spr1`):** `spr1` uses **fewer** DEGs than `Col-0` to acclimate to spaceflight (with a higher share `> 2-fold`: `41.8%` at `4d`, `22.0%` at `8d` vs. `Col-0` `17.8%`, `12.5%`). Both drop DEG counts sharply from `4d` to `8d`.

  - **Right Side (`WS` & `sku5`):** `sku5` explodes—requiring **`5×` more DEGs than `WS` at `4d`** and **`2×` more at `8d`**, with **nearly `10×` more high-fold DEGs at `4d` than `8d`** (`70.3%` of all `FLT vs. GC` DEGs unique to `sku5`!).

- **Dialogue (Califar):** *"If DEG count is the metabolic cost of adapting to spaceflight, losing `SPR1` actually made adaptation cheaper—while losing `SKU5` made it five times more expensive."*

**Pages 13–16 (4-Page Sequence: Inside the `spr1` Microtubule Shortcut)**

- **Page 13:** Molecular zoom to the cortical microtubule plus-end: wild-type **SPR1** and **EB1b** stabilize growing microtubules, balancing gravitropism and thigmotropism.

- **Page 14:** Without `SPR1`, microtubules turn more dynamic and less rigid—like a flexible suspension bridge. In microgravity (no gravity cue), `spr1` leans harder into thigmotropic leftward skewing, **much like terrestrial cold stress**!

- **Page 15:** Inside `spr1`'s transcriptome (`Figure 5`): across every age and environment, `spr1` constitutively upregulates salicylic-acid defense regulators (`NIMIN-1`, `ALD1`, `DLO1`) and, at `4d` in flight, boosts **apoplast cell-wall remodeling** and **`RuBisCo` / carbon-fixation** genes.

- **Page 16:** **Narration:** *"Because `spr1` microtubules already remodel easily, the mutant snaps into a spaceflight-tolerant cytoskeleton with fewer transcriptional edits."*

**Pages 17–22 (6-Page Sequence: Inside the `sku5` Lipid-Raft Crisis)**

- **Page 17:** Molecular zoom to the outer plasma membrane: **SKU5** is a **`GPI`-anchored protein (`GPI-AP`)** sitting inside sterol-rich **lipid-raft nanodomains** at the cell-wall–membrane nexus, linked via `ABP1`–`ROP2` signaling to the **`TOR` growth hub**.

- **Page 18:** When `sku5` hits microgravity at `Day 4`, its lipid-raft signaling falters—and the root panics as if parched or frozen.

- **Page 19:** Heatmap `Figure 10A` & `Figure 13` erupt in bright yellow (`Log2 fc` `5` to `10` = **`30×` to `1,000×` induction**!):

  - **Late Embryogenesis Abundant (`LEA`) dehydrins & group-4 `LEA`s**

  - **Seed storage proteins:** `CRUCIFERINA` (`CRA1`), `CRUCIFERIN 3` (`CRA3`)

  - **`ABA` & dormancy regulators:** `DOG1`, `RDO5`, `HAI2`, `HAI3`

- **Page 20:** Membrane-rescue alarms join the chorus: chloroplastic aldehyde reductase (`ChlADR`, `AT1G54870`) detoxifying lipid peroxidation, and `TSPO` mobilizing membrane lipids, while **suberin synthesis** drops.

- **Page 21:** By `Day 8`, `sku5`'s `4d` `LEA`/`ROS`/salt storm finally subsides (`10×` drop in high-fold DEGs), shifting toward cell-wall remodeling—while `8d WS` wild-type quietly turns on **chromatin remodeling**.

- **Page 22:** **Dialogue (Paul):** *"Every `4d` mutant and wild-type plate also lit up `karrikin`-response genes—and remember, `max2` karrikin-pathway mutants exaggerate `sku5` skewing too. Spaceflight is pulling on the oldest, deepest cell-wall sensors a root owns."*

### Act III: The Developmental Clock in Orbit (Pages 23–32)

**Pages 23–26 (4-Page Sequence: Reconciling `OSD-217` and `OSD-218`)**

- **Page 23:** Stepping back across the entire `APEX03-2` (`SpaceX-5`) harvest:

  - `OSD-217` (`Vol. 23`, `11d WS` roots & leaves): epigenetic `CHG`/`CHH` methylation & `46%+` `ROS`-linked DEGs.

  - `OSD-218` (`Vol. 24`, `4d` & `8d` `Col-0`/`WS`/`spr1`/`sku5` roots): `533` `ROS`-wheel genes at `4d` (`Col-0`), wax/suberin deficits (`4d Col-0`), `4d` root photosynthesis (`WS`), and opposite `spr1` vs. `sku5` costs!

- **Page 24:** Across *all* four genotypes, `SENESCENCE 1` (`SEN1`) and `ASPARAGINE SYNTHETASE 1` (`ASN1`)—core skewing-network candidates—are co-regulated in spaceflight (`Figure 13`).

- **Page 25:** **Dialogue (Ferl):** *"Notice what didn't change in `spr1` or `sku5` in flight: root length. Neither gene controls how fast a root grows in space—they control which way it turns, and how hard the cell has to work to stay balanced."*

- **Page 26:** `OSD-218` (`GLDS-218`, DOI `10.26030/pddm-th52`) enters OSDR alongside `Beisel et al. (2019)` (alternative splicing) and `Califar et al. (2020)` (*Frontiers in Plant Science*, `PMC7064724`).

**Pages 27–30 (4-Page Sequence: Leaving the ISS for `SJ-10`)**

- **Page 27:** Final look at `Veggie` aboard the `ISS`: `Col-0` and `WS` have taught us that **genetic background** and **developmental age (`4d` vs. `8d` vs. `11d`)** can flip a plant's spaceflight strategy completely.

- **Page 28:** A horizon shift: from U.S. `SpaceX-5` (`ISS`) back to China's recoverable satellite program—five years after `Shenzhou 8` (`Vol. 22`, `OSD-213`), China launches **`SJ-10`** (`Shijian-10`).

- **Page 29:** On `SJ-10`, another *Arabidopsis* methylome experiment waits to be compared directly against `OSD-217`'s `ISS` methylome.

- **Page 30:** **Narration:** *"Next in the archive: `OSD-219` and `OSD-220`—single-base methylomes aboard `SJ-10`."*

**Pages 31–32 (Full-Bleed Mission Debrief Infographic Spread)** *(Detailed in Section 4 below.)*

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Left Spread (Page 31): `APEX03-2` (`SpaceX-5`) Root-Skewing & Developmental Matrix

- **Header Banner:** `OSD-218 / GLDS-218 (GSE95373; Companion GSE95620 / GSE95582) — SpaceX-5 Veggie Root Timecourse`

- **Experimental Matrix (`4d` & `8d` Whole Roots, `n = 4` reps, `100–135 µmol m^-2 s^-1` LEDs):**

  - **Wild-Type `Col-0` (`CS70000`) & Mutant `spr1` (`CS6547`):** Aligned to `TAIR10` (`STAR v2.5.1b`).

  - **Wild-Type `WS` (`CS915`) & Mutant `sku5` (`CS16268`):** Aligned to `WS` reference (Gan et al., 2011).

  - **Sequencing Depth:** `SMART-Seq v4` (`10 ng` RNA) + `Nextera` → `NextSeq 500` (`5` flow cells, `2 × 75 bp`, `~40M` PE reads/sample, `502M` total aligned reads).

- **Morphology & Germination (`FIJI` / `JFilament`):**

  - **Germination:** `Col-0` & `spr1` `100%` (`GC` & `FLT`); **`sku5` `FLT` drops to `48%`** vs. `WS FLT` `85%`, `sku5 GC` `77%`, `WS GC` `93%` (`χ^2 = 15.01, p = 0.00181`).

  - **Root Length:** `WS FLT` shorter than `WS GC` at `8d` (`p = 0.000209`); `spr1` and `sku5` show **no `FLT` vs. `GC` length change**.

  - **Root Skewing:** `4d spr1` skews **more severely leftward** in `FLT` (`p = 0.00385`); `sku5` loses directional skewing precision in `FLT`.

### Right Spread (Page 32): Opposite Transcriptomic Strategies (`OSD-218` + `PMC7064724`)

- **`Col-0` vs. `WS` (`4d → 8d` Developmental Trajectory, `OSD-218`):**

  - **`4d Col-0` Flight:** Wax and suberin production deficit vs. `8d` (absent on ground); `533` `4d` / `295` `8d` root DEGs map to the `TOAST` `"high light early"` `ROS` clade (`PMC7076552`).

  - **`4d WS` Flight:** Uniquely overexpresses photosynthesis-related genes in `4d` roots vs. `8d`.

  - **Shared Trend:** Smaller root-development gene gap between `4d` and `8d` in orbit than on ground.

- **`spr1` vs. `sku5` (`FLT` vs. `GC`, `PMC7064724`):**

  - **`spr1` (Cortical Microtubule Linker):** **Fewer DEGs** than `Col-0` (`41.8%` `> 2-fold` at `4d`, `22.0%` at `8d`), constitutively upregulating SA defense (`NIMIN-1`, `ALD1`, `DLO1`) and `4d` apoplast/`RuBisCo` genes → *loss of `SPR1` lowers adaptation cost*.

  - **`sku5` (`GPI`-Anchored Lipid-Raft Protein):** **`5×` more DEGs than `WS` at `4d`**, **`2×` more at `8d`** (`~10×` more high-fold DEGs at `4d` than `8d`), inducing `LEA`s (`30–1000×`), `ABA`/dormancy (`DOG1`, `RDO5`, `HAI2`, `HAI3`), `ChlADR`, `TSPO`, and `ROS` pathways → *`SKU5` is critical for spaceflight membrane/stress homeostasis*.

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Series:** *Roots in Orbit: The NASA OSDR Plant Chronicles* — **Volume 25**

- **Title:** *The Recoverable Epigenome*

- **OSDR / GeneLab Accession:** `OSD-220` / `GLDS-220` (NASA Open Data Portal | Data.gov)

- **Chronology Note:** `OSD-219` is skipped as a non-plant OSDR accession; Volume 25 advances directly from `OSD-218` (Vol. 24, `APEX03-2` root skewing) to `OSD-220` (`SJ-10` *Arabidopsis* methylome).

- **Primary Repository & Publication:** NCBI SRA `SRP134216`; Xu et al. (2018), *npj Microgravity* 4:12, DOI `10.1038/s41526-018-0046-z` (PMC6043569)

- **Mission & Vehicle:** Chinese Recoverable Scientific Satellite **`SJ-10`** (`Shijian-10`), launched from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on **April 6, 2016** (`01:38`) and landed **April 18, 2016** (`16:30`)

- **Hardware:** Custom two-unit polysulfone culture chamber assembly with gas-permeable membrane windows, canal system, pump support system, and tube-connected `RNAlater®` fixative unit designed by the Shanghai Institute of Technical Physics (SITP), Chinese Academy of Sciences (no `1g` onboard centrifuge)

- **Organism & Genotype:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* ecotype Columbia (`Col-0`)

- **Assay & Sequencing:** Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing (**WGBS / BS-Seq**) on **Illumina HiSeq 2500** (`6` pooled samples: `S1–S3` flight vs. `G1–G3` `1g` ground control; `49` seedlings per chamber, fixed in orbit at `60 h`), plus `11 d` live-returned seedlings (`n = 4` plants, `n = 8` true leaves) for morphometry

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Dr. Weiming Cai (Principal Investigator):** Lead scientist at the Shanghai Institute of Plant Physiology and Ecology (CAS), who designed the `SJ-10` plant epigenetics investigation to test whether microgravity rewrites cytosine methylation at single-base resolution (PMC6043569).

- **Peipei Xu & Haiying Chen (Co-First Authors):** Experimentalists who pre-cultured `Col-0` seedlings three days before launch, processed the `RNAlater®`-fixed orbital samples `4 h` after capsule recovery, and built the bisulfite-converted libraries.

- **Jing Jin (Co-Author):** Bioinformatic collaborator who mapped WGBS reads with `Bismark` and called differentially methylated regions (DMRs) via `swDMR` across all five *Arabidopsis* chromosomes.

- **Cultivation Unit 1 (`S1–S3`):** Three independent polysulfone chambers, each housing `49` `Col-0` seedlings on half-strength MS (`1%` phytagel) under `16 h` light (`8000 lx`) / `8 h` dark at `22 ± 1 °C`, chemically arrested in orbit with `RNAlater®` at **60 hours** of microgravity (`10⁻³` to `10⁻⁴ g`).

- **Cultivation Unit 2 (The Survivors):** Four `Col-0` seedlings grown continuously for **11 days** in orbit and returned alive inside the `SJ-10` reentry capsule, revealing expanded true leaves (`0.179 ± 0.023 cm²` vs. `0.145 ± 0.020 cm²` on Earth, `p < 0.05`).

- **The Launch Simulator (`330 s` Hypergravity):** Ground control rig reproducing `SJ-10`'s two-stage ascent overload (`4.8g` for `150 s` + `6.0g` for `180 s`) to prove that `ARF1` hypermethylation during launch moves opposite to the `60 h` microgravity signature.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: The Capsule and the Clock (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 (Splash Page):** Full-bleed orbital view of China's **Shijian-10 (`SJ-10`)** recoverable satellite gliding over the Gobi Desert at `01:38` on **April 6, 2016** (PMC6043569). Cutaway inset reveals two compact polysulfone cultivation units glowing under `8000 lx` LEDs. **Caption:** *"Volume 23 mapped the methylome of ISS seedlings after 11 days in Veggie. Now, in a recoverable capsule built for 12 days of free flight, the question narrows to 60 hours."*

**Page 2 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, `3` days pre-launch. Peipei Xu transfers germinated *Arabidopsis* `Col-0` seedlings from Petri dishes (`4 °C` stratification `3 d`, germination `3 d`) into SITP polysulfone culture chambers (`49` seedlings per chamber).

- *Panel 2:* Close-up of the SITP hardware: gas-permeable membrane windows, canal tubing, and the pump-driven `RNAlater®` reservoir (PMC6043569).

- *Panel 3:* Weiming Cai checks the telemetry specs: `22 ± 1 °C`, `16 h` light / `8 h` dark, and no `1g` centrifuge—every gram of mass inside `SJ-10` is rationed.

- *Panel 4:* Launch ignition. Telemetry gauge spikes: **Stage 1: `4.8g` (`150 s`) → Stage 2: `6.0g` (`180 s`)**.

**Page 3 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Orbital insertion. The g-meter drops to **`10⁻³` to `10⁻⁴ g`**. Inside Cultivation Unit 1, droplets of condensation bead along the chamber walls.

- *Panel 2:* `60 hours` into microgravity. Automated pumps engage, flooding Cultivation Unit 1 with `RNAlater®` through tube connectors to freeze every `5-methylcytosine` (`5mC`) mark in place.

- *Panel 3:* Parallel ground lab in Shanghai: Haiying Chen triggers the identical `RNAlater®` fixation on `1g` ground controls (`G1–G3`) at the exact `60 h` timestamp.

**Page 4 (5-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **April 18, 2016 (`16:30`)** — `SJ-10` parachute touchdown.

- *Panel 2:* Recovery team opens the payload bay; `4 hours` post-landing, the chambers are chilled to `4 °C` and rushed to Shanghai.

- *Panel 3:* Cultivation Unit 2 is unsealed: four `11-day-old` seedlings are still alive, their first and second true leaves unfurled.

- *Panel 4:* ImageJ measurement screen: microgravity leaves average **`0.179 ± 0.023 cm²`** versus **`0.145 ± 0.020 cm²`** on the ground (`n = 8` leaves, `p < 0.05`).

- *Panel 5:* Xu holds up a Falcon tube containing `49` fixed seedlings from Unit 1 (`S1`): *"They grew bigger in 11 days. The instructions for why were written at 60 hours."*

**Page 5 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* `-80 °C` storage thaw: `20 °C` overnight, `4 °C` overnight, then room temperature to dissolve `RNAlater®` precipitate.

- *Panel 2:* Sonicator hums, shearing `5 mg` of genomic DNA into `~200 bp` fragments.

- *Panel 3:* Three consecutive rounds of `Qiagen EpiTect` bisulfite conversion—unmethylated cytosines flip to uracil (`C → T`), while `5mC` resists conversion. λ DNA spike-in verifies conversion efficiency.

- *Panel 4:* **Illumina HiSeq 2500** flow cell loads `S1–S3` and `G1–G3`.

**Page 6 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Jing Jin launches `Bismark` alignment against the *Arabidopsis* `TAIR10` reference, then runs `swDMR` sliding-window Fisher tests (`p < 0.05`).

- *Panel 2:* Five concentric chromosome tracks bloom on-screen as **Circos plots** for `CpG`, `CHG`, and `CHH` contexts (PMC6043569).

- *Panel 3:* Cai leans in as the global averages resolve: across all three cytosine contexts—**`CpG`**, **`CHG`**, and **`CHH`**—spaceflight seedlings are **globally hypomethylated** compared to ground controls.

**Page 7 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Genomic landscape breakdown: `CpG` shows the highest methylation overall, dipping sharply in `5'UTR` and `3'UTR` relative to coding sequences (`CDS`) and `1500-bp` promoters.

- *Panel 2:* `CHG` flips the pattern—highest in `1500-bp` upstream promoters and `5'UTR`, lowest in `CDS`.

- *Panel 3:* `CHH` peaks in `5'UTR` and `3'UTR` and troughs in promoters and `CDS`.

- *Panel 4:* **Dialogue (Jin):** *"It isn't random erasure. Each sequence context is losing methyl tags in its own architectural compartment."*

**Page 8 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Skeptical challenge on a whiteboard: *"Was it 60 hours of microgravity—or 330 seconds of launch overload?"*

- *Panel 2:* Ground centrifuge test replicates `4.8g` (`150 s`) + `6.0g` (`180 s`), followed by bisulfite PCR on `ABA3`, `DME`, and `ARF1`.

- *Panel 3:* Gel and sequencing readout: `ABA3` and `DME` show **no significant change**; `ARF1` becomes **hypermethylated**—the exact *reverse* of its microgravity hypomethylation trend.

**Page 9 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Dialogue (Cai):** *"Hypergravity pushes `ARF1` methylation up. Microgravity pulls it down. The launch didn't write this methylome—weightlessness did."*

- *Panel 2:* Close-up of the methyltransferase/demethylase table (`Table S1`): `DMT1` (`MET1`), `DME` (`DEMETER`), `AGO2`, and `APE1` all carry **hypermethylated** DMRs in space.

- *Panel 3:* A paradox emerges: even as the global genome loses `5mC`, the enzymes that *write* and *erase* methylation are themselves being methylated.

- *Panel 4:* Transition panel zooming into the **36 differentially methylated transcription factors** (`bHLH`, `bZIP`, `GATA`, `WRKY`, `NAC`).

**Page 10 (2-Panel Act Break):**

- *Panel 1:* Split-screen silhouette of a `Col-0` seedling root and expanding leaf against orbital starlight.

- *Panel 2:* Title card overlay: **ACT II: THE RELAXED WALL AND THE AWAKENED TRANSPOSONS**.

### Act II: The Relaxed Wall and the Awakened Transposons (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* GO enrichment bar chart for **`CHG`** altered methylation-related (`AMR`) genes (`p < 0.05`): **cell wall-related processes**, **carbohydrate metabolism**, **defense response**, and **nitrogen compound transport** (PMC6043569).

- *Panel 2:* Schematic of a plant cell wall under `1g` vs. `10⁻⁴ g`: without gravitational load, mechanical support tissue softens.

- *Panel 3:* `Table S5` gene list scrolls past: cellulose synthase catalytic subunits, callose synthases, **xyloglucan endotransglucosylase**, **beta-galactosidase**, and **beta-glucosidase**.

- *Panel 4:* **Dialogue (Xu):** *"Spaceflight plants lower cell wall rigidity and xyloglucan molecular mass. Now we see the methylome priming those exact wall-loosening enzymes."*

**Page 12 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* GO enrichment for **`CHH`** `AMR` genes: **metabolic/biosynthetic processes**, **signaling transduction**, **oxidation-reduction**, and **lipid biosynthesis**.

- *Panel 2:* Lipid membrane polarity diagram: `CHH` methylation shifts around plasma membrane and cell periphery genes.

- *Panel 3:* GO enrichment for **`CpG`** `AMR` genes: **mRNA transport & nuclear export**, **microtubule-based movement**, **inositol phosphate phosphorylation**, and **telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage**.

- *Panel 4:* Cosmic radiation track piercing a nucleus—linking `CpG` DNA-damage/telomere DMRs to the spaceflight radio-adaptive response.

**Page 13 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* **KEGG pathway bubble plot** (`Fig. 5`): `CHG` DMRs cluster in starch/sucrose metabolism, phenylpropanoid/phenylalanine biosynthesis, glutathione metabolism, **proteasomes**, and **ribosomes**.

- *Panel 2:* `CHH` DMRs light up secondary metabolite biosynthesis and ribosomes.

- *Panel 3:* `CpG` DMRs highlight **ABC transporters**, **nucleotide excision repair**, and **endocytosis**.

**Page 14 (5-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Focus on **Auxin Signaling (`Table S4`)**—the master hormone of gravitropism.

- *Panel 2:* Receptor & F-box tier: `TIR1`, `AFB2`, `AFB5` show altered methylation.

- *Panel 3:* Transcriptional tier: **`ARF1`, `ARF2`, `ARF4`**, and other `ARFs` (`ARF1–6`, `8`, `19`, `21`, `22`) lose methylation, while **`ARF3`, `IAA9`, and `IAA33`** gain hypermethylation.

- *Panel 4:* Transport tier: **`BIG`** (required for polar auxin transport) is **hypermethylated**, alongside `AAO1`/`AAO2` and `ABC` transporters.

- *Panel 5:* **Dialogue (Chen):** *"Perception, signaling, biosynthesis, and polar transport—every link in the auxin chain has an epigenetic fingerprint."*

**Page 15 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Crosstalk across other phytohormones: ethylene (`EIN2`, `EIN3`, `ERF11`, `ERF094`), abscisic acid (`ABA3`—methylation decreased), and brassinosteroids (`BAK1`—methylation decreased).

- *Panel 2:* Transcription factor spotlight: **`MYB65`, `MYB74`, `BHLH35`, `BHLH81`, `BHLH131`, `BZIP68`, `GATA26`, `NAC081`, `NAC100`, `NAC105`, `WRKY7`, `WRKY19`**—all hypermethylated.

- *Panel 3:* Dual-pattern genes (`MYB3R5`, `GATA14`, `BIG`, `BAK1`, `ABA3`) show **both** hyper- and hypomethylated regions on the same locus.

- *Panel 4:* **Dialogue (Cai):** *"Epigenetic regulation in microgravity isn't a blunt dimmer switch. It's a locus-by-locus editing desk."*

**Page 16 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Zooming out from genes to the **dark genome**: pericentromeric heterochromatin and **Transposable Elements (TEs)** (`RepeatMasker`, FDR `p < 0.05`).

- *Panel 2:* Density curves (`Fig. 4a`): across TE bodies and their `1-kb` flanking regions, `S1–S3` drop below `G1–G3` in **`CHG`**, **`CHH`**, and **`CpG`**.

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Jin):** *"When TEs lose their methyl locks, silent transposons wake up—and can act as stress enhancers for nearby genes."*

**Page 17 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* TEs stratified by length into three classes (`Fig. 4b–d`).

- *Panel 2:* **Short TEs (`< 500 bp`):** A dramatic plunge in **`CHG`** and **`CHH`** methylation under microgravity.

- *Panel 3:* **Medium TEs (`500–2000 bp`):** Only a marginal decrease in `CHG` and `CHH`.

- *Panel 4:* **Long TEs (`> 2000 bp`):** `CHG` dips, while `CHH` and `CpG` hold steady—proving **short TEs** are the primary epigenetic shock absorbers of `60 h` microgravity.

**Page 18 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Side-by-side comparison of **Vol. 23 (`OSD-217`, `APEX03-2` ISS `11 d`, `WS`)** and **Vol. 25 (`OSD-220`, `SJ-10` `60 h`, `Col-0`)**.

- *Panel 2:* Both missions flag hormone, cell-wall, and defense-related methylation shifts, yet `SJ-10` captures the **early `60 h` global hypomethylation wave** in `Col-0` without an orbital `1g` centrifuge.

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Cai):** *"Short-duration recoverable satellites give us the acute epigenetic shock; orbital stations give us the chronic adaptation."*

**Page 19 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Connecting `60 h` molecular data back to the `11 d` living survivors in Cultivation Unit 2.

- *Panel 2:* True leaves 1 and 2 of the four space-grown seedlings (`0.179 ± 0.023 cm²`) juxtaposed against ground controls (`0.145 ± 0.020 cm²`).

- *Panel 3:* Mechanistic bridge: auxin-induced cell wall relaxation + hypomethylated cell-wall expansion genes = accelerated early leaf expansion in weightlessness.

- *Panel 4:* **Caption:** *"Without gravity's constant load, the cell wall yields—and the methylome clears the path."*

**Page 20 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Data deposition screen: `SRP134216` uploaded to NCBI SRA, later ingested into NASA GeneLab / OSDR as **`OSD-220` (`GLDS-220`)**.

- *Panel 2:* Publication stamp: *npj Microgravity* `4:12` (**July 12, 2018**) (PMC6043569).

- *Panel 3:* **Caption:** *"A single-base map from a 12-day Chinese satellite enters NASA's open archive—proving plant space biology is a shared global ledger."*

**Page 21 (2-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Empty Cultivation Unit 1 chamber cleaned and archived in Shanghai.

- *Panel 2:* **Caption:** *"One unanswered question remains: if 60 hours rewrites the methylome, what happens when you break a second-messenger lipid pathway—and test it against a true 1g centrifuge in orbit?"*

**Page 22 (Full-Bleed Transition):** The **International Space Station (`ISS`)** gleams above Earth's terminator, its **European Modular Cultivation System (`EMCS`)** twin rotors spinning inside Columbus. **Caption:** *"Next: `OSD-223` — `InsP 5-ptase` transgenic Arabidopsis under true orbital `1g` vs. microgravity."*

### Act III: Synthesis & Mission Debrief (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Summary of the three-tier cytosine architecture (`CpG` in gene bodies/TEs, `CHG` in promoters/`5'UTR`/TEs, `CHH` in `UTRs`/TEs).

- *Panel 2:* Epigenetic feedback loop: `DMT1` (`MET1`), `DME`, `AGO2`, and `APE1` hypermethylation suggests active self-regulation of the methylation machinery itself.

- *Panel 3:* Auxin & cell wall nexus: `TIR1`–`ARF`–`IAA`–`BIG` methylation shifts align with xyloglucan and cellulose synthase remodeling.

- *Panel 4:* Short TE (`< 500 bp`) `CHG`/`CHH` demethylation highlights genome plasticity under acute microgravity.

**Page 24 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Experimental limitations candidly logged: absence of an onboard `1g` centrifuge on `SJ-10` means spaceflight confounders (radiation, fluidics, launch) cannot be 100% separated from microgravity alone.

- *Panel 2:* Counter-evidence panel: `330 s` simulated launch hypergravity reversed `ARF1` methylation and left `ABA3`/`DME` unchanged, isolating microgravity as the dominant signal.

- *Panel 3:* Pooling strategy (`49` seedlings × `3` biological replicates) buffers individual plant noise.

**Page 25 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Epigenetic Breeding Concept:** Tuning methylation of cell-wall and auxin-transport loci (`BIG`, `XTH`, `CESA`) to stabilize crop architecture in orbital greenhouses.

- *Panel 2:* **Transposon Guardrail:** Monitoring short TEs (`< 500 bp`) across multi-generation seed-to-seed spaceflight to prevent unwanted insertional mutations.

- *Panel 3:* **RNA-Seq Pairing Gap:** `OSD-220` captured `WGBS` without matched `RNA-seq` on `S1–S3`—a gap later addressed by multi-generation `SJ-10` follow-up studies.

- *Panel 4:* **OSDR Standardization:** `GLDS-220` / `OSD-220` pairs `SRP134216` raw reads with standardized ISA metadata on Data.gov.

**Page 26 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Timeline strip linking `Shenzhou 8` (`Simbox`, Vol. 22 `OSD-213`), `SpaceX-5` (`APEX03-2`, Vol. 23 `OSD-217` & Vol. 24 `OSD-218`), and `SJ-10` (Vol. 25 `OSD-220`).

- *Panel 2:* Visual contrast: callus microarrays (`OSD-213`) → `11 d` `WS` WGBS (`OSD-217`) → `60 h` `Col-0` WGBS (`OSD-220`).

- *Panel 3:* **Caption:** *"From transcriptomes to single-base epigenomes, plants don't just react to space—they re-index their chromatin."*

**Pages 27–30 (4-Page Epilogue Montage — 1 Panel per Page):**

- *Page 27:* Close-up of a single `Col-0` true leaf (`0.179 cm²`) silhouetted against a `Bismark` methylation browser track.

- *Page 28:* The `SJ-10` reentry capsule resting on the steppe, scorched heatshield cooling in the April dusk.

- *Page 29:* A researcher's gloved hand holding a `200 bp` bisulfite library tube—the bridge between orbital hardware and computational biology.

- *Page 30:* Looking forward: **EMCS** twin rotors (`OSD-223`) awaiting `InsP 5-ptase` seedlings to test lipid second-messenger signaling under true `1g` vs. `μg`.

**Pages 31–32 (Double-Page Spread):** Full-bleed **Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** (detailed in Section 4).

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Left Spread (Page 31) — Mission & Hardware Architecture

- **Top Banner:** `OSD-220 / GLDS-220` | **Mission:** `SJ-10` Recoverable Satellite (`Apr 6–18, 2016`) | **SRA:** `SRP134216` | **Paper:** Xu et al., 2018 (PMC6043569)

- **Hardware Diagram (SITP Two-Unit System):**

  - **Cultivation Unit 1 (Methylome):** Polysulfone chambers with gas-permeable membranes + `RNAlater®` tube-connected fixative unit; `49` `Col-0` seedlings/chamber (`S1–S3` flight, `G1–G3` `1g` ground), fixed in orbit at **`60 h`**.

  - **Cultivation Unit 2 (Phenotype):** Grown **`11 days`** in orbit (`10⁻³` to `10⁻⁴ g`), returned alive (`n = 4` plants, `n = 8` true leaves).

  - **Environment:** `22 ± 1 °C` (`~23 °C` ambient), `~25%` RH, `16 h` light (`8000 lx`) / `8 h` dark, `1/2 MS + 1% phytagel`; **no `1g` onboard centrifuge**.

- **Launch Control Box:** `330 s` simulated launch (`4.8g` `150 s` + `6.0g` `180 s`) → `ABA3` & `DME` unchanged; `ARF1` hypermethylated (opposite to microgravity hypomethylation).

### Right Spread (Page 32) — Single-Base Methylome & Phenotype Findings

- **Assay Pipeline:** `5 mg` DNA (`~200 bp` sonicated) → 3× `Qiagen EpiTect` bisulfite (`λ` DNA control) → **Illumina HiSeq 2500** → `Bismark` + `swDMR` (`p < 0.05`) + `RepeatMasker` (`p < 0.05`).

- **Global & Context Methylation:** Lower global `5mC` in **`CpG`**, **`CHG`**, and **`CHH`** under microgravity (`CpG` highest overall, `CHH` lowest).

- **Key Altered Methylation (`AMR`) Pathways:**

  - **`CHG`:** Cell wall processes (`CESA`, callose synthase, `XTH`, beta-galactosidase/glucosidase), carbohydrate metabolism, defense response, nitrogen transport.

  - **`CHH`:** Oxidation-reduction, lipid biosynthesis, secondary metabolites, phenylpropanoid biosynthesis.

  - **`CpG`:** mRNA nuclear export, microtubule movement, telomere maintenance / DNA damage repair, inositol phosphate phosphorylation, `ABC` transporters.

- **Hormones, TFs & Machinery:** Auxin (`TIR1`, `AFB2/5`, `ARF1–6/8/19/21/22`, `IAA9/33`, `BIG`, `AAO1/2`), ethylene (`EIN2/3`, `ERF11/094`), ABA (`ABA3`), BR (`BAK1`); `~36` TFs (`bHLH`, `bZIP`, `GATA`, `WRKY`, `NAC`); epigenetic enzymes (`DMT1`/`MET1`, `DME`, `AGO2`, `APE1` hypermethylated).

- **Transposable Elements & Leaf Growth:** Short TEs (`< 500 bp`) show sharp `CHG`/`CHH` hypomethylation; `11 d` microgravity leaves are larger (**`0.179 ± 0.023 cm²`** vs. **`0.145 ± 0.020 cm²`**, `p < 0.05`).

## 1. Volume Metadata Header

- **Series:** *Roots in Orbit: The NASA OSDR Plant Chronicles* — **Volume 26**

- **Title:** *The Fractional Gradient*

- **OSDR / GeneLab Accession:** `OSD-223` / `GLDS-223` (NASA OSDR | Data.gov) | DOI: `10.26030/wdtz-v612`

- **Chronology Note:** `OSD-221` (unlisted/non-plant) and `OSD-222` (`STS-135` mouse cerebellum transcriptomics) are skipped; Volume 26 advances from `OSD-220` (Vol. 25, `SJ-10` methylome) to `OSD-223` (*Plant Signaling in Microgravity*).

- **Primary Publications:** Sheppard et al. (2021), *Life* 11(10):1010, DOI `10.3390/life11101010` (PMC8539686); Land et al. (2024), *Front. Plant Sci.* 14:1308713, DOI `10.3389/fpls.2023.1308713` (PMC10800490)

- **Mission & Vehicles:** Launched aboard **STS-135** (Space Shuttle *Atlantis*, **July 2011**); operated on the **International Space Station (`ISS`)**; returned frozen aboard **SpaceX Dragon** (**March 2013**)

- **Hardware:** **European Modular Cultivation System (`EMCS`)** with twin centrifuge rotors (`0g` stationary vs. fractional-`g` spinning) and `TROPI`-like seed cassettes (`27` seeds/membrane); ground reference in **ERM-2** at NASA Ames Research Center (`ARC`) and `OVT` in **ERM-1** at `N-USOC` (Trondheim, Norway)

- **Organism & Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis thaliana* (`Col-0` wild type and transgenic **`InsP 5-ptase`** lines with compromised `InsP₃` signaling)

- **Assay & Sequencing:** `RNA-Seq` (`n = 40` samples in `OSD-223`), `RNAqueous Micro kit` (`RIN > 9.5`), `NEBNext Poly(A)` ultra-directional libraries on **3 lanes of Illumina HiSeq 2500 (`125 bp` single-end)**

## 2. Dramatis Personae (Grounded in Study Data)

- **Dr. Imara Y. Perera (Principal Investigator):** Research Professor at North Carolina State University (with Co-Is Christopher Brown & Heike Winter-Sederoff), investigating how lipid-derived **`InsP₃`** second-messenger signaling and altered gravity reshape *Arabidopsis* transcription (NASA NLSP).

- **James Sheppard & Eric S. Land (Lead Analysts):** NCSU researchers who mapped the root fractional-gravity continuum (`0g` to `0.88g`) in PMC8539686 and paired `Plant Signaling` (`PS`, `OSD-223`) with `Plant RNA Regulation` (`PRR`, `OSD-437`) shoots in PMC10800490.

- **Dr. Colleen J. Doherty & Tiffany A. Toennisson (Co-Investigators):** NCSU molecular biochemists who co-led motif/network analysis and hypergravity (`6.5× g`) validation of heat-shock targets.

- **The `EMCS` Twin Rotors:** Hardware inside the ISS Columbus module that spun `4` Experimental Containers (`ECs`, `5` seed cassettes each) at a radial gradient (`0.53g`, `0.65g`, `0.76g`, `0.88g`, `1.0g`) while holding the second rotor stationary at `μg`.

- **`InsP 5-ptase` Transgenics:** *Arabidopsis* plants constitutively expressing mammalian type I inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase, hydrolyzing `InsP₃` to probe gravity-to-`Ca²⁺` signal transduction.

## 3. 32-Page Chapter Script

### Act I: The Last Shuttle and the Twin Rotors (Pages 1–10)

**Page 1 (Splash Page):** Full-bleed dawn liftoff of **STS-135** (*Atlantis*)—the final Space Shuttle launch in **July 2011**—carrying `80` dry-mounted `TROPI`-like seed cassettes toward the ISS (PMC8539686). **Caption:** *"Volume 25 caught 60 hours of weightlessness inside a free-flying satellite. Now, aboard the final Shuttle, 2,160 dormant seeds ride into orbit to test a sharper instrument: a centrifuge built to dial gravity by tenths."*

**Page 2 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* `35 days` pre-launch at NASA Ames Research Center: Caroline Smith and the NCSU team screen `Col-0` and `InsP 5-ptase` seeds (`≥99%` germination) and mount `27` seeds per black-gridded `PES` membrane (`PALL 65561`) with guar gum, micropyles pointing away from the LEDs.

- *Panel 2:* Close-up of the blotter sandwich: `Whatman #3` / `17 CHR` paper pre-soaked in `0.5× MS` (`pH 5.7`, no sucrose), sealed with `3M` aluminum foil tape.

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Perera):** *"Hydrolyzing `InsP₃` leaves the plants looking normal on Earth—until you tilt them or deny them water. In orbit, we'll see what `InsP₃` actually buys a seedling."*

- *Panel 4:* Engineering Reference Module (`ERM-1`) in Trondheim, Norway (`N-USOC`) and `ERM-2` at NASA ARC: preflight Schedule and Operations Verification Tests (`OVT`/`EVT`).

**Page 3 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Inside the ISS Columbus module, an astronaut slides `4` Experimental Containers (`20` cassettes per rotor) into the **European Modular Cultivation System (`EMCS`)**.

- *Panel 2:* Remote hydration triggers from the ground. Both rotors spin at `1g` for the first **`48 hours`**, giving every seedling an identical initial gravitational cue.

- *Panel 3:* At `48 h`, Rotor A halts (`μg`), while Rotor B holds its spin—creating a **five-step fractional-gravity ladder** across each EC's five cassette slots: **`0.53g` → `0.65g` → `0.76g` → `0.88g` → `1.0g`** (PMC8539686).

**Page 4 (5-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Telemetry readout inside `EMCS`: continuous white LED light, **`24 °C`**, `~20–21% O₂`, ethylene scrubbing, and `CO₂` rising from `~370 ppm` post-purge to `~760 ppm`.

- *Panel 2:* `6-hour` camera downlinks show roots oriented uniformly down the cassette grid thanks to the initial `48 h` `1g` cue (PMC10800490).

- *Panel 3:* Day `5` harvest: the spinning rotor is pulled first, cassettes are transferred straight into the ISS **`MELFI` (`-80 °C`)** freezer, and the `μg` rotor follows.

- *Panel 4:* **March 2013** — **SpaceX Dragon** splashes down, returning the frozen cassettes at cryogenic temperature.

- *Panel 5:* Cold-platform dissection in Raleigh: `RNAlater®` is flooded over each thawed cassette as roots and shoots are separated (`RNAqueous Micro kit`, **`RIN > 9.5`**).

**Page 5 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Quality-control reality check: Position 5 (`1.0g` outer edge) cassettes dried out in several ECs and are excluded from the root gradient model.

- *Panel 2:* The remaining root archive locks in cleanly: **`16` `μg` replicates** vs. **`4` replicates each** at **`0.53g`**, **`0.65g`**, and **`0.88g`** (with `0.76g` reserved for paired `1g`-control analyses).

- *Panel 3:* NCSU Genomic Sciences Laboratory loads **`3` lanes of Illumina HiSeq 2500 (`125 bp` single-end)** across `40` `OSD-223` samples.

- *Panel 4:* `HiSat2` alignment hits a **`97%` mapping rate** against `TAIR10`/`Araport11`, followed by `svaseq` batch correction and `DESeq2`.

**Page 6 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* James Sheppard runs `DESeq2` treating **Gravity as a continuous variable** (`padj < 0.001`), flagging `382` candidates and curating **`101` fractional-`g` responsive genes** (PMC8539686).

- *Panel 2:* Six distinct dose-response curves emerge across `μg`, `0.53g`, `0.65g`, and `0.88g`: **linear up**, **linear down**, **peak up**, **peak down**, **threshold up**, and **threshold down**.

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Sheppard):** *"Genes don't just flip on or off at zero gravity. Some climb linearly toward 1g, some spike at 0.65g, and some hit a plateau the moment 0.53g arrives."*

**Page 7 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Transcription factor curves (`Fig. 3`): **`NFYA1`**, **`SPL6`**, and **`TCP7`** climb steadily with increasing gravity.

- *Panel 2:* **`HM2`** drops linearly as gravity rises, while **`GATA9`** and **`ANAC009` (`FEZ`)** plunge at `0.53g` and plateau through `0.88g`—a **threshold-down** switch.

- *Panel 3:* `20` TFs and coactivators lead the `101`-gene list (`13` rising with `g`, `7` falling with `g`), including root-cap regulator `ANAC009` and lateral-root gravistimulation responder `MYB53`.

- *Panel 4:* **Dialogue (Doherty):** *"Even half a g—nearly Martian to lunar-plus—is enough to trip the `GATA9` and `ANAC009` threshold."*

**Page 8 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* **Heat Shock Proteins (`9` of `101` genes):** `HSP70`, `HSP90.1`, `HSP101`, `HSFA3`, and `DNAJ` (`ATJ10`) all **increase** with increasing `g`, while small chaperone `HSP15.4` peaks in `μg`.

- *Panel 2:* Ground validation (`6.5× g` hypergravity for `4 h` in the dark): qRT-PCR bars shoot past **`> 9-fold`** for `HSP70`, `HSP90.1`, `HSP101`, and `DNAJ` (PMC8539686).

- *Panel 3:* **Caption:** *"Touch didn't trigger `HSP70`, `HSP90.1`, or `HSP101` in prior studies—only gravity did. From microgravity to 6.5g, chaperones track mechanical load."*

**Page 9 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Cell Wall & Defense (`17` and `14` genes):** Pectin lyases (`At3g59850`, `At3g61490`) and pectin acetylesterases (`PAE7`, `PAE12`) peak in **`μg`** and drop as `g` rises—loosening primary walls when weight vanishes.

- *Panel 2:* Meanwhile, **`10` of `12` defense genes**—including `Ca²⁺` channels `CNGC19` and `OSCA1.3`, `CRK11`, `SGT1A`, and `ICS2`—are **lowest in `μg`** and climb with `g` (`CML8` moves opposite).

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Perera):** *"In microgravity, roots soften their pectin walls and quiet their immune sensors. That leaves space crops vulnerable if opportunistic pathogens turn virulent in orbit."*

- *Panel 4:* Auxin & transport markers (`PILS5`, `NDL2`, `DAO2`) rise with `g`, bridging root sensing to hormone flow.

**Page 10 (2-Panel Act Break):**

- *Panel 1:* Split-frame: root cassettes on the left, **shoot tissues** from `PS` (`OSD-223`) and its successor **`PRR` (`OSD-437`)** on the right.

- *Panel 2:* Title card overlay: **ACT II: THE `1g` ALIBI IN THE SHOOTS**.

### Act II: The `1g` Alibi in the Shoots (Pages 11–22)

**Page 11 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Eric Land compares wild-type shoot `RNA-Seq` from **`PS` (`OSD-223`, `0.76g` onboard control)** and **`PRR` (`OSD-437`, `1.0g` onboard control)** (PMC10800490).

- *Panel 2:* Individual `DESeq2` (`padj < 0.05`) yields **`1,819` DEGs** in `PS` (`510` up, `1,309` down in `μg`) and **`1,792` DEGs** in `PRR` (`599` up, `1,193` down).

- *Panel 3:* Hypergeometric overlap test: **`178` shared upregulated** (`p = 9.97 × 10⁻¹⁸⁵`) and **`399` shared downregulated** (`p = 1.63 × 10⁻²⁷²`) genes.

- *Panel 4:* Combined `PS + PRR` re-analysis (`padj < 0.01`) locks in **`1,112` upregulated** and **`1,429` downregulated** microgravity genes.

**Page 12 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Upregulated in `μg` (`1,112` genes):** **`159` transcription factors** (`SPCH`, `WOX3`, `TCP22`, `GATA2`, `HFR1`, `CRF4`, `CRF5`, `ANT`) driving shoot meristem, leaf growth, and photomorphogenesis.

- *Panel 2:* **Auxin surge (`38+` genes):** `PIN3`, `PIN4`, `TIR1`, `AFB2`, `AFB3`, `6` `ARFs` (`ARF1/4/6/16/17/19`), and **`11` `SAURs`** (`9` induced `> 2-fold`, led by `SAUR76` at `log₂FC = 3.14` and `SAUR13` at `2.11`).

- *Panel 3:* **Vesicle & Golgi transport (`50` genes):** Coat protein (`COP`) complex and `Sec23/24` genes light up (`FDR = 3.0 × 10⁻¹⁰`), alongside `7` epigenetic regulators (`5` SET-domain histone methyltransferases, including `3` `SUVH` genes).

- *Panel 4:* Gravitropism genes **`SGR5` (`IDD15`)**, **`IDD14`**, and **`LAZY1`** are also upregulated in `μg`, even with no gravity vector to sediment statoliths.

**Page 13 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* `MEME` motif scan across `500 bp` upstream promoters of the `1,112` `μg`-upregulated genes (`Fig. 3` of PMC10800490).

- *Panel 2:* A razor-sharp consensus emerges: **`5'-GGCCCA-3'`** (**Site II / `Up1` element**, `E = 3.7 × 10⁻¹²`), appearing **`258` times in `174` genes** (`15.6%`) and peaking at `-70 bp` from the transcription start site.

- *Panel 3:* **Dialogue (Land):** *"Site II is the binding signature of `TCP` transcription factors—and `TCP22` itself is upregulated in microgravity."*

**Page 14 (5-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Downregulated in `μg` (`1,429` genes):** A massive dampening of stress programs (`GO:0006950`, `FDR = 4.1 × 10⁻³¹`).

- *Panel 2:* **`120` stress TFs** drop, led by **`15` `ERFs`** (including `7` `DREBs`/`CBF2`), **`12` `WRKYs`** (`WRKY18/40/60`), `4` heat-stress TFs, and `CAMTA2/3/4`.

- *Panel 3:* **`~200` biotic defense genes** and **`~140` abiotic/ABA stress genes** (including `9` of `21` hierarchical ABA-network TFs) fall together.

- *Panel 4:* **`~40` `Ca²⁺` signaling genes** (`CBL1`, `CML24`, `CML37`, `CPK4/15/28/29/32`, `CNGC1/4`, `ACA1`, `KIC`, `KRP1`) are suppressed in `μg`.

- *Panel 5:* **`~100` cell wall genes** (`XTHs`, expansins, peroxidases, `6` dirigent proteins) and **`~300` plastid/chloroplast genes** (`PSI/PSII`, `LHCA`, `NADPH` subunits) are downregulated.

**Page 15 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **The `HY5` Master Switch:** `HY5` (Elongated Hypocotyl 5) targets are significantly enriched in **both** `μg`-upregulated (`p = 2.45 × 10⁻¹¹`, organ development/auxin) and `μg`-downregulated (`p = 1.70 × 10⁻¹²⁰`, stress) gene sets (PMC10800490).

- *Panel 2:* **Natural Antisense Transcripts (`NATs`):** `42` `NATs` up and `30` `NATs` down in `μg`; `29` of the `42` upregulated `NATs` inversely track repressed sense genes (`MYB44`, chloroplast & defense loci).

- *Panel 3:* **microRNAs (`PRR` sRNA-seq):** `miR319c`, `miR863-5p`, and `miR398b-3p` rise in `μg`, repressing targets—`38%` of which localize to the plastid.

- *Panel 4:* Meanwhile, `miR156f-3p` and `miR5654-3p` rise in `1g`, repressing `SPL9` and developmental phase-transition targets.

**Page 16 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* **The Paradox (`Fig. 5` & `Fig. 6`):** Why did `BRIC-19` and other ground-controlled missions report stress and defense genes *upregulated* in space, while `PS` and `PRR` show them *downregulated* in `μg`?

- *Panel 2:* Land adds the **`ERM-2` ground reference controls** to the heatmap alongside onboard `1g` and `μg`.

- *Panel 3:* **The Reveal:** Stress and salt/defense genes are **upregulated in onboard `1g` relative to Earth (`ERM-2`)**, yet **specifically suppressed in `μg` relative to onboard `1g`**!

**Page 17 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Dialogue (Perera):** *"Every plant on the ISS feels radiation, altered gas, and zero convection—that's why onboard `1g` turns on stress genes. But weightlessness itself masks that stress induction."*

- *Panel 2:* Cross-check against `EMCS` `Seedling Growth` (`SG2/SG3`): `54` genes are commonly downregulated in `μg` and `143` in low-`g` (`< 0.1g`) vs. `1g` (PMC10800490).

- *Panel 3:* Contrast with `BRIC-19`: `70` genes reported as upregulated in `BRIC-19` (vs. ground) are actually *downregulated* in `μg` (vs. onboard `1g`).

- *Panel 4:* **Caption:** *"Without an orbital centrifuge, spaceflight stress and microgravity wear the same mask."*

**Page 18 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* `PRR` staggered hydration (`Day 4` vs. `Day 6`): PCA separates `Day 4` and `Day 6` along `PC1` (`53%` variance) under `1g` (`p < 0.05`), but **collapses** `Day 4` and `Day 6` together under `μg`.

- *Panel 2:* `Day 4` shows only `406` `μg` DEGs (`75` up, `331` down), with `210` stress/cell-wall genes already suppressed early.

- *Panel 3:* Time-lapse `EMCS` camera check confirms no delay in radicle emergence—proving the `Day 4 → Day 6` transcriptional convergence is a developmental-window effect, not slow germination.

**Page 19 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Revisiting the **`InsP 5-ptase`** transgenic objective on `OSD-223`: two-way comparisons (`μg` vs. `1g`) across wild type and `InsP₃`-compromised seedlings (NASA OSDR).

- *Panel 2:* Diagram of the phosphoinositide cascade: `PtdInsP₂` → `InsP₃` → `Ca²⁺` release (`CBL`, `CPK`, `CAMTA`, `CNGC`), linking `InsP 5-ptase` hydrolysis to the `40` `Ca²⁺` genes downregulated in `μg`.

- *Panel 3:* Schematic of `PIN` recycling and `PID`/`PDK1` lipid binding, showing how membrane phosphoinositides interface with `PIN3`/`PIN4` auxin efflux.

- *Panel 4:* **Caption:** *"Two-way `μg` vs. `1g` contrasts separate conserved microgravity responses from those gated by `InsP₃`."*

**Page 20 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* NASA GeneLab / OSDR ingestion: `40` `OSD-223` (`GLDS-223`) datasets standardized through `NF_RCP-F v1.0.3` (`STAR v2.7.10a`, `RSEM v1.3.1`, `TAIR10`).

- *Panel 2:* Publication milestones: *Life* (**September 24, 2021**) for root fractional gravity (PMC8539686) and *Frontiers in Plant Science* (**January 8, 2024**) for shoot conservation (PMC10800490).

- *Panel 3:* **Caption:** *"From STS-135's final cargo bay to 2024's cross-mission synthesis, one 5-day EMCS run rewrote how we read orbital controls."*

**Page 21 (2-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* The decommissioned `EMCS` hardware retired in memory, its twin-rotor legacy preserved in `OSD-223`, `OSD-251`, and `OSD-437`.

- *Panel 2:* **Caption:** *"Next in the EMCS archive: what happens when you add directional blue light across lunar and Martian gravity?"*

**Page 22 (Full-Bleed Transition):** Directional blue LEDs illuminating *Arabidopsis* `Ler` seedlings inside `EMCS` (`Seedling Growth`, `OSD-251`). **Caption:** *"Next: `OSD-251` — Fractional gravity meets phototropism."*

### Act III: Synthesis & Mission Debrief (Pages 23–32)

**Page 23 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* Root vs. Shoot synthesis in `OSD-223`: roots reveal continuous `g`-dose curves (`101` genes, `HSPs`, pectin lyases, `ANAC009`); shoots reveal conserved growth-up / stress-down remodeling (`1,112` up / `1,429` down).

- *Panel 2:* The `1g` centrifuge rule: onboard `1g` separates true microgravity (`μg` vs. `1g`) from ISS habitat stress (`1g` vs. `ERM-2`).

- *Panel 3:* `Site II` (`5'-GGCCCA-3'`) + `HY5` + `miR319c`/`miR398b-3p` form a multi-layered regulatory circuit in weightless shoots.

- *Panel 4:* `Ca²⁺` & `InsP₃` vulnerability: downregulating `40` `Ca²⁺` genes and `200` biotic-defense genes in `μg` flags a crop-protection risk for orbital greenhouses.

**Page 24 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Hardware & operational lessons: cassette drying at Position 5 (`1g` outer edge) taught teams to watch moisture gradients under centrifugation.

- *Panel 2:* Reproducibility lesson: even back-to-back bioreplicates in identical `EMCS` hardware showed run-to-run variance on the ISS—making multi-replicate runs mandatory.

- *Panel 3:* Scale-up lesson: `5-day` `TROPI` cassettes excel at early signaling, while `Veggie` and `APH` must test whether plastid and defense shifts persist to seed-to-seed maturity.

**Page 25 (4-Panel Grid):**

- *Panel 1:* **Moon & Mars Design Cue:** `0.53g` (above Mars `0.38g` and Moon `0.16g`) already triggers threshold genes like `GATA9` and `ANAC009`.

- *Panel 2:* **Pathogen Watch:** Suppressed `WRKY18/40/60`, `CNGC19`, and `OSCA1.3` in `μg` warrant active microbiome monitoring in spaceflight agriculture.

- *Panel 3:* **Chaperone Engineering:** `HSP70`, `HSP90.1`, and `HSP101` scale directly with gravitational load from `μg` through `6.5× g`.

- *Panel 4:* **Open Science:** All `40` `OSD-223` (`GLDS-223`) libraries remain publicly accessible on NASA OSDR.

**Page 26 (3-Panel Sequence):**

- *Panel 1:* Series continuity bridge: `Vol. 24` (`OSD-218` `Veggie` root skewing) → `Vol. 25` (`OSD-220` `SJ-10` methylome) → `Vol. 26` (`OSD-223` `EMCS` fractional-`g` & `1g` control).

- *Panel 2:* Visual motif: `SJ-10` lacked a `1g` centrifuge; `EMCS` proved why having one flips our reading of `> 400` stress genes.

- *Panel 3:* **Caption:** *"Gravity isn't a binary switch—and neither is spaceflight."*

**Pages 27–30 (4-Page Epilogue Montage — 1 Panel per Page):**

- *Page 27:* Silhouette of a `5-day-old` *Arabidopsis* seedling inside a black-gridded `PES` seed cassette.

- *Page 28:* The `EMCS` twin rotors spinning in silent opposition inside the Columbus module.

- *Page 29:* A `Site II` (`5'-GGCCCA-3'`) promoter logo glowing over a heatmap of `1g`-induced vs. `μg`-masked defense genes.

- *Page 30:* Looking ahead to `OSD-251`: blue-light phototropism under lunar and Martian gravity gradients.

**Pages 31–32 (Double-Page Spread):** Full-bleed **Mission Debrief Infographic Spread** (detailed in Section 4).

## 4. Mission Debrief (Pages 31–32 Infographic Layout)

### Left Spread (Page 31) — Mission, Hardware & Fractional-`g` Design

- **Top Banner:** `OSD-223 / GLDS-223` (`10.26030/wdtz-v612`) | **Experiment:** *Plant Signaling in Microgravity* | **Flight:** `STS-135` (`Jul 2011`) → `ISS EMCS` → `SpaceX Dragon` (`Mar 2013`)

- **Hardware & Growth Specs:**

  - **Facility:** `EMCS` (ISS Columbus) — `2` rotors (`μg` stationary vs. fractional-`g` centrifuge: `0.53g`, `0.65g`, `0.76g`, `0.88g`, `1.0g` across `5` cassette slots/EC); `ERM-2` ground control at NASA ARC.

  - **Cassettes:** `27` seeds/`PES` membrane (`Whatman #3`/`17 CHR`, `0.5× MS` no sucrose), `48 h` initial `1g` cue, `5 d` continuous white LED, `24 °C`, `~20–21% O₂`, `CO₂ ~370 → ~760 ppm`.

  - **Storage & Assay:** Frozen in ISS `MELFI` (`-80 °C`), dissected in `RNAlater®`, `RNAqueous Micro kit` (`RIN > 9.5`), `40` samples on **3 lanes Illumina HiSeq 2500 (`125 bp` SE)**.

- **Genotypes:** *Arabidopsis* `Col-0` WT vs. transgenic **`InsP 5-ptase`** (hydrolyzes `InsP₃`).

### Right Spread (Page 32) — Root Fractional-`g` & Shoot `1g`-Control Findings

- **Roots Across Fractional Gravity (PMC8539686):**

  - `16` `μg` vs. `4` reps each at `0.53g`, `0.65g`, `0.88g` → **`101` fractional-`g` DEGs** (`padj < 0.001` curated from `382`) in `6` dose-response shapes.

  - **Key Groups:** `20` TFs (`WOX4`, `SPL6`, `TCP7`, `NFYA1` up with `g`; `HM2`, `ANAC009`, `GATA9` down with `g`), `9` HSPs (`HSP70`, `HSP90.1`, `HSP101`, `DNAJ` up with `g` and **`> 9-fold`** at `6.5× g`), `14` defense (`CNGC19`, `OSCA1.3` up with `g`), `17` cell wall (pectin lyases, `PAE7/12` highest in `μg`).

- **Shoots: `PS` (`OSD-223`) + `PRR` (`OSD-437`) (PMC10800490):**

  - `PS` WT shoots: **`1,819` DEGs**; combined `PS + PRR`: **`1,112` up** & **`1,429` down** in `μg` vs. onboard `1g`.

  - **Up in `μg`:** `159` TFs (`TCP22`, `SPCH`), `38+` auxin (`PIN3/4`, `TIR1`, `11` `SAURs`), `50` vesicle/Golgi, `SGR5`/`LAZY1`, **Site II (`5'-GGCCCA-3'`)** motif (`258` hits / `174` genes).

  - **Down in `μg`:** `120` stress TFs (`15` `ERFs`, `12` `WRKYs`), `~200` biotic defense, `~140` abiotic/ABA, `~40` `Ca²⁺` (`CBL1`, `CPKs`), `~300` plastid genes, `miR319c`/`miR863-5p`/`miR398b-3p` targets.

  - **Core Insight:** Stress genes are **up in onboard `1g` vs. Earth** (`ERM-2`), but **down in `μg` vs. onboard `1g`**—proving `μg` masks spaceflight stress.
